opis.sh: Posvećeno fudbalerima poginulim u NOR-u.
opis.en: Dedicated to footballers killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima iz Kadine Luke i Paležnice palim 1941-1945. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters from Kadina Luka and Paležnica who fell in 1941-1945.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Radničkom bataljonu Užičkog partizanskog odreda, koji je 29. novembra 1941, u [bici na Kadinjači](Q12956415), izginuo braneći slobodno Užice od nemačke ofanzive.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Workers' Battalion of the Užice Partisan Detachment, which fell on 29 November 1941 in the [Battle of Kadinjača](Q12956415), defending free Užice against the German offensive.

opis.sh: Na mestu smrti narodnog heroja Rudija Čajavca.
opis.en: At the place where people's hero Rudi Čajavec died.

opis.sh: Prvobitna česma Mehmedu Skopljaku iz 1954. zamenjena je 1985. novim obeležjem.
opis.en: The original 1954 fountain to Mehmed Skopljak was replaced by a new memorial in 1985.

kalata.adresa: Jugozapadni deo sela, oko 500m zapadno od stadiona

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima NOR-a; prema obnovljenom natpisu spomenik potiče iz 1960, dok katalog navodi 1963. godine. Spomenik i njegov filigranski ukras obnovljeni su 2024. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters of the National Liberation War; the renewed inscription dates the monument to 1960, while the catalogue gives 1963. The monument and its filigree decoration were restored in 2024.

opis.sh: Zajednička grobnica žrtava fašističkog terora iz 1974. nalazi se u severnom delu mesnog groblja. Obnovljena je 2018; nije isto što i obližnja kosturnica palih boraca.
opis.en: The 1974 communal grave of victims of fascist terror is in the northern part of the local cemetery. It was restored in 2018 and is distinct from the nearby fallen fighters’ ossuary.

opis.sh: Memorijal Vojislava Vasiljevića iz 1979. ispred nekadašnje škole obuhvata niz betonskih elemenata. Betonska kompozicija je sačuvana, dok su bronzane ploče i biste Marije Bursać i Vida Bodirože Vicuke uklonjene.
opis.en: Vojislav Vasiljević’s 1979 memorial outside the former school consists of a row of concrete elements. The concrete composition survives, while the bronze plaques and busts of Marija Bursać and Vid Bodiroža Vicuka were removed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno streljanim Bokeljima, Hercegovcima i Dalmatincima.
opis.en: Dedicated to executed people from Boka, Herzegovina and Dalmatia.

opis.sh: Posvećeno pobedi naroda Slavonije i [Šestom slavonskom korpusu](Q1445288). Apstraktna skulptura Vojina Bakića iz 1968, jedna od najvećih na svetu, srušena je 1992.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victory of the people of Slavonia and the [6th Slavonian Corps](Q1445288). Vojin Bakić's abstract sculpture of 1968, one of the largest in the world, was demolished in 1992.

opis.sh: Posvećeno bici na Šušnjarima.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Battle of Šušnjari.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama bitke na Šušnjaru.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the Battle of Šušnjar.

opis.sh: Spomenik oslobođenja, delo Draga Tršara iz 1962, na ulazu u Park Evropa.
opis.en: Liberation Monument by Drago Tršar from 1962, at the entrance to Europe Park.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palima u NOB sa Sodnog vrha.
opis.en: Dedicated to those from Sodni Vrh killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim radnicima fabrike Utok.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen workers of the Utok factory.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama Drugog svetskog rata iz kamniškog kraja.
opis.en: Dedicated to WWII victims from the Kamnik area.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Karanskom bataljonu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Karan Battalion.

karanovac-partizansko-groblje.autor: Faik Helić & Zaim Topić & Mehmed Mujkić & Anton Šego

opis.sh: Posvećeno šestorici žitelja Karbunice streljanih u novembru 1943.
opis.en: Dedicated to six residents of Karbunica executed in November 1943.

opis.sh: Bronzana statua sa kosturnice iz 1955. ukradena je u novembru 2010. Prostor je obnovljen 2012, uz dodatak zasebnog obeležja ratu 1992-1995; originalna statua nije vraćena.
opis.en: The bronze statue from the 1955 ossuary was stolen in November 2010. The site was renovated in 2012 with a separate memorial to the 1992-1995 war; the original statue was not restored.

opis.sh: Na ovom mestu uz železničku prugu nemačke snage obesile su dvanaest stanovnika Busovače 1. novembra 1943. Spomenik je podignut 4. jula 1987.
opis.en: German forces hanged twelve inhabitants of Busovača here beside the railway on 1 November 1943. The memorial was erected on 4 July 1987.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnim herojima Strašu Pindžuru, Blažu Todorovskom Cicetu i Kiri Krstevu Strašu.
opis.en: Dedicated to People's Heroes Strašo Pindžur, Blažo Todorovski Ciceto and Kiro Krstev Strašo.

kavadarci-naroden-heroj-kiro-atanasovski.natpis: Народен херој Киро Атанасовски-Налбатот / Народен херој Димче Мирчев

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašističkog terora iz kavadaračkog kraja u ratu 1941-1945. Kosturnica je otkrivena 7. septembra 1976.
opis.en: Dedicated to victims of fascist terror from the Kavadarci area in the war of 1941-1945. The ossuary was unveiled on 7 September 1976.

opis.sh: Posvećeno dvanaestorici mladića iz Vataše koje su bugarske okupacione snage streljale 16. juna 1943. Memorijal se nalazi u Moklištu, kraj mesta njihovog stradanja.
opis.en: Dedicated to twelve young men from Vataša executed by Bulgarian occupying forces on 16 June 1943. The memorial stands at Moklište, near the place where they were killed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama proboja iz logora 1941.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the 1941 camp breakout.

opis.sh: Bista partizanskog borca na Kitinom kalu; ploča sa imenom je razbijena.
opis.en: Bust of a Partisan fighter at Kitino Kale; the name plaque is broken.

opis.sh: Muzej prikazuje narodnooslobodilačku borbu u zapadnoj Makedoniji, uz građu o ranijim oslobodilačkim pokretima i Ilindenskom ustanku. Za posetioce je otvoren 11. oktobra 1980.
opis.en: The museum presents the Partisan struggle in western Macedonia, alongside material on earlier liberation movements and the Ilinden Uprising. It opened to visitors on 11 October 1980.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašističkog terora iz Kičeva i okoline u ratu 1941-1945. Kosturnica na Kitinom kaleu završena je 1968.
opis.en: Dedicated to victims of fascist terror from Kičevo and its surroundings in the war of 1941-1945. The ossuary on Kitino Kale was completed in 1968.

kikinda-bista-zore-krdzalic-zage.adresa: Ispred Visoke škole za obrazovanje vaspitača

opis.sh: Posvećeno formiranju Kikindskog partizanskog odreda.
opis.en: Dedicated to the formation of the Kikinda Partisan Detachment.

kikinda-spomenik-internircima.slikaPotpis: Tatjana Panić, Hronologija izlaganja skulpture u Srbiji

opis.sh: Posvećeno 46 Kikinđana deportovanih 6. maja 1942. u koncentracione logore u Norveškoj.
opis.en: Dedicated to 46 people from Kikinda deported on 6 May 1942 to concentration camps in Norway.

opis.sh: Posvećeno 13. vojvođanskoj brigadi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 13th Vojvodina Brigade.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašizma iz Kikinde. Središnju figuru „Ranjenika“, koja rukom dodiruje grudi, prate dva bronzana reljefa Aleksandra Zarina sa prizorima oslobodilačke borbe.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascism from Kikinda. The central “Wounded Fighter” figure, with a hand against its chest, is flanked by two bronze reliefs by Aleksandar Zarin depicting the liberation struggle.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora Bukovice.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror from Bukovica.

kladanj-spomenik-palim-borcima.adresa: U centru Kladnja, uz Dom kulture

opis.sh: Posvećen borcima Kladnja i okoline koji su poginuli u NOR-u 1941-1945. Spomenik je podignut 1954, a njegovo ograđeno podnožje obnovljeno je 2013. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters from Kladanj and the surrounding area who died in the 1941–1945 liberation war. The monument was erected in 1954, and its enclosed base was renovated in 2013.

klajic-spomen-park.adresa: U centru sela, zapadno od puta, naspram groblja

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima iz Klajića poginulim u Drugom svetskom ratu. U centru sela nalaze se memorijalni zid sa pločom i bista.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters from Klajić who fell in the Second World War. A memorial wall with a plaque and a bust stand in the village centre.

klanjec-spomenik-josipu-brozu-titu.adresa: Galerija Antuna Augustinčića, Trg Antuna Mihanovića 10

opis.sh: Prvobitni spomenik palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora podignut je 1951. Uništen je u junu 1992, a zamenjen novim obeležjem 2010.
opis.en: The original memorial to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror was erected in 1951. It was destroyed in June 1992 and replaced with a new memorial in 2010.

klikovace-spomen-obiljezje.slikaPotpis: Foto Lipa, Spomenici i spomen-obilježja NOR-a u opštini Danilovgrad (2017)

opis.sh: Posvećeno formiranju Ariljskog bataljona.
opis.en: Dedicated to the formation of the Arilje Battalion.

knezevi-vinogradi.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

knezevo-spomen-grobnica.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

opis.sh: Grobnica sedmorice nepoznatih boraca i Jovana Popovića poginulih 1945. i žrtava fašističkog terora iz Kneževa.
opis.en: Tomb of seven unknown fighters and Jovan Popović, killed in 1945, and victims of fascist terror from Kneževo.

opis.sh: Posvećeno prvoj regionalnoj konferenciji KPJ održanoj 1942. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the first regional KPJ conference held in 1942.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima poginulim u [Kninskoj operaciji](Q6461523) i oslobađanju Knina. Spomenik iz 1969. srušen je eksplozivom 1995.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in the [Knin Operation](Q6461523) and the liberation of Knin. The 1969 monument was blown up in 1995.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima Timočke krajine u oslobodilačkim ratovima od 1804. do 1945, uključujući Drugi svetski rat. Bogdan Bogdanović oblikovao je park kamenim obeležjima sa uklesanim simbolima iz svakodnevnog života.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters from the Timok region in the wars of liberation from 1804 to 1945, including the Second World War. Bogdan Bogdanović designed the park with stone markers carved with symbols of everyday life.

opis.sh: Posvećeno meštanima poginulim u ratovima 1912-1918. i 1941-1945, među kojima je aktivista NOP-a Dragomir Gajić. Memorijal obuhvata ploče sa imenima i dve biste.
opis.en: Dedicated to local people killed in the wars of 1912–1918 and 1941–1945, including resistance activist Dragomir Gajić. The memorial comprises plaques listing the fallen and two busts.

opis.sh: Spomen-kompleks na brdu Lokubija u obliku amfiteatra, sa mozaicima Gligora Čemerskog.
opis.en: Amphitheater-shaped memorial complex on Lokubija hill with mosaics by Gligor Čemerski.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Koceljeve i Subotice u Drugom svetskom ratu. Uz spomenik sa imenima poginulih nalazi se bista narodnog heroja Milorada Stanojlovića.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters from Koceljeva and Subotica during the Second World War. A bust of National Hero Milorad Stanojlović stands beside the monument bearing the names of the fallen.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnim herojima kočevskog kraja, učesnicima NOB. U parku uz gimnaziju postavljeno je osam njihovih bisti na kamenim postamentima.
opis.en: Dedicated to the People’s Heroes from the Kočevje region who took part in the Partisan struggle. Eight busts on stone pedestals stand in the park beside the grammar school.

kocevski-rog-partizanska-bolnisnica-pugl.adresa: Ob pogorišču bolnišnice Pugled, jugovzhodno od nekdanje Žage Rog

opis.sh: Grobište 28 teško ranjenih partizana koji su stradali kada su nemačke snage spalile bolnicu Pugled 27. oktobra 1943. godine. Miloš Lapajne oblikovao je terasastu kamenu celinu sa cilindričnim spomenikom i spiralnim usecima, otkrivenu 1959. godine.
opis.en: Burial ground of 28 severely wounded Partisans killed when German forces burned Pugled Hospital on 27 October 1943. Miloš Lapajne designed the terraced stone ensemble with a cylindrical monument and spiral grooves, unveiled in 1959.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Matiji Tičaru i Francu Mubiju.
opis.en: Dedicated to Matija Tičar and Franc Mubi.

opis.sh: Posvećeno prvom zasedanju [ZAVNO Crne Gore i Boke](Q334224), održanom u Kolašinu 1943, i borbi Kolašinaca u Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the first session of the [Anti-Fascist Council of Montenegro and Boka](Q334224), held in Kolašin in 1943, and to the people of Kolašin in the liberation war.

kolasin-spomenik-veljku-vlahovicu.slikaPotpis: Tatjana Panić, Hronologija izlaganja skulpture u Srbiji

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Veljku Vlahoviću](Q317399). Spomenik Ota Loga svečano je otkriven 22. septembra 1989. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to [Veljko Vlahović](Q317399). Oto Logo’s monument was ceremonially unveiled on 22 September 1989.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima; nalazi se kod raskrsnice južno od škole u Kolibama Gornjim, preko puta džamije. Veza sa ranijom zajedničkom grobnicom iz 1949. nije potvrđena.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters, at the junction south of the school in Kolibe Gornje, opposite the mosque. Its relationship to the earlier 1949 collective grave is unconfirmed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima, radnicima fabrike Helios.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters who worked at the Helios factory.

kolovrat-bista-ljubise-miodragovica.adresa: Bista Ljubiše Miodragovića, narodnog heroja, U parku tekstilnog kombinata koji nosi njegovo ime.

kolovrat-spomen-kuca.adresa: Spomen-kuća u kojoj je 1915. godine rođen Ljubiša Miodragović, narodni heroj.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima NOB i Crvene armije.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisans and Red Army soldiers.

opis.sh: Sačuvana partizanska bolnica u Kočevskom rogu, namenjena lečenju teških ranjenika tokom Drugog svetskog rata. Drvene barake i prateća obeležja čine muzejsku celinu kojom upravlja Dolenjski muzej.
opis.en: A preserved Partisan hospital in Kočevski Rog used to treat seriously wounded patients during the Second World War. The wooden huts and associated memorials form a museum site managed by the Dolenjska Museum.

opis.sh: Spomen-groblje iz 1960. sa posmrtnim ostacima oko 3.700 boraca poginulih na [Sremskom frontu](Q3299011) od decembra 1944. do aprila 1945.
opis.en: Memorial cemetery from 1960 holding the remains of about 3,700 fighters killed on the [Syrmian Front](Q3299011) between December 1944 and April 1945.

opis.sh: Posvećeno deci izbeglicama umrloj tokom Drugog svetskog rata u domovima u Mataruškoj Banji i okolini.
opis.en: Dedicated to refugee children who died during WWII in homes in Mataruška Banja and its surroundings.

opis.sh: Rodna kuća [Rade Končara](Q640602), jednog od organizatora ustanka u Hrvatskoj, uređena je 1959. kao memorijalni muzej. Kuća i zbirka devastirane su tokom rata 1990-ih, a nekadašnja postavka nije dostupna posetiocima.
opis.en: The birthplace of [Rade Končar](Q640602), one of the organisers of the uprising in Croatia, became a memorial museum in 1959. The house and collection were devastated during the war of the 1990s, and the former exhibition is not accessible to visitors.

opis.sh: Posvećeno osmorici članova porodice Končar, stradalih 30. novembra 1944. kada je okupator spalio njihovo imanje.
opis.en: Dedicated to eight members of the Končar family who died on 30 November 1944 when the occupiers burned their homestead.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Drugom majevičkom odredu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 2nd Majevica Detachment.

konjuh-spomen-zona-korita.adresa: Uz planinarsku stazu iz Mačkovca; obeležja na više mesta, položaj zone je približan.

opis.sh: Memorijalna zona obuhvata dva kenotafa i grob [Peje Markovića](Q16380642), čije je obeležje podignuto 1978. i obnovljeno 2009. Dragiša Trifković izradio je nekadašnji reljef na grobu; nije potvrđen kao autor svih obeležja zone.
opis.en: The memorial zone includes two cenotaphs and the grave of [Pejo Marković](Q16380642), whose memorial was erected in 1978 and restored in 2009. Dragiša Trifković made the former relief on the grave; he has not been confirmed as the author of all memorials in the zone.

kopacevo-spomen-grobnica.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

opis.sh: Grobnica poginulih boraca i žrtava fašističkog terora iz Kopačeva i trojice nepoznatih boraca.
opis.en: Tomb of fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror from Kopačevo and three unknown fighters.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama ustaškog [logora Danica](Q11295127), koji je u Koprivnici radio 1941-1942. Betonska kompozicija Lenka Pleštine poznata kao „Vješala“ deo je memorijalnog prostora uređenog na mestu nekadašnjeg logora.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the Ustaša-run [Danica concentration camp](Q11295127), which operated in Koprivnica in 1941–1942. Lenko Pleština’s concrete “Gallows” composition forms part of the memorial grounds established at the former camp site.

opis.sh: Bronzana figura partizana u izviđanju, delo Ivana Sabolića, prvobitno je postavljena 1955. na Zrinskom trgu. Godine 1991. premeštena je u Spomen-područje Danica.
opis.en: Ivan Sabolić’s bronze figure of a partisan scout was originally installed in Zrinski Square in 1955. It was moved to the Danica Memorial Area in 1991.

opis.sh: Posvećeno zatočenicima ustaškog [logora Danica](Q11295127), koji je u Koprivnici delovao 1941–1942. Memorijalni prostor otvoren je 1981. prema projektu Lenka Pleštine, uz očuvanu zgradu logoraša i dela više autora.
opis.en: Dedicated to the prisoners of the Ustaša [Danica concentration camp](Q11295127), which operated in Koprivnica in 1941–1942. The memorial grounds opened in 1981 to a design by Lenko Pleština and include a surviving prisoners’ building and works by several artists.

opis.sh: Spomenik na Židovskom groblju posvećen je 214 pripadnika koprivničke jevrejske zajednice stradalih u fašističkim logorima tokom Drugog svetskog rata. Nastao je 1975. preoblikovanjem ranijeg spomenika žrtvama Prvog svetskog rata, dela arhitekte Slavka Löwyja.
opis.en: The monument in the Jewish cemetery commemorates 214 members of Koprivnica’s Jewish community who perished in fascist camps during World War II. It was created in 1975 by adapting an earlier World War I memorial designed by architect Slavko Löwy.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima NOB i žrtvama fašističkog terora iz Koraja i majevičkog kraja. Kompleks obuhvata spomen-zidove sa imenima stradalih i kosturnicu boraca vojvođanskih i majevičkih jedinica.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan fighters and victims of fascist terror from Koraj and the Majevica region. The complex includes memorial walls naming the victims and an ossuary of fighters from Vojvodina and Majevica units.

korbovo-spomen-park.adresa: Na malom trgu uz glavnu raskrsnicu, blizu pošte

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima [23. srpske divizije](Q981075) i žrtvama fašizma. U memorijalnom prostoru nalaze se obeležja Prvog i Drugog svetskog rata, dok je nekadašnja spomen-česma uklonjena pri obnovi.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters of the [23rd Serbian Division](Q981075) and victims of fascism. The memorial area contains First and Second World War memorials; its former memorial fountain was removed during renovation.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima sahranjenim na groblju partizanske bolnice Bijeli Potoci–Kamensko na Plješevici, prve partizanske bolnice u Hrvatskoj, gde ih počiva oko 3.000. Spomenik je razmontiran i odnet oko 2008, pa na mestu nema ostataka.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters buried at the cemetery of the Bijeli Potoci–Kamensko hospital on Plješevica, the first Partisan hospital in Croatia, where about 3,000 lie. The monument was dismantled and carried away around 2008, leaving no remains on the site.

opis.sh: Spomenik iz 1966. nalazi se uz kosturnicu u centru Korita, gde su preneti posmrtni ostaci žrtava ubijenih 1941. i bačenih u Korićku jamu. Skulptura Nandora Glida dodata je 1991; zasebno obeležje nalazi se kod same jame.
opis.en: Built in 1966, the memorial stands by the ossuary in central Korita, where the remains of victims killed in 1941 and thrown into Korita Pit were reburied. Nandor Glid’s sculpture was added in 1991; a separate memorial stands at the pit itself.

opis.sh: Obeležje sa spomen-kapelom i pločama na mestu Korićke jame, u koju su 1941. bačene ubijene žrtve. Kosturnica i Glidova skulptura nalaze se na zasebnoj lokaciji u centru sela.
opis.en: A memorial chapel and plaques mark Korita Pit, where victims killed in 1941 were thrown. The ossuary and Glid’s sculpture stand at a separate site in the village centre.

koroska-bela-spominski-park.adresa: Ob Cesti Ivana Cankarja, ob vhodu v vrtec

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima NOB i žrtvama okupacije, uključujući pet talaca koje su nemačke snage streljale 4. septembra 1941. Park obuhvata grobna obeležja i spomenik taocima sa skulpturom Jake Torkara.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisan fighters and victims of the occupation, including five hostages executed by German forces on 4 September 1941. The park includes grave markers and a hostage memorial with a sculpture by Jaka Torkar.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima i žrtvama fašizma, uz obeležje poginulima u Prvom svetskom ratu. Memorijalna celina obuhvata obelisk i kosturnicu boraca NOB iz 1960.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascism, alongside a memorial to those who fell in the First World War. The memorial area includes an obelisk and a Partisan ossuary dating from 1960.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Kosmajskom partizanskom odredu](Q11117229), koji se na ovom terenu borio od 1941. do 1944. Spomenik visok 30 metara stoji na Malom visu, jednom od tri vrha Kosmaja.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [Kosmaj Partisan Detachment](Q11117229), which fought in this area from 1941 to 1944. The 30-metre monument stands on Mali Vis, one of the three peaks of Kosmaj.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima poginulim u NOB-u 1941-1945; groblje čine 27 humki sa nadgrobnim pločama i betonski spomenik na kamenom postolju. Među sahranjenima su narodni heroj Branko Tubić i komandant bataljona Milan Muharem.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in the Partisan struggle of 1941–1945; the cemetery comprises 27 burial mounds with gravestones and a concrete monument on a stone base. Those buried include People’s Hero Branko Tubić and battalion commander Milan Muharem.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Prvom splitskom partizanskom odredu](Q12640709), čiji su borci u avgustu 1941. kod Košuta stradali u borbi i zarobljavanju. Trokraki betonski spomenik Vuka Bombardellija iz 1961. miniran je 1992, a na mestu su ostali njegovi delovi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [1st Split Partisan Detachment](Q12640709), whose fighters were killed or captured near Košute in August 1941. Vuko Bombardelli’s three-pronged concrete monument, erected in 1961, was blown up in 1992, leaving broken sections at the site.

kotlina-ploca-borcu-i-zrtvama-fasizma.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima NOB iz Kovačice. U Novom parku postavljeni su centralno obeležje sa petokrakom i kameni belezi sa posvetama na srpskohrvatskom i slovačkom jeziku.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan fighters from Kovačica. Novi Park contains a central memorial bearing a five-pointed star and standing stones with dedications in Serbo-Croatian and Slovak.

opis.sh: Rodna kuća Ilije Nešina, zaštićena kao spomenik kulture.
opis.en: Birth house of Ilija Nešin, protected as a cultural monument.

opis.sh: Posvećeno taocima streljanim na Martinkovoj njivi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the hostages executed at Martinkova Njiva.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima i narodu Kozare u [Kozaračkoj ofanzivi](Q2985697) u leto 1942, kada je poginulo oko 2.500 partizana, a 68.500 civila ubijeno ili odvedeno u ustaške logore.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters and people of Kozara in the [Kozara Offensive](Q2985697) of summer 1942, when about 2,500 Partisans were killed and 68,500 civilians were killed or deported to Ustaše camps.

kozbana-spominski-park-nob.adresa: Ob cesti proti mejnemu prehodu, 300 m zahodno od pokopališča

opis.sh: Posvećeno učesnicima izbornog zbora 1944. na kojem je govorio [Jože Srebrnič](Q12747796), kao i ratnim žrtvama čija su imena na kamenim stubovima. Memorijal čine kameni zid sa portalom, ploča i šest stubova.
opis.en: Dedicated to participants in a 1944 election gathering addressed by [Jože Srebrnič](Q12747796), and to war victims named on the stone pillars. The memorial comprises a stone wall with a gateway, a plaque and six pillars.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima NOB i formiranju Istarskog odreda i Istarskog vojnog područja. U parku su centralni kameni spomenik i biste partizanskih boraca.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan fighters and the formation of the Istrian Detachment and Istrian Military Area. The park contains a central stone memorial and busts of Partisan fighters.

opis.sh: Spomenik u Gredi kod Kozinaca posvećen je palim borcima NOB i žrtvama fašističkog terora. Podignut je 2003. u kompleksu koji obuhvata i zasebno obeležje ratu 1992-1995.
opis.en: The monument at Greda near Kozinci commemorates fallen Partisans and victims of fascist terror. It was erected in 2003 in a complex that also contains a separate 1992-1995 war memorial.

opis.sh: Spomen-zid palim borcima kod škole podignut je 27. jula 1953. Prvobitno je imao veliku crvenu zvezdu na vrhu; odvojen je od kosturnice kod izvora Vitinka.
opis.en: The fallen fighters memorial wall at the school was erected on 27 July 1953. It originally had a large red star on top and is separate from the ossuary near the Vitinka spring.

opis.sh: Zajednička grobnica osnovana je 1950, a u kosturnicu je preuređena 1952. Današnja oblikovana celina potiče iz obnove 1986–1987; centralno obeležje je sačuvano, dok su pojedini nadgrobni znaci oštećeni.
opis.en: The communal grave was established in 1950 and converted into an ossuary in 1952. The present designed ensemble dates to the 1986–1987 reconstruction; the central memorial survives, while some grave markers are damaged.

opis.sh: Bronzani ranjeni borac Dragana Panića iz 1953. u sredini fontane u Velikom parku; ovde se obeležava 7. jul, Dan ustanka.
opis.en: Dragan Panić's 1953 bronze wounded fighter in the center of a fountain in the Great Park; 7 July, Uprising Day, is commemorated here.

opis.sh: Poklon SR Hrvatske otkriven 17. oktobra 1981, delo Vojina Bakića: sedam čeličnih diskova kao svetlosna žiža tri grobnice.
opis.en: A gift from SR Croatia unveiled on 17 October 1981, by Vojin Bakić: seven steel discs forming a focal point of light for three tombs.

kragujevac-spomen-obelezje-naroda-hrvats.autor: Vojin Bakić & Josip Sajsl & Silvana Sajsl

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama [masakra u Kragujevcu](Q685201), koje su nemačke okupacione snage streljale u oktobru 1941. godine. Park u Šumaricama obuhvata mesta masovnih grobnica, memorijalne skulpture i Muzej „21. oktobar“.
opis.en: Dedicated to victims of the [Kragujevac massacre](Q685201), executed by German occupation forces in October 1941. The park in Šumarice encompasses mass grave sites, memorial sculptures and the 21 October Museum.

opis.sh: Prvi spomenik u Spomen-parku „Kragujevački oktobar“, na mestu gde je 21. oktobra 1941. streljana jedina žena, Nada Naumović. Delo Anta Gržetića iz 1959.
opis.en: The first monument in the "Kragujevac October" Memorial Park, at the site where the only woman, Nada Naumović, was shot on 21 October 1941. By Ante Gržetić, 1959.

opis.sh: Skulptura Jovana Soldatovića iz 1979. ispred Spomen-muzeja „21. oktobar“: mršav čovek koji klonulo sedi sa tri uvela cveta.
opis.en: Jovan Soldatović's 1979 sculpture in front of the "21 October" Memorial Museum: a gaunt man slumped on a stool holding three withered flowers.

opis.sh: Posvećeno streljanima iz okolnih sela. Spomenik Jelice i Gradimira Bosnića iz 1970. podseća na seosko dvorište sa stogovima sena.
opis.en: Dedicated to the executed people from the surrounding villages. Jelica and Gradimir Bosnić's 1970 monument recalls a village yard with haystacks.

opis.sh: Posvećeno streljanim dečacima, čistačima obuće, na mestu gde su sahranjeni. Beli pupoljak presečen mačem Nebojše Delje iz 1968.
opis.en: Dedicated to the executed shoeshine boys, at the place where they are buried. Nebojša Delja's white bud cut by a sword, 1968.

opis.sh: Na mestu gde je streljano 300 radnika i radničke omladine Vojnotehničkog zavoda. Delo Anta Gržetića iz 1966: smrtno ranjen čovek i beli obelisk u obliku slova V.
opis.en: At the site where 300 workers and young workers of the Military Technical Institute were shot. Ante Gržetić's 1966 work: a mortally wounded man and a white obelisk forming a V.

opis.sh: Poklon rumunskog grada Piteštija iz 1994, delo Antona Stojkua: otvorena knjiga čiji listovi prelaze u broj 21 i goluba.
opis.en: A 1994 gift from the Romanian city of Pitești by Anton Stoicu: an open book whose pages turn into the number 21 and a dove.

opis.sh: Mermerni reljef Migela Roma iz Meksika, podignut 1991. za 50. godišnjicu masakra u Kragujevcu.
opis.en: Marble relief by Miguel Romo of Mexico, erected in 1991 for the 50th anniversary of the Kragujevac massacre.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Prvoj Titovoj štafeti.
opis.en: Dedicated to the first Tito Relay.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama [masakra u Kragujevcu](Q685201) i Beemeovoj naredbi „sto za jednog“. Bronza Nandora Glida iz 1980, poklon Modriče.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the [Kragujevac massacre](Q685201) and Böhme's "hundred for one" order. Nandor Glid's 1980 bronze, a gift from Modriča.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Srbima i Jevrejima streljanim 20. oktobra 1941. Spomenik Milorada Zorbića iz 1991, poklon Bat Jama, odozgo daje Davidovu zvezdu.
opis.en: Dedicated to Serbs and Jews shot on 20 October 1941. Milorad Zorbić's 1991 monument, a gift from Bat Yam, forms a Star of David when seen from above.

opis.sh: Skulptura Jovana Soldatovića iz 1979, inspirisana slovenskim suđajama koje novorođenčetu određuju sudbinu.
opis.en: Jovan Soldatović's 1979 sculpture inspired by the Slavic Fates who decide a newborn's destiny.

opis.sh: Posvećeno logorašima streljanim u [logoru na Metinom brdu](Q133864850). Delo Dragana Panića iz 1987.
opis.en: Dedicated to inmates executed at the [Metino Brdo camp](Q133864850). By Dragan Panić, 1987.

opis.sh: Večni plamen Dragana Đorđevića iz 1978, koji je upalio Josip Broz Tito; obnovljen je 21. oktobra 2011.
opis.en: Dragan Đorđević's 1978 eternal flame, lit by Josip Broz Tito; it was restored on 21 October 2011.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim Šumadincima.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fallen of Šumadija.

opis.sh: Posvećeno đacima i profesorima koje su Nemci streljali u Šumaricama 21. oktobra 1941, u [odmazdi](Q685201) u kojoj su ubijene hiljade građana Kragujevca. Spomenik stoji gde je streljana najveća grupa učenika i 15 profesora.
opis.en: Dedicated to the pupils and teachers shot by the Germans at Šumarice on 21 October 1941, in a [reprisal](Q685201) that killed thousands of Kragujevac citizens. The monument stands where the largest group of pupils and 15 teachers were shot.

krajcinovici-spomen-cesma-posvecena-pali.adresa: Spomen-česma posvećena palim borcima i žrtvama fašizma 1941-1945.

opis.sh: Bronzana figura partizana sa puškom više nije na spomen-groblju iz 1956. Grobljanska celina je sačuvana i očišćena 2017.
opis.en: The bronze figure of a Partisan with a rifle is no longer at the 1956 memorial cemetery. The cemetery complex survives and was cleared in 2017.

kraljevo-aleja-nosilaca-spomenice-1941.adresa: Staro groblje, jugozapadni deo, kod ulaznog platoa

opis.sh: Aleja sa posmrtnim ostacima 38 pripadnika partizanskog pokreta, nosilaca Partizanske spomenice 1941, među kojima je i narodna heroina Olga Jovičić Rita. Celina Mihajla Dimitrića iz 1976. obuhvata pojedinačne grobnice i monumentalni ulaz sa medaljonom Antuna Augustinčića.
opis.en: An alley containing the remains of 38 members of the Partisan movement awarded the Partisan Commemorative Medal of 1941, including People’s Hero Olga Jovičić Rita. Mihajlo Dimitrić’s ensemble of 1976 comprises individual tombs and a monumental entrance with a medallion by Antun Augustinčić.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnim herojima [Dragoslavu Bogavcu](Q31181554), [Radu Vilotijeviću Vići](Q31181083) i [Olgi Jovičić Riti](Q4205868), učesnicima NOB. Njihove biste nalaze se u Parku heroja.
opis.en: Dedicated to People’s Heroes [Dragoslav Bogavac](Q31181554), [Rade Vilotijević Vića](Q31181083) and [Olga Jovičić Rita](Q4205868), participants in the Partisan struggle. Their busts stand in Heroes’ Park.

opis.sh: Posvećeno civilima koje su nemačke okupacione snage streljale u [masakru u Kraljevu](Q12958349) oktobra 1941. godine. Memorijal je uređen na mestu streljanja i sahranjivanja talaca.
opis.en: Dedicated to civilians executed by German occupation forces in the [Kraljevo massacre](Q12958349) in October 1941. The memorial occupies the site where the hostages were shot and buried.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašizma; Dolinarove figure postavljene su 1950. u Jajincima, a 1959. prenesene u Kraljevo.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fallen fighters and victims of fascism; Dolinar's figures were first erected at Jajinci in 1950 and moved to Kraljevo in 1959.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima NOVJ i Crvene armije koji su od 16. oktobra do 29. novembra 1944. oslobađali Kraljevo; poginulo je 357 crvenoarmejaca i 45 partizana.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisans and Red Army soldiers who liberated Kraljevo between 16 October and 29 November 1944; 357 Red Army soldiers and 45 Partisans were killed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno streljanim radnicima Fabrike vagona.
opis.en: Dedicated to executed workers of the wagon factory.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Filipu Dolencu na Orehku.
opis.en: Dedicated to Filip Dolenc at Orehek.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Ivu Slavcu Joklu u Struževu.
opis.en: Dedicated to Ivo Slavec Jokl in Struževo.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim radnicima fabrike Tekstilindus.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen workers of the Tekstilindus factory.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palima u Šorlijevom mlinu.
opis.en: Dedicated to those killed at Šorli mill.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Ivanu Slavcu Joklu u Struževu.
opis.en: Dedicated to Ivan Slavec Jokl in Struževo.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Jožetu Žanu i štampariji „Tehnika“.
opis.en: Dedicated to Jože Žan and the "Tehnika" printing house.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim u NOB, na Kendovoj kući.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in WWII, on the Kenda house.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palima u NOB iz Stražišča.
opis.en: Dedicated to those from Stražišče killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama NOB iz porodice Jelenc.
opis.en: Dedicated to WWII victims of the Jelenc family.

opis.sh: Posvećeno 135 žrtava Drugog svetskog rata; središnji deo parka je na grobištu 60 žrtava fašizma.
opis.en: Dedicated to 135 victims of WWII; the central part of the park lies on the burial ground of 60 victims of fascism.

krapinske-toplice.adresa: U središtu naselja, kod bolničkog kompleksa

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašizma; Augustinčićeva skulptura „Nošenje ranjenika“ prikazuje dvojicu boraca koji nose ranjenog druga. Postavljena je u središtu Krapinskih Toplica 1973. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to victims of fascism; Augustinčić’s sculpture “Carrying the Wounded” depicts two fighters carrying a wounded comrade. It was installed in central Krapinske Toplice in 1973.

opis.sh: Posvećeno vatrogascima palim u NOB.
opis.en: Dedicated to firefighters killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Spomen-česma Bogomiru Karaklajiću podignuta je 1950. Obnovljena je 1982, kada je dodata ploča palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora.
opis.en: The memorial fountain to Bogomir Karaklajić was erected in 1950. It was renovated in 1982, when a plaque to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror was added.

opis.sh: Na mestu smrti Trivuna Bojanovića.
opis.en: At the place where Trivun Bojanović died.

opis.sh: Obeležava prelaz preko Save za borce NOV i aktiviste OF, poginule pri prelascima i trojicu aktivista ubijenih 20. septembra 1944. godine.
opis.en: Marks the Sava crossing used by Partisan fighters and Liberation Front activists, those killed during crossings and three activists killed on 20 September 1944.

kriskovci-spomenik-palim-borcima.adresa: Između osnovne škole i pošte; susedno obeležje ratu 1992-1995 je zasebno.

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto streljanja braće Đurić. Prvobitno obeležje od cigle, podignuto pre 1960, zamenjeno je novim 1985; deo starog postolja ostao je iza njega.
opis.en: Marks the execution site of the Đurić brothers. The original brick memorial, erected before 1960, was replaced in 1985; part of its old base remained behind the replacement.

kriva-palanka-spomenik-vera-jocik.adresa: Пред општинската зграда, ул. Св. Јоаким Осоговски 175

kriva-planaka.adresa: Пред општинската зграда, ул. Св. Јоаким Осоговски 175

krivaca-spomenik-pernicka-cuprija.adresa: Na obali Spreče, kod Pijerničke ćuprije u Krivači

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima poginulim 20. januara 1944. kod Perničke ćuprije. Na ploči je navedena godina podizanja 1987, ali datum njene kasnije zamene nije utvrđen.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed near Pernička Ćuprija on 20 January 1944. The plaque gives 1987 as the monument’s erection date, but the date of its later replacement has not been established.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašizma u Križu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of fascism in Križ.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i spaljenom selu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and the burned village.

kropa.autor: Albert Sušnik & Marija Keržič & Stane Keržič

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Ozrenskog partizanskog odreda.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters of the Ozren Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žiteljima Krupišta koje su nemački okupatori streljali u oktobru 1944.
opis.en: Dedicated to the residents of Krupište shot by the German occupiers in October 1944.

opis.sh: Memorijalni kompleks „Crna kuća“ čuva sećanje na zatočenike logora Kruščica iz 1941. Obuhvata kuću, grobnicu, skulpturu Fadila Bilića iz 1974. i ploče; muzejska namena kuće nije u funkciji, a zavod je zabeležio ozbiljna oštećenja i potrebu zabrane ulaska.
opis.en: The Black House memorial complex commemorates the prisoners of the 1941 Kruščica camp. It includes the house, a collective grave, Fadil Bilić’s 1974 sculpture and plaques; the house no longer functions as a museum, and the heritage authority recorded serious damage and the need to prohibit entry.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama streljanja na Slobodištu, gde su nemački okupatori tokom rata ubili oko 1.650 ljudi, uglavnom partizana, četnika i njihovih pristalica i Roma.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the executions at Slobodište, where the German occupiers killed about 1,650 people during the war, mostly Partisans, Chetniks and their supporters, and Roma.

opis.sh: Spomen-ploča je posvećena [15. makedonskoj narodnooslobodilačkoj udarnoj brigadi](Q3402609).
opis.en: The plaque is dedicated to the [15th Macedonian People’s Liberation Assault Brigade](Q3402609).

opis.sh: Posvećeno dvadesetorici palih boraca.
opis.en: Dedicated to 20 fallen fighters.

opis.sh: Posvećeno učesnicima [Ilindenskog ustanka](Q1145682) 1903. i partizanima u Makedoniji; otvoren 2. avgusta 1974, na 30. godišnjicu zasedanja ASNOM-a.
opis.en: Dedicated to the participants of the 1903 [Ilinden Uprising](Q1145682) and to the Partisans in Macedonia; opened on 2 August 1974, the 30th anniversary of the ASNOM assembly.

opis.sh: Partizanski grobovi u Aleji velikana sa 20 boraca NOVJ iz Kruševa i okolnih sela; na centralnim pločama su imena 72 pala borca, među njima narodnog heroja Manču Mataka.
opis.en: Partisan graves in the Avenue of Greats with 20 Partisans from Kruševo and nearby villages; the central plaques list 72 fallen fighters, including people's hero Manču Matak.

krusevo-zgrada-na-muzejot-na-nov.adresa: Гумење, во близина на споменикот Илинден

opis.sh: Muzej na Gumenju čuva predmete, oružje i dokumente o partizanskom pokretu u kruševskom kraju, uz veliki mural Borka Lazeskog. Poseta se najavljuje unapred.
opis.en: The museum at Gumenje preserves objects, weapons and documents about the Partisan movement in the Kruševo area, alongside a large mural by Borko Lazeski. Visits require advance arrangement.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora iz Krvavaca i okolnih sela. Celinu čine spomen-zid sa imenima stradalih i bista narodnog heroja.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror from Krvavci and neighbouring villages. The site comprises a memorial wall listing the fallen and a bust of a People’s Hero.

opis.sh: Posvećeno građanima Kucure poginulim u Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to citizens of Kucura killed in the Second World War.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima Narodnooslobodilačkog rata palim za slobodu; spomenik je na Trgu oslobođenja.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters of the People's Liberation War who fell for freedom; the monument stands on Liberation Square.

kula-spomenik-na-mestu-pogibije-ise-seki.adresa: Uz put Kula–Lipar (Bajšanski put), desno u pravcu Lipara

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Isi Sekickom](Q61131690), koji je u septembru 1943. poginuo štiteći povlačenje drugova iz diverzantske grupe. Spomenik je podignut 1973. na mestu njegove pogibije uz put iz Kule prema Liparu.
opis.en: Dedicated to [Isa Sekicki](Q61131690), killed in September 1943 while covering the retreat of comrades from his sabotage group. The monument was erected in 1973 at the site of his death beside the road from Kula to Lipar.

opis.sh: Česma iz 1974. posvećena je žrtvama iz Kuljana i okolnih sela ubijenim 22. decembra 1943. Obnovljena je 2012, kada je zamenjena ploča.
opis.en: The 1974 fountain commemorates victims from Kuljan and neighbouring villages killed on 22 December 1943. It was restored in 2012, when its plaque was replaced.

opis.sh: Spomen-kuća komandanta kumanovskog bataljona „Jordan Nikolov Orce“ Hristijana Todorovskog Karpoša, ubijenog 7. februara 1944. u napadu na bugarsko uporište u Biljači. Danas je muzej u sastavu NU Muzej Kumanovo i kulturno nasleđe Makedonije.
opis.en: Memorial house of Hristijan Todorovski Karpoš, commander of the Kumanovo battalion “Jordan Nikolov Orce”, killed on 7 February 1944 in the attack on the Bulgarian stronghold at Biljača. It is now a museum of the Kumanovo Museum and part of Macedonia’s cultural heritage.

opis.sh: Posvećeno pobedi nad fašizmom i borbi makedonskog naroda u NOB. Žena sa podignutim vencem, delo Koste Angelija Radovanija, simbol je Kumanova.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victory over fascism and the struggle of the Macedonian people in WWII. Kosta Angeli Radovani's woman holding up a wreath is a symbol of Kumanovo.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borbi makedonskog naroda za slobodu, uključujući narodnooslobodilačku borbu. Celinu čine stilizovana figura „Makedonka“ i tri reljefna zida sa prizorima Ilindanskog ustanka, ratnog otpora i posleratne obnove.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Macedonian people’s struggle for freedom, including the Partisan liberation struggle. The ensemble consists of the stylised “Macedonian Woman” figure and three relief walls depicting the Ilinden Uprising, wartime resistance and postwar reconstruction.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borbi Pohorske čete.
opis.en: Dedicated to the battle of the Pohorje Company.

kumrovec-spomenik-josipu-brozu-titu.slikaPotpis: Janez Novak, Ljubljana, Slovenija, CC BY-SA 3.0

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima NOB iz Kupinovca.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen WWII fighters from Kupinovac.

opis.sh: Bista ispred zgrade osnovne škole koja je nosila njeno ime, postavljena 1978. godine.
opis.en: A bust installed in 1978 in front of the primary school that bore her name.

opis.sh: Dve spomen-ploče na Domu kulture posvećene meštanima palim u NOB, najviše u završnim operacijama i na Sremskom frontu.
opis.en: Two memorial plaques on the cultural center dedicated to locals killed in WWII, most of them in the final operations and on the Syrmian Front.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Svrljiškom partizanskom odredu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Svrljig Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašizma u Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascism in WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno pilotima 421. jurišnog puka NOVJ i 165. eskadrile Crvene armije poginulim na aerodromu Laćarak u proboju Sremskog fronta. Krilo aviona podignuto je 2013.
opis.en: Dedicated to pilots of the Partisan 421st Assault Regiment and the Red Army's 165th Squadron killed at Laćarak airfield during the Syrmian Front breakthrough. The aircraft wing was erected in 2013.

opis.sh: Spomenik palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora otkriven je 21. juna 1959. Obnovljen je 2016; u istom prostoru nalazi se i zasebno obeležje ratu 1992-1995.
opis.en: The memorial to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror was unveiled on 21 June 1959. It was restored in 2016; a separate memorial to the 1992-1995 war shares the site.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Prve krajiške proleterske brigade.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters of the 1st Krajina Proletarian Brigade.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnim herojima [Bori Vukmiroviću](Q1562871) i [Ramizu Sadiku](Q1568696), koji su ovde ubijeni 10. aprila 1943. i postali simbol zajedničke borbe Srba i Albanaca. Spomenik je srušen 1999, a na njegovom mestu je groblje boraca OVK.
opis.en: Dedicated to People's Heroes [Boro Vukmirović](Q1562871) and [Ramiz Sadiku](Q1568696), killed here on 10 April 1943, who became a symbol of the joint struggle of Serbs and Albanians. The memorial was demolished in 1999 and a KLA fighters' cemetery now occupies the site.

landovica.autor: Miodrag Pecić & Svetomir Arsić & Hilmija Ćatović

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Primorsko-goranske brigade.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters of the Primorje-Gorski Kotar Brigade.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Antonu Rasporu, borcu u Španiji i prvoborcu NOR-a.
opis.en: Dedicated to Anton Raspor, a veteran of the Spanish Civil War and a 1941 Partisan.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama spaljivanja sela od strane okupatora i palim pripadnicima NOP-a iz Ledinaca. Buktinja Pavla Radovanovića postavljena je 1973.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the burning of the village by the occupiers and to fallen local members of the liberation movement. Pavle Radovanović's torch was erected in 1973.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima Prvog pohorskog bataljona.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters of the 1st Pohorje Battalion.

lepetane.adresa: Na zidu uz stari put na Verigama, na tivatskoj strani moreuza

opis.sh: Posvećeno Marku Lukšiću, Matu Nikoliću, Bogdanu Raduloviću i Andriji Svilanoviću, streljanim 16. jula 1942. posle diverzije u italijanskom magacinu municije. Prema opštinskom registru obeležje je podignuto 1953, a ploča obnovljena 29. novembra 1984.
opis.en: Dedicated to Marko Lukšić, Mato Nikolić, Bogdan Radulović and Andrija Svilanović, executed on 16 July 1942 after sabotaging an Italian ammunition depot. The municipal register dates the memorial to 1953 and the renewed plaque to 29 November 1984.

lepetani-spomenik-poginulim-borcima.adresa: U dvorištu bivše vojne kasarne; prema katalogu iz 2019. pristup je ograničen odobrenjem

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima NOR-a. Spomenik je podignut 22. decembra 1959. u krugu vojne kasarne.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fallen fighters of the People’s Liberation War. The monument was erected on 22 December 1959 within the military barracks.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama [ustaškog logora Lepoglava](Q1562273) i poginulim partizanima. Memorijalno groblje čine kamena obeležja sa imenima žrtava oko apstraktne aluminijumske skulpture Stevana Luketića.
opis.en: Dedicated to victims of the [Ustaša concentration camp at Lepoglava](Q1562273) and fallen Partisans. The memorial cemetery consists of stone markers bearing victims’ names around Stevan Luketić’s abstract aluminium sculpture.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Četvrtoj crnogorskoj brigadi, koja je ovde vodila značajne borbe.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 4th Montenegrin Brigade, which fought important battles here.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim radnicima fabrike Veriga.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen workers of the Veriga factory.

opis.sh: Posvećeno osnivanju okružnog odbora Osvobodilne fronte Stična.
opis.en: Dedicated to the founding of the Stična district Liberation Front committee.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima NOVJ i žrtvama fašizma iz leskovačkog kraja poginulim u Drugom svetskom ratu; spomen-park je na brdu Hisar.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Partisan fighters and victims of fascism from the Leskovac area who died in World War II; the memorial park is on Hisar Hill.

leskovac-bista-blagoja-kostica.adresa: Na trgu u Podvrcu, mesna zajednica „Marko Crni“

opis.sh: Bista narodnog heroja Blagoja Kostića u Podvrcu, delo Dušana Nikolića, otkrivena 9. oktobra 1953.
opis.en: Bust of people's hero Blagoje Kostić in Podvrce, by Dušan Nikolić, unveiled on 9 October 1953.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Mari Đorđević Ćućuliki, tekstilnoj radnici, članu Okružnog komiteta KPJ i sekretaru partijske ćelije u štofari. Bista je otkrivena 6. jula 1984. povodom stogodišnjice leskovačke tekstilne industrije.
opis.en: Dedicated to Mara Đorđević Ćućulika, a textile worker, district Communist Party committee member and secretary of the factory’s Party cell. The bust was unveiled on 6 July 1984 for the centenary of Leskovac’s textile industry.

leskovac-bista-milentija-popovica.adresa: U međublokovskoj zelenoj površini u naselju Dubočica
leskovac-bista-milentija-popovica.slikaPotpis: Ekipa Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

leskovac-bista-milice-pavlovic.adresa: Ispred Škole za tekstil i dizajn

leskovac-bista-slavke-nedic-milojevic.adresa: U dvorištu Doma učenika srednjih škola, Kajmakčalanska 24
leskovac-bista-slavke-nedic-milojevic.slikaPotpis: Ekipa Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju [Stanimiru Veljkoviću Zeletu](Q16380587); bista u krugu istoimene fabrike otkrivena je 7. jula 1954. Drugi primerak nalazi se u dvorištu Gimnazije.
opis.en: Dedicated to People’s Hero [Stanimir Veljković Zele](Q16380587); the bust at the factory named after him was unveiled on 7 July 1954. Another cast stands in the grammar school courtyard.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju [Stanimiru Veljkoviću Zeletu](Q16380587), omladinskom rukovodiocu i učesniku NOB-a. Bista u dvorištu Gimnazije otkrivena je 1953; drugi primerak nalazi se u nekadašnjoj fabrici „Zele Veljković“.
opis.en: Dedicated to People’s Hero [Stanimir Veljković Zele](Q16380587), a youth organiser and Partisan. The bust in the grammar school courtyard was unveiled in 1953; another cast stands at the former “Zele Veljković” factory.

leskovac-bista-stojana-ljubica.adresa: U Gradskom parku u centru Leskovca

opis.sh: Bista narodnog heroja [Stojana Ljubića](Q16087089), delo Dušana Nikolića, otkrivena 8. oktobra 1953. u parku.
opis.en: Bust of people's hero [Stojan Ljubić](Q16087089) by Dušan Nikolić, unveiled in the park on 8 October 1953.

opis.sh: Bista Vlade Đorđevića, postavljena 2. avgusta 1953. u parku 9 Jugovića na Hisaru.
opis.en: Bust of Vlada Đorđević, erected on 2 August 1953 in the Nine Jugović Park on Hisar.

opis.sh: Posvećeno 500 rodoljuba, među njima 320 Roma, koje su nemački fašisti streljali u Arapovoj dolini 11. decembra 1941. Kameni blokovi predstavljaju streljane poređane u stroj.
opis.en: Dedicated to 500 patriots, including 320 Roma, shot by the Germans in Arapova Dolina on 11 December 1941. The stone blocks represent the victims lined up for execution.

leskovac-gimnazija-memorijalni-reljef.slikaPotpis: Ivana Cvetković, Zavod za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju [Stanimiru Veljkoviću Zeletu](Q16380587). Kompoziciju u holu gimnazije čine veliki metalni reljef sa borcima i mermerna ploča sa njegovim portretom.
opis.en: Dedicated to National Hero [Stanimir Veljković Zele](Q16380587). The composition in the grammar school entrance hall consists of a large metal relief depicting fighters and a marble panel bearing his portrait.

opis.sh: Bista Blagoja Nikolića, delo Dušana Nikolića, podignuta 2. avgusta 1953. na Hisaru.
opis.en: Bust of Blagoje Nikolić by Dušan Nikolić, erected on Hisar on 2 August 1953.

opis.sh: Bista narodnog heroja i rukovodioca radničkog pokreta [Koste Stamenkovića](Q13639018) iz 1951. na brdu Hisar.
opis.en: Bust of people's hero and workers' movement leader [Kosta Stamenković](Q13639018) from 1951 on Hisar hill.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borbi partizana protiv nemačkih, bugarskih i četničkih snaga na Bratujevcu 1. oktobra 1943.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Partisans' battle against German, Bulgarian and Chetnik forces at Bratujevac on 1 October 1943.

opis.sh: Spomen-kuća narodnog heroja [Koste Stamenkovića](Q13639018), pod upravom Narodnog muzeja Leskovca.
opis.en: Memorial house of people's hero [Kosta Stamenković](Q13639018), managed by the Leskovac National Museum.

leskovac-spomen-cesma-u-leskovcu.adresa: Svetoilijska 1, ispred apoteke „Sutjeska“, leva obala Veternice

opis.sh: Posvećeno Leskovčanima stradalim u dva bombardovanja grada 1941. i 1944; otkrivena 6. septembra 1991.
opis.en: Dedicated to Leskovac residents killed in the two bombings of the town in 1941 and 1944; unveiled on 6 September 1991.

leskovac-spomen-cesma-u-leskovcu.autor: Vasilije Milunović & Nikola Milunović & Đorđe Stanković

leskovac-spomenik.adresa: Kod ulaza u leskovački aerodrom, Vinarce

opis.sh: Posvećeno napadu 11. srpske udarne brigade na leskovački aerodrom 2. juna 1944. Betonski spomenik Miodraga Stevanovića u obliku oborenog aviona podignut je 1975.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 11th Serbian Assault Brigade’s attack on Leskovac airfield on 2 June 1944. Miodrag Stevanović’s concrete monument, shaped like a downed aircraft, was erected in 1975.

leskovac-spomenik-kosti-stamenkovicu.adresa: U Gradskom parku u centru Leskovca

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju [Kosti Stamenkoviću](Q13639018); statua Dušana Nikolića u Gradskom parku otkrivena je 11. oktobra 1988.
opis.en: Dedicated to People’s Hero [Kosta Stamenković](Q13639018); Dušan Nikolić’s statue in the City Park was unveiled on 11 October 1988.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palima u oslobodilačkim ratovima 1912-1918 i 1941-1945.
opis.en: Dedicated to those who fell in the liberation wars of 1912-1918 and 1941-1945.

opis.sh: Posvećeno trinaestorici boraca Kokrškog odreda.
opis.en: Dedicated to thirteen fighters of the Kokra Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Kokrške čete.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters of the Kokra Company.

opis.sh: Spomen-kompleks Svetislava Ličine sa pločom sa imenima stradalih žitelja Ležimira u Drugom svetskom ratu i bronzanom skulpturom muškarca i deteta Pavla Radovanovića.
opis.en: Memorial complex by Svetislav Ličina with a plaque bearing the names of Ležimir residents killed in WWII and Pavle Radovanović's bronze sculpture of a man and a child.

lijesanj-spomen-kosturnica.adresa: Dvorište nekadašnje škole, danas planinarskog doma Grkinja

opis.sh: Kosturnica iz 1983. nalazi se u dvorištu nekadašnje škole, danas planinarskog doma Grkinja. Godine 2022. dodata je ploča za rat 1992–1995, uz sačuvano obeležje NOB.
opis.en: The 1983 ossuary stands in the yard of the former school, now Grkinja mountain lodge. A plaque to the 1992–1995 war was added in 2022 alongside the surviving WWII memorial.

opis.sh: Spomenik južno od Doma kulture posvećen je palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora. Prema katalogu predstavlja noviju zamenu za ranija obeležja u selu.
opis.en: The memorial south of the community hall commemorates fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror. The catalogue describes it as a later replacement for earlier village memorials.

lijeva-rijeka-spomen-park.adresa: Uz groblje kod crkve, u centru sela

opis.sh: Posvećeno učesnicima oslobodilačkih ratova, sa posebnim delom za NOB i kosturnicom palih boraca. Terasasti kompleks, preuređen 1981, obuhvata spomenike, ploče i biste [Miladina Popovića](Q10992018) i [Sava Orovića](Q4337012).
opis.en: Dedicated to participants in the wars of liberation, with a section devoted to the Partisan struggle and an ossuary for fallen fighters. The terraced complex, redesigned in 1981, includes monuments, plaques and busts of [Miladin Popović](Q10992018) and [Savo Orović](Q4337012).

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašističkog terora od 30. aprila 1944.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of fascist terror of 30 April 1944.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Drugoj krajiškoj brigadi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 2nd Krajina Brigade.

opis.sh: Kosturnica Nikole Krstičevića podignuta je 1950, a groblje prošireno dodatnim sahranama 1957. Nalazi se uz osnovnu školu i obuhvata grobove najmanje 70 palih boraca.
opis.en: Nikola Krstičević’s ossuary was erected in 1950, with additional burials in 1957. The cemetery stands beside the elementary school and contains the graves of at least 70 fallen fighters.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašističkog terora u Gornjem Dragonošcu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of fascist terror in Gornji Dragonožec.

opis.sh: Kameni beleg na Obloj glavi označava mesto formiranja Ozrenskog partizanskog odreda.
opis.en: The stone marker at Obla Glava marks the formation site of the Ozren Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Obeležje iz 1988. u Lipovcu vezuje se za borbu partizanskih i četničkih snaga. Ploča i drugi memorijalni elementi nedostaju; veza sa starijim obeležjima dvadeset sedmorici boraca nije potvrđena.
opis.en: The 1988 Lipovac memorial is associated with fighting between partisan and Chetnik forces. Its plaque and other commemorative elements are missing; its relationship to earlier memorials to twenty-seven fighters is unconfirmed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palima u NOB iz Makoša.
opis.en: Dedicated to those from Makoše killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Moslavačkom partizanskom odredu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Moslavina Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Memorijalno groblje završeno je 1972, posle radova započetih 1964-1965. Poslednji opisani pregled beleži zapuštenost, grafite i polomljene ili nestale nadgrobne oznake.
opis.en: The memorial cemetery was completed in 1972 after construction began in 1964-1965. The latest described survey records neglect, graffiti and broken or missing grave markers.

opis.sh: Spomenik žrtvama fašističkog terora iz 1959. obnovljen je i obložen crnim kamenom, sa krstom na vrhu. Promenjeni izgled ne označava zaseban spomenik novijem ratu.
opis.en: The 1959 memorial to victims of fascist terror was restored with black stone cladding and a cross on top. Its altered appearance does not make it a separate memorial to a later war.

opis.sh: Posvećeno ljiškoj borbi 1941. Bronzani partizan bombaš Ota Loga postavljen je 1981. na ulazu u Ljig.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 1941 Battle of Ljig. Oto Logo's bronze Partisan grenadier was erected at the entrance to Ljig in 1981.

opis.sh: Posvećeno formiranju bataljona „Simo Šolaja“. Ploča iz 1952. je sačuvana, dok je postament znatno nagrižen.
opis.en: Dedicated to the formation of the Simo Šolaja Battalion. The 1952 plaque survives, while its base is heavily weathered.

opis.sh: Posvećeno 14. srednjobosanskoj brigadi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 14th Central Bosnian Brigade.

opis.sh: Posvećeno rudarima poginulim u NOB i 20. godišnjici rudarskog štrajka.
opis.en: Dedicated to miners killed in the People's Liberation Struggle and to 20th anniversary of the miners' strike.

opis.sh: Posvećeno pobedi partizana i socijalističkoj revoluciji u Drugom svetskom ratu. Bronzana kompozicija na Trgu republike prikazuje zbijene ljudske figure.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Partisan victory and socialist revolution during the Second World War. The bronze composition on Republic Square depicts densely grouped human figures.

opis.sh: Posvećeno 124 taoca koje su italijanski, a zatim nemački okupator streljali u Gramoznoj jami.
opis.en: Dedicated to 124 hostages executed in the gravel pit first by the Italian and then by the German occupiers.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnim herojima sahranjenim u grobnici ispred Narodnog muzeja Slovenije; na sarkofagu su reljefi iz Narodnooslobodilačke borbe i stihovi Otona Župančiča.
opis.en: Dedicated to the People's Heroes buried in the tomb in front of the National Museum of Slovenia; the sarcophagus bears reliefs from the liberation war and verses by Oton Župančič.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim u NOB: obelisk Antona Bitenca sa imenima palih meštana i bronzana Pobeda Boža Pengova iz 1949. Ceo park je premešten 2007.
opis.en: Dedicated to those killed in WWII: Anton Bitenc's obelisk with the names of fallen locals and Božo Pengov's bronze Victory from 1949. The whole park was relocated in 2007.

opis.en: Freedom Monument dedicated to WWII, at Celovška cesta 150.

opis.en: Dedicated to the hostages executed in Rožna Dolina.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašističkog pokolja na Vrhovcima.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the fascist massacre at Vrhovci.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama NOB iz Sneberja.
opis.en: Dedicated to WWII victims from Sneberje.

opis.sh: Tiskarna Podmornica bila je uređena kao Muzej štampe NOB.
opis.en: The Podmornica Printing Press formerly housed the National Liberation War Printing Museum.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju [Tonetu Tomšiču](Q350128); kip Borisa Kalina iz 1957. prvi je spomenik pojedinom narodnom heroju u Ljubljani.
opis.en: Dedicated to people's hero [Tone Tomšič](Q350128); Boris Kalin's 1957 statue was the first monument to an individual people's hero in Ljubljana.

ljubljana-zale-spominski-park-borcev-in-.adresa: Pokopališče Žale, ob Tomačevski cesti, oddelek TAL

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima NOB, streljanim taocima i drugim žrtvama okupacije. Memorijalna celina na Žalama obuhvata grobna polja i spomenike nastale u više faza od 1955.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan fighters, executed hostages and other victims of the occupation. The memorial area at Žale comprises burial grounds and monuments created in several phases from 1955 onwards.

opis.sh: Spomenik iz 1958. ispred železničke stanice, posvećen štrajku železničara aprila 1920. i železničarima palim u NOB.
opis.en: Monument from 1958 in front of the railway station, dedicated to the railway workers' strike of April 1920 and railway workers killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Spomenik žrtvama i grobnica boraca.
opis.en: Monument to the victims and tomb of fighters.

opis.sh: U kosturnici su posmrtni ostaci 78 palih boraca i tri narodna heroja.
opis.en: The ossuary contains the remains of 78 fallen fighters and three National Heroes.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama racije u Loku.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the raid in Lok.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Lovrencu Koncilji i Janezu Maksu Kodru.
opis.en: Dedicated to Lovrenc Koncilja and Janez Maks Koder.

opis.sh: Posvećeno 14. brigadi „Garibaldi“.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 14th "Garibaldi" Brigade.

lokva-rogoznica-spomenik-palim-borcima.adresa: Uz cestu, desno od nekadašnje zgrade mjesne zajednice

opis.sh: Bronzana figura gologlavog muškarca stisnutih šaka simbolizuje otpor okupatoru, bez uobičajenih obeležja partizana. Delo mesnog vajara Joka Kneževića, liveno u ljevaonici Likum u Zagrebu, ubraja se među istaknutije spomenike palim borcima u Dalmaciji.
opis.en: A bronze figure of a bare-headed man with clenched fists symbolises resistance to the occupiers, without the usual Partisan attributes. The work of local sculptor Joko Knežević, cast at the Likum foundry in Zagreb, it is counted among the more notable monuments to fallen fighters in Dalmatia.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Mornaričkom odredu Koper.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Koper Naval Detachment.

opis.sh: Spomen-soba u vodenici u znak sećanja na 26 omladinaca i dece koje su nemačke snage žive spalile.
opis.en: A memorial room in a watermill commemorating 26 youths and children burned alive by German forces.

opis.sh: Celina obuhvata partizansko spomen-groblje i nekadašnji Muzej NOB Birač kod manastira Lovnice.
opis.en: The site comprises a Partisan memorial cemetery and the former Birač National Liberation Struggle Museum at Lovnica Monastery.

opis.sh: Grobni spomenik sa posmrtnim ostacima i imenima boraca NOB poginulih u Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Tomb monument holding the remains and names of fighters killed in WWII.

lozovac-spomenik-palim-radnicima-tvornic.adresa: Predio Vrh Brine, Novo naselje, lijevo od ceste prema Slapovima Krke

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim radnicima Fabrike aluminijuma.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen workers of the aluminium factory.

lozovac-tromilja-spomenik-palim-borcima-.adresa: Tromilja na putovima Šibenik–Drniš i Šibenik–Skradin

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora iz Lozovca, Gradine, Konjevrata, Čvrljeva, Goriša i Brnjice. Kompleks obuhvata bronzanu figuru borca Antuna Jovića i memorijalni zid Vlade Petkovića.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror from Lozovac, Gradina, Konjevrate, Čvrljevo, Goriš and Brnjica. The complex comprises a bronze fighter by Antun Jović and a memorial wall by Vlade Petković.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Lozovika i crvenoarmejcima poginulim na području naselja 1944. godine. Spomenik je otkriven u avgustu 1945; iz sela je poginulo deset meštana u partizanskim jedinicama, a na ovom području 68 boraca NOVJ.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters from Lozovik and Red Army soldiers killed in the village area in 1944. The monument was unveiled in August 1945; ten villagers died in Partisan units and 68 Yugoslav Partisan fighters were killed in the area.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima NOB, internircima i taocima.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen WWII fighters, internees and hostages.

opis.sh: Posvećeno 17. udarnoj brigadi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 17th Assault Brigade.
