opis.sh: Grobnica boraca Osme vojvođanske udarne brigade poginulih za oslobođenje Luga 1944.
opis.en: Tomb of fighters of the 8th Vojvodina Assault Brigade killed in the liberation of Lug in 1944.

lug-spomen-ploca-klajo-imri.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

opis.sh: Posvećeno Dragoljubu Bešliću, komandiru Račanske čete, i Aliji Akanoviću, komandiru voda, poginulim januara 1942. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to Dragoljub Bešlić, commander of the Rača Company, and Alija Akanović, a platoon commander, killed in January 1942.

opis.sh: Posvećeno bosanskim izbeglicama preminulim 1942. godine u logoru na području Bajine Bašte.
opis.en: Dedicated to Bosnian refugees who died in 1942 in a camp in the Bajina Bašta area.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim učesnicima Narodnooslobodilačkog rata u Lukavcu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen participants in the People's Liberation War in Lukavac.

lukavac-djuro-pucar-stari.adresa: Plato ispred Doma kulture u Lukavcu

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju [Đuri Pucaru Starom](Q6590585), jednom od organizatora ustanka u Bosni i Hercegovini. Bista je 2016. pomerena unutar platoa ispred Doma kulture, gde je fotografisana u oktobru 2018. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to National Hero [Đuro Pucar Stari](Q6590585), one of the organizers of the uprising in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The bust was moved within the square in front of the Cultural Centre in 2016 and photographed there in October 2018.

opis.sh: Posvećeno pesniku i partizanu [Ivanu Goranu Kovačiću](Q835790), rođenom u Lukovdolu i ubijenom 1943. Apstraktni portret Vojina Bakića od nerđajućeg čelika postavljen je 1964. uz pesnikovu rodnu kuću, u okviru prostora sa amfiteatrom.
opis.en: Dedicated to the poet and Partisan [Ivan Goran Kovačić](Q835790), born in Lukovdol and killed in 1943. Vojin Bakić’s abstract stainless-steel portrait was erected in 1964 beside the poet’s birthplace within a setting that includes an amphitheatre.

opis.sh: Rodna kuća [Ivana Gorana Kovačića](Q835790) čuva sećanje na pesnika i partizana, autora poeme „Jama“, ubijenog 1943. Muzejska postavka prikazuje njegov život, književni rad i zavičaj.
opis.en: The birthplace of [Ivan Goran Kovačić](Q835790) commemorates the poet and Partisan, author of “The Pit”, who was killed in 1943. The exhibition presents his life, literary work and home region.

opis.sh: Posvećeno 350 boraca poginulih u Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to 350 fighters killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno seljacima koji su u NOB skrivali i hranili partizane; otkriven je 6. jula 1979. u Lunjevačkoj šumi i obnovljen 2025.
opis.en: Dedicated to the peasants who hid and fed the Partisans during WWII; unveiled on 6 July 1979 in Lunjevac forest and restored in 2025.

opis.sh: Dom je podignut u znak sećanja na poginule partizanske borce sa područja Lušci Palanke. Memorijalna posveta zgrade potvrđena je u vodiču spomenika revolucije iz 1986.
opis.en: The hall was built in memory of fallen Partisan fighters from the Lušci Palanka area. Its memorial dedication is documented in the 1986 guide to monuments of the revolution.

opis.sh: Kosturnica 37 palih boraca.
opis.en: Ossuary of 37 fallen fighters.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim u balkanskim ratovima, Prvom i Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in the Balkan Wars, WWI and WWII.

opis.sh: Spomenik za 66 žrtava fašističkog terora podignut je pre 1960. Obnovljen je između 2014. i 2021, uz krst i dodatnu ploču posvećenu ratu 1992–1995.
opis.en: The memorial to 66 victims of fascist terror was erected before 1960. It was restored between 2014 and 2021 with a cross and an additional plaque commemorating the 1992–1995 war.

luzani-spomen-cesma-palim-borcima.autor: Cvijetin Lukić & Milan Marjanović & Stanko Stanojević

opis.sh: Posvećeno osnivanju seoskog narodnooslobodilačkog odbora.
opis.en: Dedicated to the founding of the village liberation committee.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju Tomi Ivanoviću Mačkatovcu.
opis.en: Dedicated to people's hero Toma Ivanović Mačkatovac.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju Tomi Ivanoviću Mačkatovcu.
opis.en: Dedicated to people's hero Toma Ivanović Mačkatovac.

mackatica-spomen-kompleks.adresa: Južno od groblja, kod crkve i nekadašnje škole

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima i ratnicima iz Mačkatice, uključujući žrtve Drugog svetskog rata. Celina obuhvata spomenik, česmu iz 1978. i biste [Tome Ivanovića Mačkatovca](Q20435567) i Bore Stamenkovića Leke.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and soldiers from Mačkatica, including those killed in the Second World War. The site comprises a monument, a fountain from 1978 and busts of [Toma Ivanović Mačkatovac](Q20435567) and Bora Stamenković Leka.

opis.sh: Spomen-park iz 1954. obuhvata kosturnicu vojvođanskih boraca, stepeništa sa grobnim obeležjima i spomen-česmu. Glavna ploča posvećena je sedamdeset sedmorici boraca vojvođanskih brigada.
opis.en: The 1954 memorial park includes an ossuary for Vojvodina brigade fighters, stairways lined with grave markers and a memorial fountain. Its main plaque commemorates seventy-seven fighters of the Vojvodina brigades.

opis.sh: Posvećeno oslobodiocima Majdanpeka i borcima i civilima ovog kraja stradalim u narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi. Betonski obelisk Vojislava Vasiljevića podignut je na uzvišenju iznad grada, uz memorijalni zid.
opis.en: Dedicated to the liberators of Majdanpek and to local fighters and civilians who died during the Partisan struggle. Vojislav Vasiljević’s concrete obelisk stands on a hillside above the town, alongside a memorial wall.

majdanpek-bista.adresa: Bista Velimira MarkićevićaMaksa u zgradi osnovne škole koja nosi njegovo ime. Postavljena 1971. godine. Vajar S. Cvetković. Velimir Markićević, pripadnik napredno

opis.sh: Bista u zgradi osnovne škole koja je nosila njegovo ime, postavljena 1971. godine.
opis.en: A bust installed in 1971 inside the primary school that bore his name.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim partizanskim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan fighters and victims of fascist terror.

majske-medje-grob-jovana-lazica.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

majske-medje-spomenik-ferencu-kisu.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

opis.sh: Na mestu pogibije Ferenca Kiša, komandanta 15. vojvođanske udarne brigade „Šandor Petefi“, 21. marta 1945.
opis.en: At the place where Ferenc Kiš, commander of the 15th Vojvodina Assault Brigade "Sándor Petőfi", was killed on 21 March 1945.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama Makarskog primorja stradalim u narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi. Spomenik na Glavici oblikovan je kao memorijalni trg i pozornica sa betonskim paravanima čiji reljefi simbolizuju rat i borbu.
opis.en: Dedicated to victims from the Makarska coast who died during the Partisan struggle. The monument on Glavica Hill forms a memorial square and stage with concrete screens whose reliefs evoke war and resistance.

makarska.autor: Matija Salaj & Šime Vulas & Ante Kuduz

opis.sh: Gradski muzej u palači Tonoli nasledio je Muzej revolucije, čija je postavka prikazivala radnički pokret i narodnooslobodilačku borbu biokovskog područja. Današnji muzej ima šire zavičajne zbirke, pa se stara postavka NOB ne podrazumeva; uslove posete treba proveriti kod muzeja.
opis.en: The City Museum in Tonoli Palace succeeded the Museum of the Revolution, whose exhibition covered the labour movement and Partisan struggle in the Biokovo area. Today’s museum holds broader local-history collections, so the former Partisan exhibition should not be assumed to remain on display; check visiting arrangements with the museum.

makarska-vila-irena-party-school-museum.adresa: Šetalište sv. Petra (nekad Ribarsko šetalište bb), park-šuma Sv. Petar

opis.sh: Posvećeno partijskoj školi CK KPJ, održanoj u vili Irena od 5. septembra do 10. oktobra 1940. Muzej je otvoren u istoj zgradi 24. oktobra 1980; posle raspada Jugoslavije zgrada je prešla u državno vlasništvo i neko vreme služila kao ugostiteljski objekat.
opis.en: Dedicated to the CPY Central Committee party school held at Villa Irena from 5 September to 10 October 1940. The museum opened in the same building on 24 October 1980; after the breakup of Yugoslavia the building passed to the state and for a time served as a catering venue.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim radnicima.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen workers.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [bici za ranjenike na Neretvi](Q127872674) iz februara i marta 1943, kada su partizani uz parolu „Prozor noćas mora pasti!“ štitili 4.000 ranjenika Centralne bolnice.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [Battle for the Wounded on the Neretva](Q127872674) in February and March 1943, when the Partisans, under the slogan "Prozor must fall tonight!", protected 4,000 wounded of the Central Hospital.

opis.sh: Posvećeno taocima streljanim u Stodrežu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the hostages executed in Stodrež.

mala-kopasnica-spomenik-nob.adresa: U dvorištu škole, u centru sela
mala-kopasnica-spomenik-nob.slikaPotpis: Ekipa Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima Male Kopašnice palim u Prvom i Drugom svetskom ratu, skojevcima streljanim na Bubnju i žrtvama fašističkog terora. Na česmi, podignutoj 4. juna 1988, nalazi se bronzani reljef Vlajka Nikolića, borca NOB-a poginulog 1942.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters from Mala Kopašnica killed in World Wars I and II, Communist youth members executed at Bubanj, and victims of fascist terror. The fountain, erected on 4 June 1988, features a bronze relief of Vlajko Nikolić, a Partisan fighter killed in 1942.

opis.sh: Mesto gde je 10. juna 1942. poginuo i sahranjen narodni heroj Boško Palkovljević Pinki; njegovi ostaci su danas na Spomen-groblju u Sremskoj Mitrovici.
opis.en: The place where people's hero Boško Palkovljević Pinki was killed and buried on 10 June 1942; his remains are now in the Memorial Cemetery in Sremska Mitrovica.

opis.sh: Posvećeno streljanim taocima iz Kostanjevice.
opis.en: Dedicated to the executed hostages from Kostanjevica.

opis.sh: Spomenik palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora podignut je 1964. Ploča je kasnije zamenjena, a stara ploča sačuvana je u blizini.
opis.en: The memorial to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror was erected in 1964. Its plaque was later replaced, and the old plaque survives nearby.

opis.sh: Partizansko groblje iz 1959. temeljno je obnovljeno 2008. Prema pregledu iz 2018, pojedinačne grobne oznake više nisu vidljive.
opis.en: The 1959 Partisan cemetery was extensively restored in 2008. A 2018 survey reported that individual grave markers were no longer visible.

malesici-partizansko-groblje.autor: Ostoja Radić & Abdulah Osmičević & Anton Šego

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim u Drugom svetskom ratu na Prevojama.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in WWII at Prevoje.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim delegatima Sreske partijske konferencije.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fallen delegates of the district Party conference.

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanima kupčkog kraja i pomoći koju su im pružali meštani. Opis iz 1981. navodi spomen-put, most, česmu i spomen-park, ali današnja očuvanost svih delova nije potvrđena.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisans from the Kupci area and the support provided by local residents. A 1981 description lists a memorial road, bridge, fountain and park, but the present condition of all these elements has not been confirmed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Drugoj četi Šercerovog bataljona.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 2nd Company of the Šercer Battalion.

mamula-island-prison.adresa: U tvrđavi Mamula na ostrvu Lastavica, u sklopu hotela

opis.sh: Galerija čuva sećanje na zatočenike italijanskog logora na Mamuli tokom Drugog svetskog rata, uz dokumente, predmete i svedočanstva. Nalazi se u tvrđavi koja je danas hotel; posetu i prevoz do ostrva treba dogovoriti pre dolaska.
opis.en: The gallery preserves the memory of prisoners held in the Italian camp on Mamula during the Second World War through documents, objects and testimonies. It is housed in the fortress, now a hotel; arrange your visit and transport to the island before travelling.

manojlovce-bista-najdana-pavlovica.slikaPotpis: Ekipa Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

opis.sh: Posvećeno Najdanu Pavloviću, borcu Babičkog partizanskog odreda koga su četnici ubili septembra 1942. u šumi kod Zlokućana. Autor biste je Slobodan Popović.
opis.en: Dedicated to Najdan Pavlović, a fighter of the Babička Partisan Detachment killed by Chetniks in September 1942 in a forest near Zlokućane. The bust was created by Slobodan Popović.

opis.sh: Spomenik Arifu Derviševiću podignut je 1968. uz nekadašnju osnovnu školu, danas ambulantu. Obnovljen je 2019. i razlikuje se od obeležja njegovog mesta pogibije južnije u Maoči.
opis.en: The memorial to Arif Dervišević was erected in 1968 by the former primary school, now a clinic. Renovated in 2019, it is separate from the marker at his death site farther south in Maoča.

opis.sh: Na mestu smrti Arifa Derviševića.
opis.en: At the place where Arif Dervišević died.

opis.sh: Posvećeno zarobljavanju 768 pripadnika divizije „Handžar“ 1944. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the capture of 768 Handžar Division troops in 1944.

opis.sh: Posvećeno meštanima Marezige koji su izgubili život u borbi protiv okupatora i žrtvama fašističkog nasilja posle pobune protiv fašista 15. maja 1921.
opis.en: Dedicated to Marezige villagers who lost their lives fighting the occupiers and to victims of fascist violence after the uprising against the fascists on 15 May 1921.

opis.sh: Posvećeno taocima i učesnicima otpora koje su nemačke okupacione snage streljale u Mariboru tokom Drugog svetskog rata. Na bronzanom spomeniku Slavka Tiheca sačuvane su reprodukcije objava o streljanju i oproštajnog pisma osuđenog Jožeta Fluksa.
opis.en: Dedicated to hostages and resistance members executed by German occupation forces in Maribor during the Second World War. Slavko Tihec’s bronze monument reproduces execution notices and the farewell letter of condemned prisoner Jože Fluks.

opis.sh: Posvećeno taocima ubijenim u osvit slobode, aprila 1945.
opis.en: Dedicated to hostages killed at the dawn of freedom in April 1945.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora; ograđena memorijalna celina kod društvenog doma obuhvata kosturnicu iz 1961. i spomenik iz 1975. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror; the enclosed memorial by the community hall includes a 1961 ossuary and a 1975 monument.

opis.sh: Posvećeno osnivanju bataljona Druge brigade državne bezbednosti.
opis.en: Dedicated to the founding of a battalion of the 2nd State Security Brigade.

opis.sh: Posvećeno osnivanju Škofjeloškog odreda.
opis.en: Dedicated to the founding of the Škofja Loka Detachment.

opis.sh: Memorijal palim borcima NOB i žrtvama fašističkog terora podignut je 1978. Kasnije je preuređen i uključen u širi kompleks sa obeležjima drugim ratovima.
opis.en: The memorial to fallen Partisans and victims of fascist terror was erected in 1978. It was later altered and incorporated into a broader complex with memorials to other wars.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim 1912-1918. i 1941-1945. i žrtvama fašističkog terora; otkriven 13. septembra 1978, po projektu Časlava Videnovića.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in 1912-1918 and 1941-1945 and victims of fascist terror; unveiled on 13 September 1978, designed by Časlav Videnović.

opis.sh: Posvećeno 26 boraca Druge brigade 13. primorsko-goranske divizije koji su se smrzli u maršu u noći sa 19. na 20. februar 1944. Spomen-područje je uredio Zdenko Sila.
opis.en: Dedicated to 26 fighters of the 2nd Brigade of the 13th Primorje-Gorski Kotar Division who froze to death on the march of the night of 19-20 February 1944. The memorial area was designed by Zdenko Sila.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim meštanima Matijevca.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fallen residents of Matijevac.

mavrovo-spomen-park.adresa: U južnom delu sela, u parku ispred hotela i restorana

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima NOB iz mavrovskog kraja. Park obuhvata centralnu skulpturu, zid sa imenima stradalih i biste [Mare Ugrinovske](Q131376702), [Bogeta Veljanovskog](Q131351079) i [Nikudina Simevskog](Q131357708).
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan fighters from the Mavrovo area. The park includes a central sculpture, a wall listing the fallen and busts of [Mara Ugrinovska](Q131376702), [Boge Veljanovski](Q131351079) and [Nikudin Simevski](Q131357708).

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima partizanskog odreda „Borka Taleski“.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters of the "Borka Taleski" Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Spomenik partizanskom aerodromu podignut je 1974, a njegove spomen-ploče su razbijene. Obližnji spomen-avion postavljen je na ovu lokaciju 1980. i kasnije uništen; ploča iz 1982. i starije obeležje od avionskog krila zasebni su objekti.
opis.en: The Partisan airfield memorial was erected in 1974, and its plaques have been smashed. The nearby memorial aircraft was moved here in 1980 and later destroyed; the 1982 plaque and the older aircraft-wing memorial are separate objects.

medjare-spomenik-palim-borcima-i-zrtvama.adresa: Pored ceste Međare–Zažvić, s lijeve strane u Međarima

opis.sh: Posvećeno formiranju Agitpropa za istočnu Bosnu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the formation of the Agitprop for eastern Bosnia.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Mačvanskom partizanskom odredu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Mačva Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno počecima partizanskog vazduhoplovstva 1942. i pilotima [Franji Kluzu](Q2614258) i [Rudiju Čajavecu](Q2614845). Prvo obeležje podignuto je 1951, a avion Ikarus Kurir dodat je memorijalu 1985. kao podsetnik na ratni aerodrom.
opis.en: Dedicated to the beginnings of Partisan aviation in 1942 and pilots [Franjo Kluz](Q2614258) and [Rudi Čajavec](Q2614845). The first memorial was erected in 1951, and an Ikarus Kurir aircraft was added in 1985 to commemorate the wartime airfield.

medvedja-spomen-park.adresa: Kod Doma kulture, uz glavnu raskrsnicu

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima Drugog svetskog rata iz Medveđe. Celina kod Doma kulture obuhvata spomenik sa reljefima Dušana Nikolića iz 1952. i biste.
opis.en: Dedicated to local fighters from Medveđa who fell in the Second World War. The site beside the cultural centre comprises a monument with reliefs by Dušan Nikolić from 1952 and busts.

opis.sh: Na mestu gde je 24. septembra 1944. formirana Peta kosovsko-metohijska udarna brigada; podignut je 1989.
opis.en: At the site where the 5th Kosovo-Metohija Assault Brigade was formed on 24 September 1944; erected in 1989.

opis.sh: Posvećeno taocima streljanim u Gramoznoj jami.
opis.en: Dedicated to hostages executed at the Gramozna Jama gravel pit.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Severnobanatskom partizanskom odredu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the North Banat Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima NOB i žrtvama fašizma iz Melnice. Memorijalnu celinu čine obelisk sa imenima stradalih, spomen-česma i dodatne ploče.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan fighters and victims of fascism from Melnica. The memorial site comprises an obelisk listing the fallen, a memorial fountain and additional plaques.

melovo-spomenik-nob.adresa: Ispred OŠ „Slavko Zlatanović“ i seoske ambulante
melovo-spomenik-nob.slikaPotpis: Ekipa Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanima poginulim januara 1942. i borcima iz okolnih sela palim 1944-1945. Spomenik Stevana Sokolovića postavljen je 1971. ispred škole i nekadašnje seoske kuće.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisans killed in January 1942 and fighters from nearby villages who fell in 1944–1945. Stevan Sokolović’s memorial was erected in 1971 outside the school and former village community building.

memici-partizanski-spomenik.adresa: U centru Memića, uz glavni put, kod skretanja za Hemlijaše

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima NOR-a 1941-1945. Spomenik su meštani Memića podigli 27. jula 1957, a obnovljen je 2009.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters of the 1941–1945 People’s Liberation War. The people of Memići erected the monument on 27 July 1957, and it was restored in 2009.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Kokrškom odredu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Kokra Detachment.

opis.sh: Na mestu gde se 12. oktobra 1941. okupio Karadački partizanski odred od 15 boraca, četiri kilometra južno od Kumanova; komandant je bio Boro Menkov, a politički komesar Pero Georgievski Čičo. Odred je posle dva dana razbio bugarski okupator.
opis.en: At the site where the 15-strong Karadak Partisan Detachment gathered on 12 October 1941, four kilometres south of Kumanovo; its commander was Boro Menkov and its political commissar Pero Georgievski Čičo. The Bulgarian occupiers broke up the detachment two days later.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Travničke čete i Zeničkog odreda.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters of the Travnik Company and the Zenica Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Cankarovoj četi na Obranici.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Cankar Company on Obranica.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim na planini Ravne.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed on the Ravne pasture.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Ferdu Korenu na Obranici.
opis.en: Dedicated to Ferdo Koren on Obranica.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulima iz Mežice i okoline u borbama za severnu granicu i u NOB. Park ispred Narodnog doma obuhvata stubni spomenik iz 1952. i bistu narodnog heroja Franca Pasterka Lenarta.
opis.en: Dedicated to people from Mežica and its surroundings who fell in the struggle for the northern border and in the Partisan struggle. The park in front of Narodni dom contains a column monument from 1952 and a bust of People’s Hero Franc Pasterk Lenart.

opis.sh: Spomenik iz 1956. posvećen je žrtvama fašističkog terora ubijenim u avgustu 1941. Uništen je tokom rata 1992-1995, ponovo podignut 2017. i popravljan 2018. posle oluje.
opis.en: The 1956 memorial commemorates victims of fascist terror killed in August 1941. Destroyed during the 1992-1995 war, it was rebuilt in 2017 and repaired in 2018 after storm damage.

opis.sh: Spomenik Prvoj proleterskoj brigadi iz 1954. stoji kod zgrade opštine Ustikolina. Katalog ga opisuje kao ploču, dok fotografija prikazuje samostalno kameno obeležje sa ugrađenom pločom; raniji naziv mesta Milakovac bio je pogrešan.
opis.en: The 1954 First Proletarian Brigade memorial stands near the Ustikolina municipal building. The catalogue calls it a plaque, while the photograph shows a freestanding stone memorial with an inset plaque; the former place name Milakovac was incorrect.

opis.sh: Vojnoistorijski muzej u nekadašnjoj kasarni čuva tenkove, artiljeriju, avione i drugu vojnu tehniku, uključujući opremu iz Drugog svetskog rata i jugoslovenskog perioda. Izložbe obuhvataju i druga razdoblja vojne istorije Slovenije.
opis.en: Housed in former barracks, this military history museum displays tanks, artillery, aircraft and other equipment, including examples from the Second World War and the Yugoslav period. Its exhibitions also cover other periods of Slovenian military history.

miljkovac-spomen-obiljezje-palim-borcima.adresa: U šumi na Miljkovcu, uz planinarsku stazu u Zaštićenom pejzažu Konjuh

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima [VI istočnobosanske brigade](Q16761390) poginulim u borbama u avgustu 1942. Spomen-obeležje iz 1952. obnovljeno je i dobilo novu ploču 2011; ne označava mesto njihovih grobova.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters of the [6th Eastern Bosnian Brigade](Q16761390) killed in fighting in August 1942. The 1952 memorial was restored and received a new plaque in 2011; it does not mark their burial place.

opis.sh: Na groblju se nalazi devet zajedničkih grobnica žrtava fašističkog terora.
opis.en: The cemetery contains nine communal graves of victims of fascist terror.

milovici.adresa: Na jugoistočnoj strani uvale Pržno, uz šetalište plaže Plavi horizonti

opis.sh: Posvećeno devetoro civila streljanih 2. januara 1944. zato što su članovi njihovih porodica bili borci NOB. Spomenik su 1956. podigli članovi njihovih porodica.
opis.en: Dedicated to nine civilians executed on 2 January 1944 because members of their families were partisan fighters. Their relatives erected the monument in 1956.

milovici-memorial-to-the-victims-of-ital.adresa: Podrogač, ispod Radovića, iznad puta u blizini skretanja za Krašiće

opis.sh: Posvećeno petnaestorici boraca stradalih 9. septembra 1943. u borbi protiv italijanskih fašista. Spomenik je podignut 4. jula 1953.
opis.en: Dedicated to fifteen fighters who died on 9 September 1943 fighting the Italian fascists. The monument was erected on 4 July 1953.

opis.sh: Mozaik Joke Kneževića iz 1963. prikazuje dve majke na grobu palih boraca, dva partizana na straži i ženu sa hranom kao znak pobede.
opis.en: Joko Knežević's 1963 mosaic shows two mothers at the grave of fallen fighters, two Partisans on guard and a woman carrying food as a sign of victory.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama ratova 1912-1918. i 1941-1945. godine, kao i narodnom heroju Milunu Miniću Šumadincu. Memorijalna celina otkrivena je 7. jula 1991. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of the wars of 1912-1918 and 1941-1945, and to National Hero Milun Minić Šumadinac. The memorial was unveiled on 7 July 1991.

opis.sh: Posvećeno formiranju Mioničke čete.
opis.en: Dedicated to the formation of the Mionica Company.

opis.sh: Spomenik Zoji Kosmodemjanskoj prvobitno je podignut 1949, preuređen 1973. i obnovljen oko 2017.
opis.en: The monument to Zoya Kosmodemyanskaya was originally erected in 1949, remodelled in 1973 and restored around 2017.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palima na Rojama.
opis.en: Dedicated to those killed at Roje.

opis.sh: Grobnica tridesetak narodnih heroja i istaknutih ličnosti radničkog pokreta, delo Đure Kavurića iz 1968. Teško je oštećena eksplozivom 2001.
opis.en: Tomb of some thirty people's heroes and prominent figures of the workers' movement, built by Đuro Kavurić in 1968. It was badly damaged by explosives in 2001.

opis.sh: Otkriven 14. avgusta 1974, na tridesetogodišnjicu formiranja 13. srpske udarne brigade. Tri cveta simbolizuju ranija oslobođenja, a petokraka oslobođenje 1944.
opis.en: Unveiled on 14 August 1974, the 30th anniversary of the formation of the 13th Serbian Assault Brigade. Three flowers symbolize earlier liberations and the star the liberation of 1944.

opis.sh: Bista Borislava Stankovića Ćulavka (1919-1944), delo vajara Slobodana Popovića.
opis.en: Bust of Borislav Stanković Ćulavko (1919-1944) by sculptor Slobodan Popović.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [50. makedonskoj diviziji NOVJ](Q1007943), formiranoj u okolini Mitrašinaca 1944. Spomenik Radovana Rađenovića podignut je 1974. povodom tridesete godišnjice njenog osnivanja, sa pet betonskih krakova koji se izvijaju ka nebu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [50th Macedonian Partisan Division](Q1007943), formed near Mitrašinci in 1944. Radovan Rađenović’s monument was erected in 1974 for the thirtieth anniversary of its formation, with five concrete arms curving skywards.

opis.sh: Posvećeno rudarima i partizanima, Srbima i Albancima sa Kosova i Metohije, poginulim u Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi 1941–1945.
opis.en: Dedicated to the miners and Partisans, Serbs and Albanians from Kosovo, who died in the People's Liberation War of 1941–1945.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Marku Marojici, narodnom predstavniku poginulom 23. marta 1944.
opis.en: Dedicated to Marko Marojica, a people's representative killed on 23 March 1944.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Titovom rukovođenju vojnim operacijama iz sela u septembru 1942.
opis.en: Dedicated to Tito leading military operations from the village in September 1942.

mliniste-spomen-voz-prve-partizanske-zel.adresa: In front of former train station

opis.sh: Posvećeno oslobodiocima Modriče iz 1943; spomenik iz 1978. premešten je 2012. od nekadašnje robne kuće u gradski park.
opis.en: Dedicated to the liberators of Modriča in 1943; the 1978 monument was relocated from the former department store to the town park in 2012.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima iz Mojsinja.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters from Mojsinje.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim na Mežakli.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed on Mežakla.

opis.sh: Posvećeno vatrogascima palim u NOB.
opis.en: Dedicated to firefighters killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Mokrinskom partizanskom odredu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Mokrin Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno osnivanju Mokrinskog partizanskog odreda.
opis.en: Dedicated to the founding of the Mokrin Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Prvobitna kosturnica palih boraca uređena je 1953; obeležje iz 1960. obnovljeno je i premešteno na današnje mesto 1984. godine. Današnju celinu oblikovali su Luka Ilić i Ranko Marković; obeležje ratu 1992–1995. dodato je 2018.
opis.en: The original fallen fighters’ ossuary dates to 1953; the 1960 memorial was renovated and moved to its present location in 1984. Luka Ilić and Ranko Marković designed the present memorial; a separate 1992–1995 war memorial was added in 2018.

opis.sh: Posvećeno zatočenicima italijanskog fašističkog logora u uvali Jazi, koji je delovao 1942–1943. Memorijalna celina čuva ostatke logora i sećanje na zatočenike i stradale civile.
opis.en: Dedicated to prisoners of the Italian fascist camp in Jazi Bay, which operated in 1942–1943. The memorial site preserves camp remains and the memory of its prisoners and civilian victims.

moravice-spomenik-prvoj-partizanskoj-div.adresa: Uz prugu prema Vrbovskom, na mestu diverzije 12/13. jula 1941; zarastao (2016).

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim u Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama racije u Mošorinu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the raid in Mošorin.

opis.sh: Posvećeno formiranju Pete krajiške kozaračke brigade.
opis.en: Dedicated to the formation of the 5th Krajina Kozara Brigade.

mostar-hidden-hand-fountain.adresa: Ispred Doma zdravlja, ugao Bulevara i Ulice kneza Mihajla Viševića Humskog

opis.sh: Posvećeno mostarskim ilegalcima iz Drugog svetskog rata; poznato i kao „Skrivena ruka“. Današnja fontana Suleimana Đapa zamenila je ranije obeležje žrtvama fašističkog terora, postavljeno pre 1963; katalog je datira u 1976, a obnovljena je 2010. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to Mostar’s clandestine resistance workers during the Second World War; also known as the “Hidden Hand”. Suleiman Đapo’s fountain replaced an earlier memorial to victims of fascist terror erected before 1963; the catalogue dates the fountain to 1976, and it was restored in 2010.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Mostarcima poginulim u Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi 1941–1945; spomen-groblje je na Bijelom brijegu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the people of Mostar killed in the People's Liberation War of 1941–1945; the memorial cemetery is on Bijeli Brijeg.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Vojku Školarisu na Žirovničkoj planini.
opis.en: Dedicated to Vojko Školaris on Žirovniška Planina.

opis.sh: Spomenik sa 16 glava u memorijalnom parku posvećenom poslednjoj borbi Lackove čete 1942. godine; starije obeležje kraj puta je zaseban objekat.
opis.en: A monument with 16 heads in the memorial park dedicated to the Lacko Company’s last battle in 1942; the older roadside memorial is a separate object.

opis.sh: Posvećeno veterinarima palim u NOB.
opis.en: Dedicated to veterinarians killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borbi i stradanju naroda Kozare, naročito tokom [Kozaračke bitke](Q2985697) 1942. godine. Muzej otvoren 1973. čuva dokumente, fotografije i predmete iz rata, uz memorijalni reljef Dušana Džamonje.
opis.en: Dedicated to the struggle and suffering of the people of Kozara, particularly during the [Battle of Kozara](Q2985697) in 1942. Opened in 1973, the museum displays wartime documents, photographs and objects, together with a memorial relief by Dušan Džamonja.

opis.sh: Posvećeno pobedi I čete 1941. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victory of the I Company in 1941.

opis.sh: Posvećeno pobedi III čete 1941. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victory of the III Company in 1941.

opis.sh: Posvećeno pobedi IV čete 1941. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victory of the IV Company in 1941.

opis.sh: Posvećeno pobedi V čete 1941. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victory of the V Company in 1941.

mrcevac-spomenik-zrtvama-drugog-svjetsko.adresa: Božinovići, na podzidanom platou u spomen-kompleksu iznad Mrčevca
mrcevac-spomenik-zrtvama-drugog-svjetsko.slikaPotpis: Magdalena Radunović & Bratislav Radunović, Montemisija / TO Tivat, 2019

opis.sh: Posvećeno Niku Anđusu, Mihailu Ivanoviću, Borislavi Zenović i Đuru Božinoviću, poginulim u borbi protiv četnika 1944. Spomenik su 1984. podigli opštinski odbori SUBNOR-a Tivta, Kotora i Budve.
opis.en: Dedicated to Niko Anđus, Mihailo Ivanović, Borislava Zenović and Đuro Božinović, killed fighting the Chetniks in 1944. The municipal veterans’ associations of Tivat, Kotor and Budva erected the monument in 1984.

opis.sh: Spomen-dom ZAVNOBiH-a, delo Zdravka Karačića iz 1973, danas je kulturni centar „Petar Kočić“. Razlikuje se od starije zgrade u kojoj je održano Prvo zasedanje 1943. godine i kasnije uređen muzej.
opis.en: The ZAVNOBiH Memorial Hall, designed by Zdravko Karačić in 1973, now serves as the Petar Kočić Cultural Centre. It is distinct from the older building that hosted the First Session in 1943 and later became a museum.

mrljevici-grob-ante-mrkica.adresa: U šumi na obodu zaseoka Mrljevići

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto gde je Anto Mrkić, pripadnik XVIII hrvatske brigade, poginuo u nesreći 22. decembra 1943. Njegovi posmrtni ostaci kasnije su preneti na Partizansko groblje u Husinu.
opis.en: Marks the place where Anto Mrkić of the 18th Croatian Brigade died in an accident on 22 December 1943. His remains were later transferred to the Partisan cemetery in Husino.

muggia-monumento-ai-caduti-della-guerra-.natpis: Ai caduti nella lotta antifascista e nella guerra di liberazione / Padlim v antifašistični borbi in v osvobodilni vojni / Muggia 25. 4. 1965 Milje

murter-bista-ive-vodopije-srecka.adresa: Hramina, mjesni park na raskrižju ulica Maršala Tita i Veljka Vlahovića

murter-bista-milana-jurana-zute.adresa: Dvorište Osnovne škole, Ulica Ive Vodopije Srećka

opis.sh: Muzej istorije i kulture fočanskog kraja, osnovan 1956. godine. Stalna postavka „Fočanski period NOB-a“ prikazuje Foču kao centar partizanske slobodne teritorije, boravak Vrhovnog štaba i organizovanje nove vlasti.
opis.en: A museum of the history and culture of the Foča region, founded in 1956. Its permanent exhibition on the Foča period of the People’s Liberation Struggle presents the town as the centre of a liberated Partisan territory, the presence of the Supreme Headquarters and the organization of a new administration.

opis.sh: Nekadašnji muzej u kući Vladislava Ribnikara obeležava sednicu Politbiroa CK KPJ od 4. jula 1941, na kojoj je doneta odluka o podizanju oružanog ustanka. Muzej je radio od 1950. do 2003, a postavka više nije otvorena za posetioce.
opis.en: The former museum in Vladislav Ribnikar’s house commemorates the Communist Party Politburo meeting of 4 July 1941, which decided to launch an armed uprising. The museum operated from 1950 to 2003, and its exhibition is no longer open to visitors.

opis.sh: Muzej čuva istorijsku građu o narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi i [Kozaračkoj bici](Q2985697), uz arheološke, etnološke i umetničke zbirke. U sadašnju zgradu preseljen je 1984, dok je ustanova osnovana 1954.
opis.en: The museum preserves historical material on the Partisan struggle and the [Battle of Kozara](Q2985697), alongside archaeological, ethnological and art collections. Founded in 1954, it moved into its present building in 1984.

opis.sh: Nekadašnji Muzej narodne revolucije čuva građu o radničkom pokretu, okupaciji i narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi u Zasavju. Današnji regionalni muzej predstavlja i rudarsku, industrijsku i društvenu istoriju ovog kraja.
opis.en: The former Museum of the People’s Revolution preserves material on the labour movement, occupation and Partisan resistance in Zasavje. Today the regional museum also presents the area’s mining, industrial and social history.

opis.sh: Muzej je nastao 1996. spajanjem Memorijalnog centra „Josip Broz Tito“ i Muzeja revolucije naroda i narodnosti Jugoslavije, a čuva građu o istoriji Jugoslavije, narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi i Titovom životu. Čine ga Muzej 25. maj, Stari muzej i Kuća cveća, u kojoj su sahranjeni Tito i Jovanka Broz.
opis.en: The museum was formed in 1996 by merging the Josip Broz Tito Memorial Centre and the Museum of the Revolution of the Peoples of Yugoslavia; it preserves material on Yugoslav history, the Partisan struggle and Tito’s life. It comprises the Museum of 25 May, the Old Museum and the House of Flowers, where Tito and Jovanka Broz are buried.

opis.sh: Posvećeno osnivanju [Prve proleterske brigade](Q2190675) u Rudom 21. decembra 1941. i njenom ratnom putu do Trsta. Deo postavke o brigadi sadrži zbirku oružja i dokumentarnu građu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the formation of the [1st Proletarian Brigade](Q2190675) in Rudo on 21 December 1941 and its wartime route to Trieste. The section devoted to the brigade includes a collection of weapons and documentary material.

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto stradanja 143 žrtve fašističkog terora. Prvobitni spomenik iz 1982. uništen je tokom rata 1992-1995. ili neposredno zatim; obnovljeni je otkriven u decembru 2019.
opis.en: Marks the site where 143 victims of fascist terror were killed. The original 1982 memorial was destroyed during or shortly after the 1992-1995 war; the rebuilt memorial was unveiled in December 2019.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim na Nanosu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed on Nanos.

naselje-kanarevo-brdo-bista-petra-lekovi.adresa: Bista Petra Lekovića, narodnog heroja, u parku školskog centra koji nosi njegovo ime. Postavljena 1978. Vajar M. Protić.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašističkog terora u Radlovcu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of fascist terror at Radlovac.

opis.sh: Muzej u Cekinovom dvorcu prikazuje istoriju Slovenije u 20. veku. Stalna izložba „Slovenci v XX. stoletju“ obuhvata lična svedočenja i predmete iz Drugog svetskog rata, kao i predratni i posleratni život.
opis.en: Housed in Cekin Mansion, the museum presents twentieth-century Slovenian history. Its permanent exhibition, “Slovenes in the Twentieth Century”, includes personal accounts and objects from the Second World War alongside prewar and postwar life.

opis.sh: Istorijski muzej u Vladinom domu prati istoriju Crne Gore, uključujući narodnooslobodilačku borbu 1941-1945. Zatvoren je za posetioce dok se priprema nova stalna postavka.
opis.en: The History Museum in Vladin dom presents Montenegro’s history, including the Partisan struggle of 1941-1945. It is closed to visitors while a new permanent exhibition is being prepared.

natalinci-spomen-park.adresa: U trouglastom parku na račvanju puta, severno od crkve i škole

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima i žrtvama Drugog svetskog rata. U parku su grob i bista [Milana Blagojevića Španca](Q1567421), kao i ploče borcima NOVJ, vojnicima stradalim u aprilu 1941. i jednom crvenoarmejcu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of the Second World War. The park contains the grave and bust of [Milan Blagojević Španac](Q1567421), together with plaques commemorating Partisan fighters, soldiers killed in April 1941 and a Red Army officer.

opis.sh: Muzej prikazuje istoriju Maribora i severoistočne Slovenije u 20. veku, uključujući nacističku okupaciju i otpor 1941-1945. Sačuvani predmeti i dokumenti predstavljaju i svakodnevni život stanovnika tokom rata.
opis.en: The museum presents the twentieth-century history of Maribor and northeastern Slovenia, including Nazi occupation and resistance in 1941-1945. Objects and documents also illustrate the wartime everyday lives of local people.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim skojevcima.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen SKOJ members.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žiteljima stradalim u balkanskim i Prvom svetskom ratu, palim borcima NOB i civilnim žrtvama fašizma. Uništen je 2023. pri gradnji autoputa.
opis.en: Dedicated to residents killed in the Balkan Wars and WWI, fallen WWII fighters and civilian victims of fascism. It was destroyed in 2023 during motorway construction.

opis.sh: Partizansko spomen-groblje uređeno je 1959, uz dalje ukope 1960–1961; centralni spomenik je prema terenskom obilasku srušen do septembra 2025. godine. Grobljanska celina i ostaci centralnog spomenika razlikuju se od zasebne zajedničke grobnice na gradskom groblju.
opis.en: The Partisan Memorial Cemetery was established in 1959, with further burials in 1960–1961; a field visit recorded the central monument as destroyed by September 2025. This cemetery and its ruined central monument are distinct from the collective grave at the town cemetery.

nevesinje-bista-dukice-grahovac.adresa: Park in front of sports hall

nevesinje-bista-obrena-ivkovica.adresa: Park in front of sports hall

nevesinje-bista-save-colovica.adresa: Park in front of sports hall

nevesinje-bista-vuka-torovica.adresa: Park in front of sports hall

nevesinje-spomenik-blagoju-parovicu.adresa: Partizansko spomen-groblje; premešten sa gradskog trga 2009.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Blagoju Paroviću](Q8248571); spomenik iz 1958. premešten je 2009. sa gradskog trga na Partizansko spomen-groblje.
opis.en: Dedicated to [Blagoje Parović](Q8248571); the 1958 monument was relocated from the town square to the Partisan Memorial Cemetery in 2009.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima NOVJ poginulim 19. avgusta 1943.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisans killed on 19 August 1943.

opis.sh: Spomenik u sećanje na više od 1.500 poginulih iz opštine Nikšić u Drugom svetskom ratu i na 32 partizana i antifašista koje su okupatori streljali na Trebjesi.
opis.en: In memory of the more than 1,500 people from the Nikšić municipality killed in World War II and of the 32 Partisans and anti-fascists executed by the occupiers on Trebjesa Hill.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama streljanja na Bubnju, gde su okupatori tokom rata ubili više od 10.000 ljudi iz Niša i drugih krajeva. Tri pesnice predstavljaju prkos muškaraca, žena i dece pred streljanjem.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the executions at Bubanj, where the occupiers killed more than 10,000 people from Niš and elsewhere during the war. The three fists stand for the defiance of the men, women and children facing the firing squad.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Pavlu Stojkoviću, prvom predsedniku komunističke opštine Niš.
opis.en: Dedicated to Pavle Stojković, the first president of the communist municipality of Niš.

opis.sh: Memorijalni kompleks iz 2014. sa spomenikom „Iskra slobode“ i bistama šest narodnih heroja, prenetim na plato u parku pored Nišave.
opis.en: Memorial complex from 2014 with the "Spark of Freedom" monument and busts of six people's heroes, moved to a plaza in the park by the Nišava.

nis-jovic.slikaPotpis: Alexmilt at Serbian Wikipedia, Public domain

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim vazduhoplovcima.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen airmen.

opis.sh: Spomen-grobnica na Sinđelićevom trgu, zaštićena kao spomenik kulture.
opis.en: Memorial tomb on Sinđelić Square, protected as a cultural monument.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama nacističkih streljanja na brdu Bubanj tokom Drugog svetskog rata, među kojima su bili zatočenici logora Crveni krst. Centralni spomenik čine tri stisnute pesnice, simbol otpora.
opis.en: Dedicated to victims of Nazi executions on Bubanj Hill during the Second World War, including prisoners of the Crveni Krst concentration camp. Three clenched fists form the central monument, symbolizing resistance.

opis.sh: Posvećeno sovjetskim vojnicima poginulim u niškom incidentu 7. novembra 1944. Podignut je 2015. na mestu uklonjene ploče sa njihovim imenima.
opis.en: Dedicated to Soviet soldiers killed in the Niš incident of 7 November 1944. Erected in 2015 on the site of a removed plaque with their names.

opis.sh: Na mestu smrti Mileve Mijatović.
opis.en: At the place where Mileva Mijatović died.

opis.sh: Obeležava ubistvo i spaljivanje 41 stanovnika sela 20. novembra 1941. Prvobitno obeležje iz 1967. zamenjeno je 1985, a zvezda je kasnije zamenjena krstom.
opis.en: Commemorates the killing and burning of 41 villagers on 20 November 1941. The original 1967 memorial was replaced in 1985, and its star was later replaced with a cross.

novi-bezdan-spomenik-palim-borcima.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Igmanskom maršu](Q3467820); obeležava prelazak Prve proleterske brigade preko reke Bosne u Reljevu u januaru 1942. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [Igman March](Q3467820); marks the First Proletarian Brigade’s crossing of the Bosna River at Reljevo in January 1942.

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanskim borcima Dobroševića i okoline; prvobitno obeležje iz 1959. bilo je i zajednička grobnica devetnaest boraca. Prema katalogu je kasnije zamenjeno, verovatno posle 1995; sudbina posmrtnih ostataka nije potvrđena.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisan fighters from Dobroševići and the surrounding area; the original 1959 memorial also served as a collective grave of nineteen fighters. The catalogue records a later replacement, probably after 1995; the fate of the remains is unconfirmed.

novi-grad-sarajevo-spomenik-zrtvama-fasi.adresa: Ulaz u nekadašnju Tvornicu žice, Džemala Bijedića 160

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama sabirnog logora Alipašin Most; prvobitna ploča iz 1953. zamenjena je spomenikom Pavla Mašića 1984, uništenim tokom opsade Sarajeva. Tvornica žice je 2011. na ulazu postavila današnju ploču sa istim tekstom.
opis.en: Dedicated to victims of the Alipašin Most transit camp; the original 1953 plaque was replaced by Pavle Mašić’s monument in 1984, which was destroyed during the siege of Sarajevo. In 2011, the wire factory installed the present entrance plaque with the same text.

opis.sh: Kosturnica 37 palih boraca.
opis.en: Ossuary of 37 fallen fighters.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima iz Novog Kneževca i okoline. Dve stilizovane figure ratnika u pokretu čine kompoziciju Aleksandra Zarina u parku uz Tisu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters from Novi Kneževac and its surroundings. Two stylised warriors in motion form Aleksandar Zarin’s composition in the park beside the Tisa River.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama [Novosadske racije](Q1047674) iz januara 1942, kada su mađarski okupatori ubili više od 1.000 građana Novog Sada i bacili ih u zaleđeni Dunav.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the [Novi Sad raid](Q1047674) of January 1942, when the Hungarian occupiers killed more than 1,000 citizens of Novi Sad and threw them into the frozen Danube.

opis.sh: Spomen-groblje boraca NOR-a u okviru Gradskog groblja, zaštićeno kao kulturno-istorijska celina.
opis.en: Memorial cemetery of WWII fighters within the City Cemetery, protected as a cultural-historical site.

opis.sh: Odeljenje novije istorije u nekadašnjem Muzeju socijalističke revolucije predstavlja političku, privrednu i vojnu istoriju Vojvodine 1914-1945. Važan deo postavke posvećen je okupaciji, zločinima i narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi tokom Drugog svetskog rata.
opis.en: The Modern History Department, housed in the former Museum of the Socialist Revolution, presents Vojvodina’s political, economic and military history from 1914 to 1945. A substantial part covers occupation, atrocities and Partisan resistance during the Second World War.

opis.sh: Partizanska baza bila je uređena kao Muzej štampe NOB Vojvodine.
opis.en: The Partisan base formerly housed the Museum of Vojvodina’s National Liberation War Press.

opis.sh: Posvećeno šesnaestorici palih boraca.
opis.en: Dedicated to 16 fallen fighters.

opis.sh: Nekropola žrtvama fašizma, rad Bogdana Bogdanovića iz 1975, nalazi se na Smrikama, na Čamića brdu kod Novog Travnika. Proglašena je nacionalnim spomenikom Bosne i Hercegovine 2012. godine.
opis.en: The Necropolis for Victims of Fascism, designed by Bogdan Bogdanović in 1975, stands at Smrike on Čamića Brdo near Novi Travnik. It was designated a National Monument of Bosnia and Herzegovina in 2012.

novi-vinodolski-bista-slavise-vajnera-ci.natpis:
NARODNI HEROJ
SLAVIŠA VAJNER
ČIČA ROMANIJSKI
LEGENDARNA LIČNOST NARODNO-OSLOBODILAČKE BORBE 1941-1945
ROĐEN U NOVOM VINODOLSKOM 1903.
POGINUO NA ROMANIJI 1942.

opis.sh: Grob boraca Cankarove brigade na Marofu.
opis.en: Grave of Cankar Brigade fighters at Marof.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palima iz Bršljina.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fallen from Bršljin.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim železničarima.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen railway workers.

opis.sh: Posvećeno prvoj borbi Dragutinovačkog odreda.
opis.en: Dedicated to the first battle of the Dragutinovac Detachment.

novo-nevesinje-spomenik-palim-borcima.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

opis.sh: Posvećeno Korapskom partizanskom odredu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Korab Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno vođstvu [VI istočnobosanske brigade](Q16761390) u oslobođenju Bijeljine 1944/1945.
opis.en: Dedicated to leadership of liberation of Bijeljina by the [VI Eastern Bosnian Brigade](Q16761390) in 1944/45.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora. Spomenik iz 1957. rekonstruisan je 1979, a okolni park obnovljen 2018; susedni spomenik ratu 1992-1995. zaseban je objekat.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror. The 1957 monument was reconstructed in 1979 and its surrounding park renovated in 2018; the adjacent 1992-1995 war memorial is a separate object.

opis.sh: Spomenik iz 1976. posvećen je palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora iz Nuglašice. Ponovo je podignut posle 2009; dodata ploča ratu 1992–1995. ne menja prvobitnu godinu.
opis.en: The 1976 memorial commemorates fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror from Nuglašica. It was re-erected after 2009; an added plaque for the 1992–1995 war does not change its original date.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Šestoj crnogorskoj udarnoj brigadi](Q16088819), koja je u novembru 1944. u ovom kraju vodila borbe protiv nemačkih snaga. Betonski spomenik Slobodana Vukajlovića na Obadovom brijegu oblikovan je kao stilizovana ptica.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [6th Montenegrin Strike Brigade](Q16088819), which fought German forces in this area in November 1944. Slobodan Vukajlović’s concrete monument on Obad Hill takes the form of a stylised bird.

opis.sh: Spomen-kosturnica Bratislava Stojanovića i Milovana Krstića iz 1954, sa posmrtnim ostacima 27 boraca Posavskog partizanskog odreda u kripti.
opis.en: Memorial ossuary by Bratislav Stojanović and Milovan Krstić from 1954, holding the remains of 27 fighters of the Posavina Partisan Detachment in its crypt.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama [kragujevačkog masakra](Q685201), koje su nemačke okupacione snage streljale u oktobru 1941, među njima i đacima. Muzej u Šumaricama čuva dokumente, fotografije, lične predmete i poslednje poruke streljanih.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the [Kragujevac massacre](Q685201), executed by German occupation forces in October 1941, including schoolchildren. The museum in Šumarice preserves documents, photographs, personal belongings and the victims’ final messages.

opis.sh: Spomen-kosturnica palih boraca u gradskom parku podignuta je 1962, a obnovljena 2018. godine.
opis.en: The fallen fighters’ memorial ossuary in the town park was erected in 1962 and restored in 2018.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima NOB iz Josipdola.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen WWII fighters from Josipdol.

opis.sh: Partizansko groblje na padinama Galičice sa grobovima 31 borca NOVJ iz Ohrida i okoline, svaki obeležen piramidom od belog mermera.
opis.en: Partisan cemetery on the slopes of Galičica with the graves of 31 Partisans from Ohrid and its surroundings, each marked by a white marble pyramid.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima Kokrške čete.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters of the Kokra Company.

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto formiranja partizanskog odreda „Zvijezda“.
opis.en: Dedicated to place of formation of Zvijezda Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašizma; „Kameni cvijet“ Pere Jelisića podignut je 1981, a memorijalno područje uređeno 1984. godine. Ovde su preneti posmrtni ostaci iz zajedničke grobnice kod nekadašnjeg Doma kulture, uklonjene 1973.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascism; Pero Jelisić’s “Stone Flower” was erected in 1981, and the memorial area was completed in 1984. Remains were transferred here from the collective grave by the former Cultural Centre, removed in 1973.

opis.sh: Posvećeno četvorici boraca Dalmatinske brigade poginulih u julu 1943. Datum 17. novembar 1974. urezan je u betonsko podnožje.
opis.en: Dedicated to four fighters of the Dalmatian Brigade killed in July 1943. The date 17 November 1974 is engraved in the concrete base.

omazici-spomen-kosturnica-palih-boraca.natpis:
ČETVORICI PALIH
DALMATINSKE BRIGADE
JULA 1943
SUB NOR BANOVIĆI

opis.sh: Posvećeno pet žrtava fašističkog terora streljanih u januaru 1945. Nalazi se u školskom dvorištu, iza Doma mesne zajednice.
opis.en: Dedicated to five victims of fascist terror executed in January 1945. It stands in the schoolyard behind the community hall.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim garibaldincima Tršćanskog udarnog bataljona u Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Garibaldini of the Trieste Assault Battalion in WWII.

opis.sh: Spomenik palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora otkriven je 4. jula 1987. Nalazi se ispred nekadašnjeg Spomen-doma; propast zgrade ne znači da je sam spomenik uklonjen.
opis.en: The monument to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror was unveiled on 4 July 1987. It stands in front of the former memorial hall; the building’s ruin does not mean the monument itself was removed.

opis.sh: Spomenik iz 1972. u Parku solidarnosti prikazuje repliku bombe izrađivane u partizanskoj radionici u Ljubiji.
opis.en: The 1972 memorial in Solidarity Park features a replica of a bomb made in the Partisan workshop in Ljubija.

opis.sh: Groblje 61 palog borca podignuto je 1961. i obnovljeno 2007. godine.
opis.en: The cemetery of 61 fallen fighters was established in 1961 and restored in 2007.

opis.sh: Posvećeno petnaestorici civila koje je nemačka vojska žive spalila u kućama u noći 17. na 18. maj 1944. Spomenik Toneta Bitenca iz 1956. čine ostaci spaljenih kuća i hrastova skulptura.
opis.en: Dedicated to fifteen civilians burned alive in their homes by the German army on the night of 17-18 May 1944. Tone Bitenc's 1956 memorial consists of the remains of the burned houses and an oak sculpture.

oreskovica-bista-maksima-ilica.adresa: Bista Maksima Ilića, prvoborca Požarevačkog partizanskog odreda, ispred Doma kulture.

oreskovica-spomenik-palim-partizanima-u-.adresa: Spomenik palim partizanima u vinogradima u ataru naselja.

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanima palim u vinogradima u ataru sela.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisans killed in the village vineyards.

opis.sh: Posvećeno 71 taocu koje su nacisti streljali 3. aprila 1944.
opis.en: Dedicated to 71 hostages shot by the Nazis on 3 April 1944.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palima u NOB.
opis.en: Dedicated to those killed in WWII.

osecina-spomen-park.adresa: Na zelenoj površini kod ulaza u autobusku stanicu

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima NOB iz osečinskog kraja, uz spomen-kosturnicu. Obeležje sa reljefom borca preneto je iz parka na prostor kod autobuske stanice.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan fighters from the Osečina area, alongside a memorial ossuary. The memorial bearing a relief of a fighter was moved from the park to the area beside the bus station.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašističkog logora Tenja.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the Tenja fascist camp.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašizma iz Osijeka i Slavonije.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of fascism from Osijek and Slavonia.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašizma u Osijeku i Slavoniji 1941-1945.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of fascism in Osijek and Slavonia in 1941-1945.

opis.sh: „Sloboda“ Drage Handanovića i Save Krivokapića iz 1983. posvećena je 26 palih boraca i deset žrtava fašističkog terora. Sastoji se od betonskih elemenata raspoređenih u zvezdu, u centru Osječana Donjih.
opis.en: Freedom, created in 1983 by Drago Handanović and Sava Krivokapić, commemorates 26 fallen fighters and ten victims of fascist terror. Its concrete elements form a star in central Osječani Donji.

opis.sh: Spomenik Drage Handanovića, Save Krivokapića i Petra Vajdića iz 1981. obeležava napad na žandarmerijsku kasarnu 23. avgusta 1941. Nalazi se između puta za Doboj i pruge, južno od središta Osječana.
opis.en: The 1981 memorial by Drago Handanović, Sava Krivokapić and Petar Vajdić marks the attack on the gendarmerie barracks on 23 August 1941. It stands between the Doboj road and the railway, south of central Osječani.

osjecani-gornji-spomenik-prvom-ustanku-u.autor: Drago Handanović & Sava Krivokapić & Petar Vajdić

oskova-spomenik-izgradnji-pruge-brcko-ba.adresa: Brioni, uz zgradu železničke stanice Oskova

opis.sh: Obeležava polazak prvog voza sa banovićkim ugljem omladinskom prugom Brčko–Banovići 7. novembra 1946. Natpis ističe učešće 62.000 jugoslovenskih i 1.800 stranih omladinaca u izgradnji pruge.
opis.en: Commemorates the departure of the first train carrying Banovići coal along the Brčko–Banovići youth railway on 7 November 1946. The inscription records the participation of 62,000 Yugoslav and 1,800 foreign young volunteers in building the railway.

osmaci-bista-svetozara-vukovica-zarka.adresa: Kod spomen-groba Svetozara Vukovića Žarka, pored vatrogasnog doma

opis.sh: Bista Svetozara Vukovića Žarka, rad Dragiše Trifkovića nastao posle 1970, prvobitno je stajala ispred današnje zgrade opštine. Nakon čuvanja u skladištu postavljena je u prostor njegovog spomen-groba kod vatrogasnog doma.
opis.en: Svetozar Vuković Žarko’s bust, created by Dragiša Trifković after 1970, originally stood in front of today’s municipal building. After being kept in storage, it was installed in the enclosure of his memorial grave by the fire station.

opis.sh: Grob narodnog heroja Svetozara Vukovića Zarka.
opis.en: Grave of people's hero Svetozar Vuković Zarko.

opis.sh: Posvećeno prvom savezničkom vazdušnom mostu sa teritorije BiH; prvobitna spomen-ploča uništena je tokom rata 1992–1995. Zamenjena je novom pločom 2009. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the first Allied airlift from Bosnia and Herzegovina; the original memorial plaque was destroyed during the 1992–1995 war. A replacement plaque was installed in 2009.

opis.sh: Spomen-česma iz 1974. posvećena je civilima iz Osojaca, Rapćana i Bišnje ubijenim 1945. Derventski list je 19. februara 2026. potvrdio obnovu u toku, započetu 2025; završetak radova nije potvrđen.
opis.en: The 1974 memorial fountain commemorates civilians from Osojci, Rapćani and Bišnja killed in 1945. Derventski list reported ongoing reconstruction on 19 February 2026, begun in 2025; completion has not been confirmed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima Čačanskog partizanskog odreda poginulim u noći 4. na 5. marta 1943, kada su četnici i žandarmi opkolili 25 partizana u obližnjoj štali; u proboju ih je poginulo četrnaest.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fourteen fighters of the Čačak Partisan Detachment killed on the night of 4–5 March 1943, when Chetniks and gendarmes surrounded 25 Partisans in a nearby barn.

opis.sh: Sačuvana kompozicija [Partizanske železnice](Q20310549) podseća na boravak Tita i Vrhovnog štaba na Oštrelju u oktobru 1942. Lokomotiva i vagoni izloženi su kao memorijalni voz pod nadstrešnicom.
opis.en: The preserved [Partisan railway](Q20310549) train commemorates the stay of Tito and the Supreme Headquarters at Oštrelj in October 1942. The locomotive and carriages are displayed under a shelter as a memorial train.

ostrovica-spomen-cesma.adresa: Spomen-česma sa imenima tri borca poginula u borbama 1944-1945. godine. polom

opis.sh: Posvećeno osnivanju vojne jedinice.
opis.en: Dedicated to the founding of a military unit.

osve-spomenik-zrtvama-fasistickog-terora.adresa: Gušavica, južno od zaseoka Karasnica i lokalnog puta

opis.sh: Posvećeno stanovnicima Ošava koje su ustaše ubile u avgustu 1941. godine. Spomenik je porušen 1992, a obnovljen i otkriven 24. avgusta 2025. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the inhabitants of Ošve killed by the Ustaše in August 1941. The memorial was demolished in 1992, then rebuilt and unveiled on 24 August 2025.

otesevo.adresa: Над кампот „Отешево“, на падината покрај Преспанското Езеро

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Prespanskom savetovanju CK Komunističke partije Makedonije](Q12291399), održanom 2. avgusta 1943. kod Oteševa. Dve zakrivljene betonske forme spomenika uzdižu se na padini iznad Prespanskog jezera.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [Prespa Conference of the Communist Party of Macedonia Central Committee](Q12291399), held near Oteševo on 2 August 1943. The monument’s two curved concrete forms rise on a hillside above Lake Prespa.

opis.sh: Spomen-česma iz 1978. posvećena je palim borcima. Prema katalogu očuvana je, ali voda više ne teče.
opis.en: The 1978 memorial fountain commemorates fallen fighters. The catalogue records it as preserved but no longer dispensing water.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima s Pala i iz okoline; kosturnica ima statuu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters from Pale and the surrounding area; the ossuary includes a statue.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Paljevskom partizanskom odredu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Paljevo Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima, taocima i internircima.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters, hostages and internees.

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanskim kuririma, prikazanim kao dečak sa porukom o slobodi.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisan couriers, shown as a boy carrying a message of freedom.

opis.sh: Posvećeno streljanim građanima Pančeva.
opis.en: Dedicated to executed citizens of Pančevo.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Crvene armije.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Red Army soldiers.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima NOB iz Vojlovice.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen WWII fighters from Vojlovica.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima iz Fabrike stakla.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters from the glass factory.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju [Branku Krsmanoviću](Q1263710), borcu u Španiji i NOB; podignut je 1981. u centru Paraćina.
opis.en: Dedicated to people's hero [Branko Krsmanović](Q1263710), a fighter in Spain and in WWII; erected in 1981 in central Paraćin.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima iz Ciglenice.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fallen fighters from Ciglenica.

pasiglav-spomenik-zrtvama-cetnickog-tero.adresa: Na Vrmacu, između Gornjih Bogdašića i Gornje Lastve; prilaz brdskim stazama
pasiglav-spomenik-zrtvama-cetnickog-tero.slikaPotpis: Magdalena Radunović & Bratislav Radunović, Montemisija / TO Tivat, 2019

opis.sh: Posvećeno Antu N. Ciku, Jozu M. Markoviću i Luki N. Brkanu, žrtvama četničkog terora 1944. Spomenik je podignut 21. novembra 1979.
opis.en: Dedicated to Anto N. Cik, Jozo M. Marković and Luka N. Brkan, victims of Chetnik terror in 1944. The monument was erected on 21 November 1979.

opis.sh: Posvećeno proboju Drugog krajiškog partizanskog odreda iz obruča u [Kozaračkoj ofanzivi](Q2985697) u julu 1942; zid sa metalnim reljefima podignut je 1967. godine, dok katalog navodi 1969. Spomenik je obnovljen 2009. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Second Krajina Partisan Detachment’s breakthrough from the encirclement during the [Kozara Offensive](Q2985697) in July 1942; the wall with metal reliefs was erected in 1967, while the catalogue gives 1969. It was restored in 2009.

pazici-spomen-obiljezje.slikaPotpis: Foto Lipa, Spomenici i spomen-obilježja NOR-a u opštini Danilovgrad (2017)

pecenjevce-bista-branka-cvetkovica.adresa: Na zelenoj površini ispred Doma zdravlja
pecenjevce-bista-branka-cvetkovica.slikaPotpis: Ekipa Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcu Branku Cvetkoviću (1915-1942). Bronzana bista postavljena je na mermerom obloženom postamentu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighter Branko Cvetković (1915–1942). The bronze bust stands on a marble-clad pedestal.

pecenjevce-spomenik-palima-u-drugom-svet.adresa: U centru sela, ispred zgrade mesne kancelarije

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima iz Pečenjevca poginulim u Prvom i Drugom svetskom ratu. Spomenik Stojana Cvetkovića otkriven je 12. oktobra 1964, a tekst je napisao književnik Tomislav N. Cvetković.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters from Pečenjevce killed in World Wars I and II. Stojan Cvetković’s monument was unveiled on 12 October 1964, with a text by writer Tomislav N. Cvetković.

opis.sh: Posvećeno šesnaestorici rodoljuba streljanih na Suvači 15. jula 1942.
opis.en: Dedicated to sixteen patriots executed at Suvača on 15 July 1942.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim partizanskim borcima i žrtvama fašizma sa Kosova i Metohije. Aluminijumska grupa Ante Gržetića uklonjena je 2012, dok su postament i ostaci memorijalnog prostora na Karagaču sačuvani u ruševnom stanju.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan fighters and victims of fascism from Kosovo and Metohija. Ante Gržetić’s aluminium sculptural group was removed in 2012, leaving the pedestal and remains of the memorial grounds on Karagač Hill in a ruined state.

pepici-spomenik-formiranju-kladanjskog-n.adresa: Između sela Pepići i Pelemiši, prema granici opštine Šekovići

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto formiranja Kladanjskog partizanskog odreda. Kamena stela podignuta je 1961, povodom dvadesetogodišnjice ustanka.
opis.en: Marks the formation site of the Kladanj Partisan Detachment. The stone stele was erected in 1961 to mark the twentieth anniversary of the uprising.

pepici-spomenik-formiranju-kladanjskog-n.natpis:
NA OVOM PODRUČJU MJESECA SEPTEMBRA

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim partizanima Travničkog partizanskog odreda.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisans of the Travnik Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Severnobanatskom odredu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the North Banat Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Lackovom odredu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Lacko Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašizma i nacizma i sećanju na Drugi svetski rat. Vrt je nastao oko dve žalosne vrbe koje je Apolonija Šiftar zasadila za sinove koji se nisu vratili iz rata, a proširen je spomen-drvećem i skulpturama.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of fascism and Nazism and to remembrance of the Second World War. The garden grew around two weeping willows planted by Apolonija Šiftar for her sons who did not return from the war, and was expanded with commemorative trees and sculptures.

petkovci-spomen-kosturnica.adresa: Donja Baljkovica, uz Dom kulture, severno od puta

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima Logaške čete.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters of the Logatec Company.

petlovac-spomenik-palim-partizanima.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

petrijevci-skupna-grobnica-palih-boraca-.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković, Registar kulturnih dobara RH

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim u Prvom i Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in WWI and WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [ustanku](Q142721) naroda Korduna i Banije i partizanskoj bolnici na Petrovoj gori. Na ovom vrhu je 1942. oko 300 seljaka, naoružanih samo vilama, poginulo jurišajući na utvrđene ustaše.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [uprising](Q142721) of the people of Kordun and Banija and to the Partisan hospital on Petrova Gora. On this peak in 1942, about 300 peasants armed only with pitchforks died storming the entrenched Ustaše.

opis.sh: Nekadašnja tajna partizanska bolnica na Petrovoj gori uređena je posle rata kao memorijalni muzej sa drvenim bolničkim objektima i grobljem. Kompleks je oštećen, a nekadašnja muzejska postavka nije sačuvana u celini.
opis.en: The former secret Partisan hospital on Petrova Gora was turned into a memorial museum after the war, with wooden hospital buildings and a cemetery. The complex is damaged and requires restoration; the Yugoslav-era hospital exhibition has not survived intact.

petrova-poljana-spomen-park-5-kordunasko.adresa: Južno od Petrove Poljane, na šumskoj čistini

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto formiranja [5. kordunaške udarne brigade](Q12757165) 16. septembra 1942. Od nekadašnje memorijalne celine sa drvenom konstrukcijom sačuvan je oštećeni tenk Šerman.
opis.en: Marks the formation of the [5th Kordun Assault Brigade](Q12757165) on 16 September 1942. A damaged Sherman tank survives from the former memorial ensemble with its wooden structure.

petrovac-na-moru.adresa: Na tvrđavi Kastelo, zapadni kraj obale

opis.sh: Posvećeno Paštrovićima poginulim u balkanskim ratovima i oba svetska rata. Memorijal na tvrđavi Kastelo čine visoki obelisk i zid sa imenima poginulih.
opis.en: Dedicated to people from Paštrovići who fell in the Balkan Wars and both world wars. The memorial at Kastelo fortress comprises a tall obelisk and a wall bearing the names of the fallen.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim u Prvom i Drugom svetskom ratu; spomenik Stevana Sokolovića otkriven je za Dan borca 1963. Masivne forme planina završavaju se motivom tri puške složene u kupu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in World Wars I and II; Stevan Sokolović’s monument was unveiled for Fighters’ Day in 1963. Massive mountain-like forms culminate in three stacked rifles.

petrovcic-bista-dusana-vukasovica.adresa: Ispred OŠ „Dušan Vukasović Diogen“, Dušana Vukasovića 5

opis.sh: Katalog navodi groblje u Lužanjku iz 1953. i današnje groblje sa kosturnicom iz 1970, čiji su autori Dragiša Trifković i Nurudin Škapurović. Prenos ostataka između ta dva mesta nije potvrđen.
opis.en: The catalogue lists a cemetery in Lužanjak from 1953 and the present cemetery and ossuary from 1970, designed by Dragiša Trifković and Nurudin Škapurović. A transfer of remains between the two sites is unconfirmed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju Radovanu Radovanoviću.
opis.en: Dedicated to people's hero Radovan Radovanović.

opis.sh: Kosturnica je podignuta 1959. i obnovljena 1975. Kasnije je uz nju dodat spomenik ratu 1992–1995. i izmenjen obelisk, dok je sačuvan i zid sa zvezdom i prvobitnom posvetom.
opis.en: The ossuary was erected in 1959 and restored in 1975. A memorial to the 1992–1995 war was later added alongside and the obelisk altered, while the wall with its star and original dedication survives.

opis.sh: Obeležava zasedu partizanskih snaga u septembru 1941.
opis.en: Commemorates ambush by Partisan forces in September 1941.

opis.sh: Na mestu smrti narodnog heroja Krsta Bjeletića.
opis.en: At the place where people's hero Krsto Bjeletić died.

opis.sh: Posvećeno pedesetorici palih boraca i pet žrtava fašističkog terora.
opis.en: Dedicated to fifty fallen fighters and five victims of fascist terror.

pirot-bista-milorada-mancica-lukanjca.adresa: U parku donjeg grada Pirotske tvrđave

pirovac-spomen-kosturnica-palim-borcima.adresa: Predio Griža, uz cestu Pirovac–Stankovci lijevo, borova šuma

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora. Ploča Marka Mašića iz 1965, ranije na društvenom domu, ugrađena je u spomenik 1985; autor novije konstrukcije nije potvrđen.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror. Marko Mašić’s 1965 plaque, formerly on the community hall, was incorporated into the monument in 1985; the designer of the newer structure is unconfirmed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora streljanim 1942. godine. Prvobitna kosturnica iz 1949. zamenjena je novim obeležjem 1991; susedni spomenik ratu 1992-1995. zaseban je objekat.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror executed in 1942. The original 1949 ossuary was replaced by a new memorial in 1991; the neighbouring 1992–1995 war monument is a separate object.

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanima poginulim u Pjenovcu 21. januara 1942, među kojima su Milan Ilić Čiča Šumadijski, Slaviša Vajner Čiča i Dragan Pavlović Šilja. Spomenik je saniran 2022, a novija ploča navodi 62 imena.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisans killed in Pjenovac on 21 January 1942, including Milan Ilić Čiča Šumadijski, Slaviša Vajner Čiča and Dragan Pavlović Šilja. The memorial was repaired in 2022, and the newer plaque lists 62 names.

opis.sh: Obeležava boravak [Josipa Broza Tita](Q9161) i Vrhovnog štaba u Plahovićima tokom leta 1943. Memorijalnu celinu čine pećine i spomen-ploče, među kojima je i obeležje iz 1951.
opis.en: Marks the stay of [Josip Broz Tito](Q9161) and the Supreme Headquarters at Plahovići in the summer of 1943. The memorial area comprises caves and commemorative plaques, including a marker from 1951.

opis.sh: U kosturnici iz 1961, uz glavni put na južnom ulazu u Planu, sahranjen je 41 pali borac Pete crnogorske proleterske brigade.
opis.en: The 1961 ossuary beside the main road at the southern entrance to Plana holds 41 fallen fighters of the Fifth Montenegrin Proletarian Brigade.

opis.sh: Namenski spomen-dom iz 1982. stoji uz memorijal palim borcima NOR-a. Prema katalogu, više nije u funkciji.
opis.en: The purpose-built 1982 memorial hall stands beside the monument to fallen National Liberation War fighters. The catalogue records that it is no longer in use.

opis.sh: Posvećeno bici na Malom Rovtu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the battle at Mali Rovt.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Ivanu Čeru na Suhom sedlu.
opis.en: Dedicated to Ivan Čer at Suho Sedlo.

opis.sh: Posvećeno kuririma palim u Kramparici.
opis.en: Dedicated to couriers killed in Kramparica.

planina-pod-sumikom-partizanska-bolnisni.adresa: Pri kmetiji Lepe, Planina pod Šumikom 3, pod cesto Šmartno na Pohorju–Trije kralji

opis.sh: Obnovljena partizanska bolnica na Pohorju, građena od jeseni 1944, koja je prve ranjenike primila početkom 1945. godine. Iznad baraka nalazi se obeležje nekadašnjih grobova umrlih ranjenika, čiji su posmrtni ostaci posle rata preneti u rodna mesta.
opis.en: A restored Partisan hospital on Pohorje, built from autumn 1944 and admitting its first wounded patients in early 1945. Above the huts is a memorial marking the former graves of patients whose remains were returned to their home communities after the war.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Tomšičevoj brigadi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Tomšič Brigade.

opis.sh: Posvećeno akcijama Zvijezdanskog partizanskog odreda. Spomen-česma iz 1951. bila je u ruševinama 2011. i zamenjena je novim spomenikom 2015.
opis.en: Dedicated to actions of the Zvijezda Partisan Detachment. The 1951 memorial fountain lay in ruins in 2011 and was replaced by a new monument in 2015.

opis.sh: Posvećeno osnivanju opštinskog narodnooslobodilačkog odbora Skradin.
opis.en: Dedicated to the founding of the Skradin municipal liberation committee.

opis.sh: Posvećeno taocima streljanim kod Polsnikovog dola.
opis.en: Dedicated to the hostages executed near Polsnikov Dol.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Revirskoj četi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Revir Company.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima Turopoljskog partizanskog odreda, diverziji na aerodromima Pleso i Kurilovec 1943. i oslobođenju Zagreba 9. maja 1945.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters of the Turopolje Partisan Detachment, the 1943 sabotage of the Pleso and Kurilovec airfields and the liberation of Zagreb on 9 May 1945.

pletvar-naroden-heroj-borka-taleski-crni.natpis: Народен херој Борка Талески-Црниот / Народен херој Лазо Филиповски-Лавски

opis.sh: Posvećeno diviziji „Garibaldi“.
opis.en: Dedicated to the "Garibaldi" Division.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima NOVJ i žrtvama fašističkog terora iz Ploča i okolnih mesta. Memorijalni zid u parku nosi imena stradalih i naselja iz kojih su poticali.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Yugoslav Partisan fighters and victims of fascist terror from Ploče and nearby settlements. The memorial wall in the park bears the names of the victims and their home settlements.

opis.sh: Obeležava odlazak vojne komande u Birač 1941.
opis.en: Commemorates departure of the military command to Birač in 1941.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i civilnim žrtvama fašizma iz Plovanije i okolnog dela Istre. Tri betonska krila spomenika ukrašena su mozaicima sa prizorima istarskog života, dok memorijalne ploče čuvaju imena stradalih.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and civilian victims of fascism from Plovanija and the surrounding part of Istria. The monument’s three concrete fins bear mosaics depicting Istrian life, while memorial plaques preserve the victims’ names.

poculica-spomenik-palim-borcima.adresa: Južni ulaz u selo, zapadno od puta R441, kod prodavnica

opis.sh: Zajednička grobnica sedmorice palih boraca obeležena je 27. jula 1956. Nalazi se uz glavni put na južnom ulazu u selo; očišćena je u avgustu 2020.
opis.en: The collective grave of seven fallen fighters was marked on 27 July 1956. It lies beside the main road at the southern village entrance and was cleaned in August 2020.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima i žrtvama rata iz mojkovačkog kraja, na mestu streljanja zarobljenih partizana 1942. i 1943. Kompleks obuhvata spomenik, grobnice streljanih i posmrtne ostatke boraca iz drugih krajeva koji su poginuli na području Mojkovca.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and war victims from the Mojkovac area, at the site where captured Partisans were executed in 1942 and 1943. The complex includes a monument, graves of those executed and the remains of fighters from other regions who fell around Mojkovac.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Janezu Finžgaru i Milanu Ovseniku.
opis.en: Dedicated to Janez Finžgar and Milan Ovsenik.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Janku Špendalu i Janku Rozmanu.
opis.en: Dedicated to Janko Špendal and Janko Rozman.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borbi i stradanju naroda Moslavine u Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the struggle and suffering of the people of Moslavina in World War II.

opis.sh: Posvećeno mornarima i pomorcima poginulim u Drugom svetskom ratu; otkriven 10. septembra 1962, na 20. godišnjicu osnivanja [partizanske mornarice](Q18404751).
opis.en: Dedicated to the sailors and seamen who died in World War II; unveiled on 10 September 1962, the 20th anniversary of the founding of the [Partisan navy](Q18404751).

opis.sh: Spomenik u groblju sa imenima 23 poginula borca, taoca i žrtve fašizma.
opis.en: A cemetery memorial listing 23 fallen fighters, hostages and victims of fascism.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašizma iz Vavte vasi i okolnih sela; dve ploče nose 54 imena.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascism from Vavta vas and nearby villages; two plaques bear 54 names.

opis.sh: Nekadašnja postavka u Spomen-domu Prvog mornaričkog odreda prikazivala je nastanak i razvoj partizanske mornarice. Zgrada je 2012. prenamenjena za turistički ured i bioskop; sačuvani su memorijalni mozaik i bista Milana Kurtića, ali muzej više ne radi.
opis.en: The former exhibition in the 1st Naval Detachment Memorial Hall presented the origins and development of the Partisan navy. The building became a tourist office and cinema in 2012; its memorial mosaic and bust of Milan Kurtić survive, but the museum no longer operates.

opis.sh: Posvećeno stanovnicima Podgorca poginulim u ratovima 1912-1918 i 1941-1945.
opis.en: Dedicated to residents of Podgorac who fell in the wars of 1912-1918 and 1941-1945.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima NOB na Valja Rnžu.
opis.en: Dedicated to WWII fighters at Valja Rnž.

opis.sh: Posvećeno 25 boraca iz Momišića poginulih u NOR-u 1941-1945.
