opis.en: Dedicated to fighters from Svrljig killed in the liberation of the town and victims of fascist terror. Aleksandar Šakić's bronze fighter was unveiled in 1950.

opis.sh: Posvećeno formiranju Prve račanske partizanske čete 3. avgusta 1941.
opis.en: Dedicated to the formation of the First Rača Partisan Company on 3 August 1941.

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanima i seljačkim ustanicima.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Partisans and the peasant rebels.

opis.sh: Spomenik NOB pored puta Bihać-Vrtoče, kod Teočaka. Izvor beleži oštećenja i pominje ranije obeležje koje je postojalo pre 1960, ali godina sadašnjeg spomenika nije utvrđena.
opis.en: A National Liberation Struggle memorial beside the Bihać–Vrtoče road near Teočak. The source records damage and mentions an earlier memorial existing before 1960, but the present monument’s construction date is unknown.

opis.sh: Spomen-soba nekadašnje partizanske bolnice u kući Sime Stanarevića u Stanarevićima kod Teočaka. Današnja postavka, mogućnost obilaska i tačan položaj kuće nisu potvrđeni.
opis.en: A memorial room for a former Partisan hospital in Simo Stanarević’s house at Stanarevići near Teočak. The present exhibition, visitor access and precise location of the house have not been confirmed.

opis.sh: Kosturnica 63 pala borca.
opis.en: Ossuary of 63 fallen fighters.

tetovo.adresa: Булевар „Маршал Тито“/„Илирија“, кај Центарот за култура „Иљо Антески - Смок“

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima NOB-a, sa figurom [žene borca](Q192045) i zasebnim bronzanim reljefom iz iste kompozicije „Pobeda“. Delo Borke Avramove postavljeno je 1961. godine pred tadašnjom zgradom opštine.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan fighters, with a [woman fighter](Q192045) and a separate bronze relief forming the composition “Victory”. Borka Avramova’s work was installed in 1961 in front of the former municipal building.

opis.sh: Spomen-kuća porodice Jovanovski čuva sećanje na osnivanje [Komunističke partije Makedonije](Q1563709) i prvi sastanak njenog Centralnog komiteta 19. marta 1943. Mala muzejska postavka otvorena je 1968. u obnovljenoj kući.
opis.en: The Jovanovski family memorial house commemorates the founding of the [Communist Party of Macedonia](Q1563709) and the first meeting of its Central Committee on 19 March 1943. A small museum exhibition opened in the restored house in 1968.

tican-spomen-podrucje.adresa: Kod raskrižja Tićan, u blizini Višnjana

opis.sh: Spomen-područje u sećanje na 84 borca i civila poginula u sukobu sa nemačkim snagama kod Tićana 11. septembra 1943. godine. Zdenko Sila oblikovao je sedam kamenih blokova sa urezanim motivima zemljoradničkog alata.
opis.en: A memorial area commemorating 84 fighters and civilians killed in clashes with German forces near Tićan on 11 September 1943. Zdenko Sila designed seven stone blocks engraved with farming-tool motifs.

tihaljina-kosturnica-palih-boraca-dalmat.adresa: Kod ruševina nekadašnjeg Doma kulture; tačka je približna, prilaz zarastao.

opis.sh: Prema katalogu, prilaz kosturnici je potpuno zarastao i neprohodan.
opis.en: According to the catalogue, access to the ossuary is completely overgrown and impassable.

tijanje-spomen-park.adresa: U školskom dvorištu, u centru sela

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima NOB i žrtvama fašizma, među kojima je Srećko Ikodimović, poginuo kod Kraljeva 1941. U školskom dvorištu nalaze se njegova bista i spomen-česma iz 1958.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan fighters and victims of fascism, including Srećko Ikodimović, killed near Kraljevo in 1941. His bust and a memorial fountain from 1958 stand in the schoolyard.

opis.sh: Prvobitni spomenik iz 1951. ispred čitaonice zamenjen je obližnjim spomenikom Anta Golubičića iz 1964. Kasnije su obnovljeni plato i potporni zidovi i dodata manja ploča.
opis.en: The original 1951 monument outside the reading room was replaced nearby by Anto Golubičić’s 1964 monument. The terrace and retaining walls were subsequently renovated and a small plaque added.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i civilnim žrtvama fašizma iz titelskog kraja, među njima i ubijenima u januarskoj raciji 1942. Betonski spomenik Jovana Soldatovića na obali Tise čine tri zakrivljena kraka usmerena jedan prema drugom.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and civilian victims of fascism from the Titel area, including those killed in the January 1942 raids. Jovan Soldatović’s concrete monument on the Tisa riverbank consists of three curved arms pointing towards one another.

opis.sh: Posvećeno boravcima [Josipa Broza Tita](Q9161) na Brijunima od 1947. do 1979. godine. Izložba, otvorena 1984, fotografijama i dokumentima prikazuje njegov državni rad, susrete sa stranim delegacijama i svakodnevni život na ostrvima.
opis.en: Dedicated to [Josip Broz Tito’s](Q9161) stays on Brijuni from 1947 to 1979. Opened in 1984, the exhibition uses photographs and documents to present his work as head of state, meetings with foreign delegations and everyday life on the islands.

opis.sh: Etno-muzej oko rodne kuće Josipa Broza Tita, ispred koje je 1948. postavljen njegov spomenik.
opis.en: Open-air museum around the birth house of Josip Broz Tito, in front of which his statue was erected in 1948.

tito-s-cave-museum-at-drvar.adresa: Pećina iznad kompleksa Muzeja „25. maj“, preko reke Unac.

opis.sh: Posvećeno boravku Vrhovnog štaba sa Titom u ovoj pećini početkom 1944. i [nemačkom desantu na Drvar](Q931125) 25. maja 1944, tokom koga se Tito iz nje izvukao.
opis.en: Dedicated to the stay of the Supreme Headquarters with Tito in this cave in early 1944 and to the [German airborne raid on Drvar](Q931125) on 25 May 1944, during which Tito escaped from it.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Josipu Brozu Titu](Q9161), vođi jugoslovenskih partizana i predsedniku Jugoslavije. Spomenik na Titovom trgu postavljen je 1977. kao uvećana verzija Augustinčićeve skulpture iz Kumrovca.
opis.en: Dedicated to [Josip Broz Tito](Q9161), leader of the Yugoslav Partisans and president of Yugoslavia. Erected on Tito Square in 1977, the monument is an enlarged version of Augustinčić’s sculpture in Kumrovec.

tito-square-in-velenje.autor: Antun Augustinčić & Vladimir Herljević & Ivan Pavić

tivat-3.adresa: Pored zgrade stare osnovne škole, uz glavni put

opis.sh: Posvećeno Tivćanima poginulim u Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi, sa 78 uklesanih imena. Spomenik je podignut 29. novembra 1951.
opis.en: Dedicated to the people of Tivat who died in the People’s Liberation War, with 78 names inscribed. The monument was erected on 29 November 1951.

tivat-bista-save-kovacevica.adresa: Zbirka pomorskog nasljeđa, Porto Montenegro; položaj unutar muzeja zabeležen u katalogu iz 2019.
tivat-bista-save-kovacevica.slikaPotpis: Magdalena Radunović & Bratislav Radunović, Montemisija / TO Tivat, 2019

opis.sh: Posvećeno narodnom heroju [Savi Kovačeviću](Q821495). Bronzana bista iz 1981. prikazana je u katalogu iz 2019. kao deo Zbirke pomorskog nasljeđa.
opis.en: Dedicated to People’s Hero [Sava Kovačević](Q821495). The 1981 bronze bust is documented in the 2019 catalogue as part of the Naval Heritage Collection.

tivat-spomenik-objesenim-rodoljubima.adresa: Prekoputa stare osnovne škole, uz lokalni put
tivat-spomenik-objesenim-rodoljubima.slikaPotpis: Magdalena Radunović & Bratislav Radunović, Montemisija / TO Tivat, 2019

opis.sh: Posvećeno petorici saradnika Narodnooslobodilačkog pokreta koje su nemački okupatori i domaći saradnici obesili na ovom mestu 22. aprila 1944. Spomenik je podignut 22. aprila 1956.
opis.en: Dedicated to five supporters of the People’s Liberation Movement hanged here by German occupiers and local collaborators on 22 April 1944. The monument was erected on 22 April 1956.

tivat-spomenik-spasicu-i-maseri.adresa: U Velikom gradskom parku, uz fontanu
tivat-spomenik-spasicu-i-maseri.slikaPotpis: Magdalena Radunović & Bratislav Radunović, Montemisija / TO Tivat, 2019

opis.sh: Posvećeno Milanu Spasiću i [Sergeju Mašeri](Q1280314), koji su 17. aprila 1941. potopili razarač „Zagreb“ da ne padne u ruke italijanskom okupatoru i pritom poginuli. Spomenik čine obelisk, dve bronzane biste i reljef potapanja broda.
opis.en: Dedicated to Milan Spasić and [Sergej Mašera](Q1280314), who died on 17 April 1941 while scuttling the destroyer Zagreb to prevent its capture by the Italian occupiers. The monument comprises an obelisk, two bronze busts and a relief depicting the ship’s sinking.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [bici na Sutjesci](Q1419973) iz maja i juna 1943, u kojoj su partizani u Dolini heroja uz velike gubitke probili nemački obruč. Kompleks je deo Nacionalnog parka Sutjeska.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [Battle of the Sutjeska](Q1419973) of May and June 1943, in which the Partisans broke through the German encirclement in the Valley of Heroes at great cost. The complex is part of Sutjeska National Park.

opis.sh: Grob [Nurije Pozderca](Q12756368), umrlog od rana u bici na Sutjesci. Prvobitno obeležje postojalo je pre 1975, a kasniju skulpturu izradio je Miodrag Živković 1987. godine.
opis.en: The grave of [Nurija Pozderac](Q12756368), who died of wounds sustained in the Battle of the Sutjeska. An earlier memorial existed before 1975; Miodrag Živković created the later sculpture in 1987.

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto gde je Josip Broz Tito ranjen 9. juna 1943. godine tokom [bitke na Sutjesci](Q1419973). Prvobitno obeležje potiče iz 1975, a sadašnje skulpture Miodraga Živkovića postavljene su 1987.
opis.en: Marks the place where Josip Broz Tito was wounded on 9 June 1943 during the [Battle of the Sutjeska](Q1419973). The original memorial dates from 1975; the present sculptures by Miodrag Živković were installed in 1987.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Savi Kovačeviću](Q821495), poginulom u bici na Sutjesci. Prvobitno obeležje podignuto je 1951, a Miodrag Živković oblikovao je sadašnju celinu 1987. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to [Sava Kovačević](Q821495), killed in the Battle of the Sutjeska. The original memorial was erected in 1951; Miodrag Živković designed the present ensemble in 1987.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima [Bitke na Sutjesci](Q1419973) 1943. godine. Namenski memorijalni prostor Ranka Radovića sadrži upisana imena boraca i ciklus zidnih slika Krste Hegedušića.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters killed in the [Battle of Sutjeska](Q1419973) in 1943. Ranko Radović’s purpose-built memorial space contains the fighters’ inscribed names and a cycle of murals by Krsto Hegedušić.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Drugoj dalmatinskoj brigadi](Q117668). Prvobitno obeležje postojalo je pre 1964, a sadašnja skulptura Miodraga Živkovića postavljena je 1989.
opis.en: Dedicated to the [2nd Dalmatian Brigade](Q117668). An earlier memorial existed before 1964; the present sculpture by Miodrag Živković was installed in 1989.

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto partizanske bolnice na Dragoš sedlu; skulpturu je izradio Miodrag Živković 1987. godine.
opis.en: Marks the site of a Partisan hospital at Dragoš sedlo; Miodrag Živković created the sculpture in 1987.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Kragujevačkom bataljonu i borcima Fočanske omladinske čete poginulim na Borovnu u [bici na Sutjesci](Q1419973). Ranije obeležje postojalo je pre 1975, a sadašnju skulpturu izradio je Miodrag Živković 1989. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Kragujevac Battalion and Foča Youth Company fighters killed at Borovno during the [Battle of the Sutjeska](Q1419973). An earlier memorial existed before 1975; Miodrag Živković created the present sculpture in 1989.

opis.sh: Obeležje Prvoj dalmatinskoj brigadi podignuto je 1953. Ne treba ga mešati sa većom Živkovićevom kompozicijom posvećenom Drugoj dalmatinskoj brigadi na Donjim Barama.
opis.en: The First Dalmatian Brigade memorial was erected in 1953. It is distinct from Živković’s larger composition to the Second Dalmatian Brigade at Donje Bare.

opis.sh: Natpis iz 1958. uklesan je u prirodnu stenu južno od Doline heroja. Posvećen je palim borcima Desete hercegovačke proleterske brigade.
opis.en: The 1958 inscription was carved into a natural rock face south of the Valley of Heroes. It commemorates fallen fighters of the Tenth Herzegovinian Proletarian Brigade.

opis.sh: Grob nepoznatog borca Gupčeve brigade.
opis.en: Grave of an unknown fighter of the Gubec Brigade.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim meštanima Toplog Dola.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fallen residents of Topli Do.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima i umrlima u logorima.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters and those who died in camps.

opis.sh: Spomenik narodnim herojima, među kojima su [Darinka Radović](Q12956732), [Sofija Ristić](Q12759065), [Milan Blagojević](Q1567421) i [Milić Radovanović Mladen](Q61130496); stoji ispred Vinogradareve kuće kod Oplenca.
opis.en: Monument to people's heroes, among them [Darinka Radović](Q12956732), [Sofija Ristić](Q12759065), [Milan Blagojević](Q1567421) and [Milić Radovanović Mladen](Q61130496); it stands in front of the Vinegrower's House near Oplenac.

opis.sh: Posvećeno majkama i ćerkama Šumadije, među kojima je [Darinka Radović](Q12956732); stoji ispred Vinogradareve kuće kod Oplenca.
opis.en: Dedicated to the mothers and daughters of Šumadija, among them [Darinka Radović](Q12956732); it stands in front of the Vinegrower's House near Oplenac.

topolje-spomenik-palim-borcima.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

topolovica-skupna-grobnica-zrtava-popadi.adresa: Na rubu šume Popadija, sjeverno od sela

topolovo-spomen-obiljezje.adresa: Topolovo (Mosori), planina Topolovo; mesto smotre bataljona „Bijeli Pavle“ 20. novembra 1941. Ne koristiti Google tačku naselja kao tačku spomenika.
topolovo-spomen-obiljezje.slikaPotpis: Foto Lipa, Spomenici i spomen-obilježja NOR-a u opštini Danilovgrad (2017)

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Šercerove brigade.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters of the Šercer Brigade.

opis.sh: Nekadašnji muzej obeležavao je [Treće zasedanje ZAVNOH-a](Q17490543), održano u Topuskom 8. i 9. maja 1944, na kojem je ZAVNOH proglašen najvišim organom državne vlasti Hrvatske. Zgrada u kojoj je zasedanje održano uništena je 1991, a nekadašnja postavka nije dostupna.
opis.en: The former museum commemorated the [Third Session of ZAVNOH](Q17490543), held in Topusko on 8-9 May 1944, which declared ZAVNOH the highest organ of state authority in Croatia. The meeting building was destroyed in 1991, and the former exhibition is no longer accessible.

torjanci-spomenik-nob.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim Norcima i žrtvama fašizma.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fallen of Norci and victims of fascism.

opis.sh: Kosturnica devetorice palih boraca i 11 žrtava fašističkog terora.
opis.en: Ossuary of 9 fallen fighters and 11 victims of fascist terror.

trata-pri-velesovem-spomenik-zrtvam-za-s.natpis: Za socializem in zmago revolucije so žrtvovali svoja življenja

opis.sh: Spomen-kosturnica „Majka“ potiče iz 1961; današnju formu iz 1974. potpisuju arhitekta Juraj Neidhart i vajar Zdenko Grgić. Oštećena je u martu 1993. i obnovljena 2014. radom lokalnog vajara Dejana Pranjkovića.
opis.en: The Mother Memorial Ossuary originated in 1961; architect Juraj Neidhart and sculptor Zdenko Grgić designed its present 1974 form. It was damaged in March 1993 and restored in 2014 by local sculptor Dejan Pranjković.

opis.sh: Skup obeležja Ivi Loli Ribaru, Josipu Mažaru Šoši i Taibu Dautoviću na Trgu Republike. Mažarova bista iz 1975. teško je oštećena, dok je sadašnja Taibova bista kasnija replika originala iz 1981, verovatno postavljena 2010.
opis.en: A group of memorials to Ivo Lola Ribar, Josip Mažar Šoša and Taib Dautović on Republic Square. Mažar’s 1975 bust is severely damaged, while the present Taib bust is a later replica of the 1981 original, probably installed in 2010.

opis.sh: Grobnica 23 borca poginula pri oslobođenju Travnika; natpis beleži 1. maj 1947, dok katalog navodi 1951. Kasnija forma postojala je pre 1979, a grobnica je obnovljena 2018.
opis.en: Grave of 23 fighters killed in the liberation of Travnik; the inscription dates it to 1 May 1947, while the catalogue gives 1951. Its later form existed before 1979 and was restored in 2018.

opis.sh: Posvećeno taocima streljanim u Sodolu.
opis.en: Dedicated to hostages executed in Sodol.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima, taocima i žrtvama internacije.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters, hostages and victims of internment.

trbuk-bista-dusanke-vajic.adresa: Ispred područne škole Ozren, oko 80 m severno od Partizanskog groblja.

opis.sh: Bista Drage Handanovića iz 1969. stoji ispred područne škole Ozren, nekadašnje škole Dušanka Vajić. Tačka pokazuje približan prostor škole severno od Partizanskog groblja, a ne precizan položaj biste.
opis.en: Drago Handanović’s 1969 bust stands outside the Ozren branch school, formerly named Dušanka Vajić. The point indicates the approximate school area north of the Partisan cemetery rather than the bust’s exact position.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim u borbi protiv fašizma; figuralnu kompoziciju izradio je Nandor Glid 1953. Spomenik obuhvata i kosturnicu, u koju je 1961. sahranjeno još 75 palih boraca.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in the struggle against fascism; Nandor Glid created the figurative group in 1953. The monument also includes an ossuary, where another 75 fallen fighters were interred in 1961.

opis.sh: Prvobitna bista Vase Miskina Crnog potiče iz perioda 1969, a njen autor je Ejub Begović. Zamenska bista u gradskom parku otkrivena je 2008; autor zamene nije potvrđen.
opis.en: The original bust dates from 1969 and was made by Ejub Begović. A replacement was unveiled in the town park in 2008; the replacement’s maker has not been confirmed.

opis.sh: Spomenik NOB iz 1956. kasnije je uključen u park posvećen ratu 1992-1995. godine. Posveta ovog zapisa ostaje vezana za NOB.
opis.en: The 1956 National Liberation Struggle memorial was later incorporated into a park dedicated to the 1992–1995 war. This record concerns the WWII memorial.

tri-cesmi-spomen-park.adresa: На источниот влез во селото, јужно од пристапниот пат

opis.sh: Memorijalni prostor posvećen poginulim borcima. Celinu čine bista, spomen-česma i kameno obeležje na uređenom platou.
opis.en: A memorial space dedicated to fallen fighters. The site comprises a bust, a memorial fountain and a stone marker on a landscaped platform.

tribunj-sovlje-spomenik-partizanskoj-pom.adresa: Uvala Sovlje, borova šuma lijevo od puta

tribunj-spomen-kosturnica-palim-borcima-.adresa: Vrh brda Sv. Nikola zapadno od mjesta

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror.

opis.sh: Na mestu gde su nacifašisti 29. maja 1944. obesili taoce.
opis.en: At the site where the Nazi-Fascists hanged hostages on 29 May 1944.

opis.sh: Nacistički sabirni i logor smrti od 1943, jedini sa krematorijumom u Italiji; danas nacionalni spomenik i gradski muzej. Ovde su stradali i mnogi Slovenci, Hrvati i partizani.
opis.en: A Nazi transit and extermination camp from 1943, the only one in Italy with a crematorium; now a national monument and civic museum. Many Slovenes, Croats and Partisans died here.

opis.sh: Nekadašnji muzej bio je posvećen Prvoj ženskoj partizanskoj četi, formiranoj u Trnavcu 25. avgusta 1942. od 74 partizanke. Otvoren je 1977, ali više ne radi i ne treba ga planirati kao muzej dostupan za obilazak.
opis.en: The former museum was dedicated to the First Women’s Partisan Company, formed in Trnavac on 25 August 1942 with 74 women. It opened in 1977 but no longer operates and should not be planned as an accessible museum visit.

opis.sh: Obeležava više događaja u Trnjacima tokom NOB.
opis.en: Commemorates several events in Trnjaci during the People’s Liberation Struggle.

trnovac-spomen-kompleks-slana-banja.adresa: Memorijalni deo šetališta Slana Banja, ispod Gradine

opis.sh: Memorijalna celina od 1959. obuhvata grobnicu, obeležja borcima i žrtvama fašizma, umetnička dela i aleju bista. Ismet Mujezinović, Dragiša Trifković i Pero Jelisić autori su različitih delova; njihove godine i kasnija proširenja nisu godina jednog zajedničkog spomenika.
opis.en: Developed from 1959, the memorial complex includes a collective grave, memorials to fighters and victims of fascism, artworks and a bust avenue. Ismet Mujezinović, Dragiša Trifković and Pero Jelisić made different elements; their individual dates and later additions do not date one single shared monument.

opis.sh: Kosturnica oko 160 partizana podignuta je 1960. uz skulpturu Petra Krstića, a celina dograđena 1973. Skulptura je ukradena posle 1995, zbog čega je objekat 2015. uklonjen sa privremene liste nacionalnih spomenika; preostala kosturnica je oštećena.
opis.en: The ossuary for around 160 Partisans was built in 1960 with a sculpture by Petar Krstić and expanded in 1973. The sculpture was stolen after 1995, leading to the site’s removal from the provisional national monuments list in 2015; the remaining ossuary is damaged.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama bugarskih fašista.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the Bulgarian fascists.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima i žrtvama rudinsko-trepačkog kraja iz oslobodilačkih ratova, uključujući narodnooslobodilačku borbu i žrtve fašističkog terora 1941-1945. Granitna kompozicija Slobodana Vukajlovića ima 22 stuba, memorijalne ploče i kosturnicu iza spomenika.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters and victims from the Rudine–Trepča area in the liberation wars, including the Partisan struggle and victims of fascist terror in 1941–1945. Slobodan Vukajlović’s granite composition has 22 columns, memorial plaques and an ossuary behind the monument.

trubjela.natpis: Palim za slobodu / Zahvalni građani rudinsko-trepačke opštine

trubjela-spomenik-u-trubjeli.slikaPotpis: Marija Nikčević, StoryMap Mapa spomenika NOB

opis.sh: Posvećeno taocima streljanim u Čegeljšama.
opis.en: Dedicated to the hostages executed in Čegeljše.

opis.sh: Posvećeno logoru čete Bože Vidasa Vuka.
opis.en: Dedicated to the camp of Božo Vidas Vuk's company.

opis.sh: Spomen-prostor sa pločama posvećenim palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora iz 1966. Naknadno su dodate i ploče veteranima Prvog svetskog rata i rata 1992-1995.
opis.en: A memorial space with plaques dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror, dating from 1966. Plaques to veterans of World War I and the 1992-1995 war were subsequently added.

tulovo-spomenik-zrtvama-fasistickog-tero.adresa: Crveni breg, u ataru sela Tulovo
tulovo-spomenik-zrtvama-fasistickog-tero.slikaPotpis: Ekipa Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

opis.sh: Posvećeno trojici boraca Kukavičkog partizanskog odreda poginulim u blizini 5. novembra 1941. i meštanima Tulova koje su bugarske snage istog dana streljale na ovom mestu. Spomenik je podignut 6. novembra 1983.
opis.en: Dedicated to three fighters of the Kukavica Partisan Detachment killed nearby on 5 November 1941 and villagers of Tulovo executed here by Bulgarian forces that day. The memorial was erected on 6 November 1983.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima i borkinjama NOB i žrtvama fašizma.
opis.en: Dedicated to WWII fighters, men and women, and victims of fascism.

opis.sh: Posvećeno herojima palim u Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to heroes killed in WWII.

turekovac-bista-mose-pijade.slikaPotpis: Ekipa Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

turija-spomenik-na-mjestu-smrti-mehe-tub.adresa: Istočno od puta iz Turije prema Semićima

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanu Mehi Tubiću (1892-1943), poginulom na ovom mestu 20. novembra 1943. godine. U oktobru 2018. zabeleženo je da je spomenik znatno zarastao u rastinje.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisan fighter Meho Tubić (1892-1943), killed at this spot on 20 November 1943. In October 2018, the memorial was recorded as heavily overgrown.

opis.sh: Spomen-kompleks obuhvata obeležje borcima iz oko 1965, kasniji spomenik iz 1987. i obeležje žrtvama fašističkog terora iz 1999. U istom prostoru su partizansko groblje i zasebna posveta ratu 1992-1995.
opis.en: The complex includes a fighters’ memorial dating from around 1965, a later monument from 1987 and a memorial to victims of fascist terror from 1999. The site also contains a Partisan cemetery and a separate dedication to the 1992-1995 war.

tuzla-alley-freedom-park.adresa: Ceremonijalni plato na šetalištu Slana Banja

opis.sh: Spomenik u obliku razvijenih zastava posvećen je jedinicama NOVJ koje su učestvovale u oslobađanju Tuzle. Na njemu su ploče sa nazivima brigada i odreda.
opis.en: The monument, shaped as unfurled flags, commemorates the Yugoslav partisan units that fought to liberate Tuzla. Its plaques bear the names of brigades and detachments.

tuzla-dolovi.adresa: Uz put pored voćnjaka na Pločniku

opis.sh: Obeležava odlazak Oblasnog vojnog štaba iz Tuzle na Birač 1941. godine. Spomenik na Pločniku podignut je 1981.
opis.en: Marks the departure of the Regional Military Headquarters from Tuzla to Birač in 1941. The monument at Pločnik was erected in 1981.

tuzla-husino-miner-s.adresa: Park kod Bosanskog kulturnog centra, Bosne Srebrene 60

opis.sh: Posvećeno rudarima palim u Husinskoj buni 1920. i narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi 1941-1945, što izričito piše na postamentu. Ivan Sabolić izradio je skulpturu rudara koji odbacuje alat i uzima pušku; otkrivena je 27. jula 1956.
opis.en: Dedicated to miners killed in the 1920 Husino uprising and the 1941-1945 People’s Liberation Struggle, as explicitly stated on the pedestal. Ivan Sabolić made the miner discarding his tools and taking up a rifle; it was unveiled on 27 July 1956.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Moluhe i Solane Tuzla.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters from Moluhe and the Tuzla salt works.

tuzla-spomen-grob.adresa: Ulica Mitra Trifunovića Uče 65, uz sportski teren

opis.sh: Zajednička grobnica streljanih revolucionara Kreke Envera Šiljka, Rudolfa Vikića i Meme Suljetovića. Spomenik iz 1946. obnovljen je do oktobra 2010.
opis.en: The shared tomb of the executed Kreka revolutionaries Enver Šiljak, Rudolf Vikić and Memo Suljetović. The 1946 memorial had been restored by October 2010.

opis.sh: Spomen-park uređen je 1949. uz rad Ismeta Mujezinovića i dograđen 1961; sadržao je ploče, spomen-dom i česmu. Spomen-kuća je kasnije srušena i na njenom mestu je košarkaški teren, ali to nije dokaz nestanka cele parkovske celine.
opis.en: The memorial park was established in 1949 with work by Ismet Mujezinović and expanded in 1961; it included plaques, a memorial hall and a fountain. The memorial house was later demolished and replaced by a basketball court, which does not establish the disappearance of the entire park.

opis.sh: Spomenik „Knjiga“ Pere Jelisića iz 1974. posvećen je profesorima i učenicima palim u NOR-u. Nalazi se kod Gimnazije „Meša Selimović“.
opis.en: Pero Jelisić’s 1974 Book monument commemorates teachers and students killed in the National Liberation War. It stands at Meša Selimović Grammar School.

tuzla-spomenik-suza.adresa: Turalibegova ulica, preko puta zgrade MUP-a, na mestu nekadašnje železničke stanice

opis.sh: Posvećeno građanima Tuzle koji su od 1941. do 1944. odvođeni sa nekadašnje železničke stanice u nacističke logore. Skulptura u obliku suze rad je Pere Jelisića.
opis.en: Dedicated to citizens of Tuzla deported from the former railway station to Nazi camps between 1941 and 1944. The teardrop-shaped sculpture is the work of Pero Jelisić.

opis.sh: Na Slanoj banji izložene su biste [Josipa Broza Tita](Q9161) i narodnih heroja, među kojima su brojni primerci preneti iz drugih delova Tuzle. Biste su radovi različitih vajara i ne potiču sve iz iste godine.
opis.en: Slana Banja displays busts of [Josip Broz Tito](Q9161) and national heroes, including many relocated from other parts of Tuzla. The busts are by different sculptors and do not all share the same date.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima Tamnave.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters of Tamnava.

ugljes-ploca-djurkovicu-i-milanovicu.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

opis.sh: Spomen-kosturnica iz Starog Ugljevika potiče iz 1955; zbog širenja rudnika podignuta je replika 2009. i preneti su posmrtni ostaci boraca. Original je još postojao na snimcima 2017-2018; tačan datum njegovog kasnijeg uklanjanja nije potvrđen.
opis.en: The memorial ossuary at Stari Ugljevik originated in 1955; mining expansion prompted a replica in 2009 and the reburial of the fighters’ remains. The original was still visible in 2017-2018 imagery; its precise subsequent demolition date is unconfirmed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Mateju Koblaru na Komni.
opis.en: Dedicated to Matej Koblar on Komna.

ulcinj-freedom.adresa: Pristanska stijena, Pinješ, iznad Male plaže

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i civilnim žrtvama ulcinjskog kraja u narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi. Četiri betonske forme nalik krilima uzdižu se na Pristanskoj stijeni iznad Male plaže, kao središte zamišljenog memorijalnog kompleksa.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and civilian victims from the Ulcinj area during the Partisan struggle. Four wing-like concrete forms rise on Pristanska stijena above Mala Plaža beach as the centrepiece of a planned memorial complex.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Romima ubijenim u ustaškom [logoru Jasenovac](Q155032). Celina obuhvata istorijsko romsko groblje sa masovnim grobnicama i noviji memorijalni centar.
opis.en: Dedicated to Roma murdered in the Ustaša [Jasenovac concentration camp](Q155032). The site comprises the historic Roma cemetery with mass graves and a more recent memorial centre.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima socijalističke revolucije iz Utrga.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters of the socialist revolution from Utrg.

uzelci-spomenik-palim-borcima.adresa: Alongside old road to Bosanski Petrovac

opis.sh: Spomen-kosturnica iz 1958. sa posmrtnim ostacima 230 boraca i rodoljuba iz Užica i okoline, na mestu gde su 1941. sahranjeni borci poginuli na Drežničkoj gradini.
opis.en: Memorial ossuary from 1958 holding the remains of 230 fighters and patriots from Užice and its surroundings, where fighters killed at Drežnička Gradina were buried in 1941.

opis.sh: Posvećeno ustanku 1941. i Užičkoj republici, kada su u Užicu bili Vrhovni štab i Tito; muzej je nastao kao Muzej ustanka 1941.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 1941 uprising and the Republic of Užice, when the Supreme Headquarters and Tito were based in the town; the museum began as the Museum of the 1941 Uprising.

uzice-spomenik-josipu-brozu-titu.adresa: Iza Narodnog muzeja; 1991. premešten sa Trga partizana

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Josipu Brozu Titu](Q9161); delo Frana Kršinića prvobitno je postavljeno na Trgu partizana 1962. godine. Godine 1991. premešteno je u dvorište Narodnog muzeja.
opis.en: Dedicated to [Josip Broz Tito](Q9161); Frano Kršinić’s work was originally installed on Partisans’ Square in 1962. In 1991 it was moved to the courtyard of the National Museum.

uzice-spomenik-poginulima-u-fabrici-oruz.slikaPotpis: Baština Užica / Narodni muzej Užice, Hronologija izlaganja skulpture u Srbiji

opis.sh: Posvećeno radnicima i građanima poginulim u eksploziji partizanske fabrike oružja 22. novembra 1941.
opis.en: Dedicated to workers and citizens killed in the explosion of the Partisan arms factory on 22 November 1941.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima i drugim žrtvama NOB.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters and other WWII victims.

vagan-spomenik-palim-borcima-i-zrtvama-f.adresa: To left of Glamoč-Bosansko Grahovo main road

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama koje su Italijani streljali u maju 1942.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims shot by the Italians in May 1942.

opis.sh: Obeležava prvu borbu Cetinskog partizanskog odreda u avgustu 1941.
opis.en: Commemorates first battle of the Cetinska Partisan Detachment in August 1941.

opis.sh: Spomenik palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora podignut je 1977. kod osnovne škole. Zasebno obeležje novijem ratu dodato je 2000.
opis.en: The monument to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror was erected by the primary school in 1977. A separate memorial to a later war was added in 2000.

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Dragojlu Dudiću](Q1565909); delo Vide Jocić preneto je iz škole u Mionici u park na Jadru, gde je zamenilo njegovu bistu. Razlikuje se od spomenika Ota Loga na Gradskom trgu.
opis.en: Dedicated to [Dragojlo Dudić](Q1565909); Vida Jocić’s sculpture was transferred from a school in Mionica to the park in Jadar, replacing his bust. It is distinct from Oto Logo’s monument on the City Square.

valjevo-dudic.adresa: Gradski trg, kod zgrade Gradske skupštine

opis.sh: Posvećeno [Dragojlu Dudiću](Q1565909), prvom predsedniku Narodnooslobodilačkog odbora Srbije. Ovo je spomenik Ota Loga na Gradskom trgu, različit od rada Vide Jocić u parku na Jadru.
opis.en: Dedicated to [Dragojlo Dudić](Q1565909), the first president of Serbia’s People’s Liberation Committee. This is Oto Logo’s monument on the City Square, distinct from Vida Jocić’s sculpture in the park in Jadar.

opis.sh: U parku na Jadru nalaze se biste narodnih heroja i revolucionara valjevskog kraja, postavljene 1959, i spomenik [Dragojlu Dudiću](Q1565909). Skulpture su rad Vide Jocić, po kojoj park nosi ime.
opis.en: The park at Jadar contains busts of People’s Heroes and revolutionaries from the Valjevo area, installed in 1959, and a monument to [Dragojlo Dudić](Q1565909). The sculptures are by Vida Jocić, after whom the park is named.

opis.sh: Spomen-groblje sa 313 boraca NOP-a iz valjevskog kraja, među njima 261 koga su Nemci streljali 27. novembra 1941, posle [predaje zarobljenih partizana od strane četnika](Q11163232).
opis.en: Memorial cemetery with 313 members of the liberation movement from the Valjevo region, including 261 shot by the Germans on 27 November 1941 after [the Chetniks handed over captured Partisans](Q11163232).

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima revolucije, kroz lik narodnog heroja [Stjepana Filipovića](Q458061). Podignute ruke figure podsećaju na njegov poziv na otpor neposredno pre vešanja u Valjevu 1942. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fighters of the revolution through the figure of National Hero [Stjepan Filipović](Q458061). The figure’s raised arms recall his call for resistance immediately before his execution by hanging in Valjevo in 1942.

opis.sh: Spomen-kosturnica palih boraca i žrtava fašizma na centralnom groblju, delo Pavla Vojkovića iz 1961.
opis.en: Memorial ossuary of fallen fighters and victims of fascism in the central cemetery, by Pavle Vojković, 1961.

opis.sh: Kosturnica palih boraca iz 1947, koju je projektovao Vinko Leki, zamenjena je 1977. današnjim spomenikom Zlatka Ugljena. Prvobitna kosturnica sadržala je posmrtne ostatke 17 boraca.
opis.en: Vinko Leki’s 1947 ossuary for fallen fighters was replaced in 1977 by the present monument by Zlatko Ugljen. The original ossuary held the remains of 17 fighters.

opis.sh: Posvećeno streljanim mladićima iz Vataše.
opis.en: Dedicated to the executed young men of Vataša.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima NOVJ i žrtvama fašizma; spomen-obeležje Svetislava Ličine podignuto je 1961.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisans and victims of fascism; Svetislav Ličina's memorial was erected in 1961.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim partizanima Velesa i okoline, čiji su posmrtni ostaci sahranjeni u kosturnici. Memorijal je oblikovan kao cvet maka, a unutrašnjost krase mozaici Petra Mazeva.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisans from Veles and the surrounding area, whose remains are interred in the ossuary. The memorial takes the form of a poppy flower, with interior mosaics by Petar Mazev.

veles.autor: Ljubomir Denković & Savo Subotin & Petar Mazev

opis.sh: Spomen-kuća pesnika i revolucionara Koče Racina, restaurirana 1962, sa njegovim originalnim rukopisima.
opis.en: Memorial house of poet and revolutionary Kočo Racin, restored in 1962, holding his original manuscripts.

veles-spomenik-na-koco-racin.adresa: Во дворот на Гимназијата; бронзена фигура, четирипетинска големина.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Velih Laza.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters from Veli Lazi.

velika-biljanica.adresa: Na uzvišenju iznad Južne Morave, nedaleko od mosta

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima Babičkog odreda poginulim 4. februara 1942, kada su srušili most na Moravi. Spomen-kompleks Stevana Sokolovića otkriven je 1967, a tekst je napisao Dobrica Ćosić.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters of the Babička Detachment killed on 4 February 1942 when they destroyed the bridge over the Morava. Stevan Sokolović's memorial complex was unveiled in 1967, with a text by Dobrica Ćosić.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima; nalazi se u zaseoku Čitluk, kod nekadašnje škole. Obnovljen je 2002.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters, in the hamlet of Čitluk by the former school. It was renovated in 2002.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim u Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in WWII.

velika-grabovnica-bista-borka-stamenkovi.adresa: Kod OŠ „Vuk Karadžić“, pored spomenika palim borcima
velika-grabovnica-bista-borka-stamenkovi.slikaPotpis: Ekipa Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

opis.sh: Posvećeno Borku Stamenkoviću, borcu Kukavičkog odreda i puškomitraljescu Prvog udarnog bataljona, poginulom avgusta 1943. kod Crkovice. Bista je otkrivena 7. jula 1985.
opis.en: Dedicated to Borko Stamenković, a fighter of the Kukavica Detachment and machine gunner of the First Assault Battalion, killed near Crkovica in August 1943. The bust was unveiled on 7 July 1985.

velika-grabovnica-bista-stojana-ilica.adresa: Kod OŠ „Vuk Karadžić“, pored spomenika palim borcima
velika-grabovnica-bista-stojana-ilica.slikaPotpis: Ekipa Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

opis.sh: Posvećeno Stojanu Iliću Conki (1919-1943), članu Sreskog komiteta. Bista Nebojše Mitrovića otkrivena je 7. jula 1985.
opis.en: Dedicated to Stojan Ilić Conka (1919–1943), a member of the district committee. Nebojša Mitrović’s bust was unveiled on 7 July 1985.

velika-grabovnica-spomenik-palim-borcima.adresa: U centru sela, kod OŠ „Vuk Karadžić“

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima iz ratova 1912-1918. i 1941-1945. i žrtvama fašističkog terora; spomenik je otkriven 7. jula 1984. U celini su i biste Borka Stamenkovića i Stojana Ilića iz NOB-a, kao i kasnije dodata bista Saše Kostića, poginulog 1992.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters of the wars of 1912–1918 and 1941–1945 and victims of fascist terror; the monument was unveiled on 7 July 1984. The ensemble includes busts of Partisans Borko Stamenković and Stojan Ilić, and a later bust of Saša Kostić, who died in 1992.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim 1912-1918. i u NOB 1941-1945. Bista partizana i dve table sa imenima otkrivene su 4. decembra 1968.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in 1912-1918 and in WWII 1941-1945. The Partisan bust and two name boards were unveiled on 4 December 1968.

opis.sh: Memorijal NOB Podgrmeča čuva posmrtne ostatke 76 boraca; prvobitna kosturnica iz 1961. zamenjena je sadašnjom celinom 1989. godine, prema projektu Omera Čauševića i Milovana Krstića. Na zidovima su imena palih boraca i žrtava fašističkog terora, a u sredini memorijalni portreti devet istaknutih učesnika.
opis.en: The Podgrmeč National Liberation Struggle memorial holds the remains of 76 fighters; the original 1961 ossuary was replaced by the present complex in 1989, designed by Omer Čaušević and Milovan Krstić. Its walls list fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror, and its centre contains memorial portraits of nine prominent participants.

velika-socanica-spomenik-palim-borcima.adresa: Raskrsnica prema Ljupljanici i Dažnici, severni obod Velike Sočanice.

opis.sh: Spomenik iz 1950. uništen je 1992. i obnovljen 2003. Obnovljeno obeležje zadržava posvetu borcima i žrtvama Drugog svetskog rata, uz dodati krst i posvete ratu 1992–1995.
opis.en: The 1950 memorial was destroyed in 1992 and reconstructed in 2003. It retains its dedication to WWII fighters and victims alongside an added cross and inscriptions commemorating the 1992–1995 war.

velika-spomenik-zrtvama-pokolja.slikaPotpis: Spomenici NOB u Crnoj Gori, Facebook

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama pokolja u Velici i okolini 28. jula 1944.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of the massacre in Velika and surroundings on 28 July 1944.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Antonu Kambiču Dušanu i saborcima.
opis.en: Dedicated to Anton Kambič Dušan and comrades.

opis.sh: Posvećeno dvojici komandanata Tomšičeve brigade.
opis.en: Dedicated to two commanders of the Tomšič Brigade.

opis.sh: Grob boraca 12. slovenačke udarne brigade.
opis.en: Grave of fighters of the 12th Slovene Assault Brigade.

veliki-zdenci-grobnica-palih-boraca-nor-.posveta: borcima NOV palim za oslobođenje Velikih Zdenaca 1945.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima sa Košutnjaka.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters from Košutnjak.

veliko-trojstvo-spomen-muzej-josipa-broz.adresa: U središtu sela, uz glavnu cestu i ostatke Pollakova mlina

opis.sh: U kući u kojoj je [Josip Broz Tito](Q9161) živeo 1921-1925. otvoren je 1980. spomen-muzej o njegovom životu i radu u bjelovarskom kraju. Postavka je zatvorena 1992, a predmeti preneti u Gradski muzej Bjelovar.
opis.en: The house where [Josip Broz Tito](Q9161) lived in 1921–1925 became a memorial museum in 1980, presenting his life and work in the Bjelovar area. The exhibition closed in 1992 and its objects were transferred to Bjelovar City Museum.

vester-vestrski-mlin.slikaPotpis: Semjon at Slovenian Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 3.0

opis.sh: Mlin u kome je radila ilegalna partizanska tehnika; Nemci su ga spalili 8. februara 1944, a delimično je obnovljen kao spomenik palim partizanima.
opis.en: A mill that housed a clandestine Partisan printing press; the Germans burned it on 8 February 1944, and it was partly restored as a monument to fallen Partisans.

opis.sh: Posvećeno ratnicima stradalim 1912-1918 i 1941-1945.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters who fell in 1912-1918 and 1941-1945.

opis.sh: Mauzolej u kome su od novembra 1946. sahranjeni istaknuti borci subotičkog radničkog pokreta i revolucionari streljani, obešeni ili poginuli u borbi za slobodu ovog kraja.
opis.en: Mausoleum where prominent figures of the Subotica workers' movement and revolutionaries shot, hanged or killed in the struggle for the region's freedom have been buried since November 1946.

vinarce.adresa: U centru Vinarca, na raskrsnici puteva ka Donjem Stopanju i Podrimcu

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima iz Vinarca poginulim u Prvom i Drugom svetskom ratu i žrtvama fašističkog terora. Četiri betonska kraka, od kojih najviši doseže 11 metara, delo su Đorđa Vasića.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters from Vinarce killed in World Wars I and II and victims of fascist terror. Its four concrete arms, the tallest reaching eleven metres, were designed by Đorđe Vasić.

vinarce-spomenik-milutinu-smiljkovicu.slikaPotpis: Ekipa Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture Niš, Studija zaštite 2023

opis.sh: Posvećeno Milutinu Smiljkoviću, sekretaru gradskog biroa KPJ za Leskovac, koga su na ovom mestu posle mučenja streljali 28. jula 1944. Spomenik je postavljen 11. oktobra 1961.
opis.en: Dedicated to Milutin Smiljković, secretary of the Leskovac city bureau of the Communist Party of Yugoslavia, executed here after torture on 28 July 1944. The memorial was installed on 11 October 1961.

vinkovci-spomen-kosturnica-boraca-nor-a.adresa: Središnji gradski park, Trg bana Josipa Šokčevića
vinkovci-spomen-kosturnica-boraca-nor-a.slikaPotpis: Andrija Ćavar, Registar kulturnih dobara RH

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima vatrogascima.
opis.en: Dedicated to firefighters who fought in the war.

opis.sh: Spomenik sa Titovim rečima „Tuđe nećemo, svoje ne damo“ uklonjen je devedesetih godina.
opis.en: The monument bearing Tito's words "We don't want what belongs to others, we won't give what is ours" was removed in the 1990s.

opis.sh: Nekadašnji muzej u tvrđavi Batarija bio je posvećen boravku [Vrhovnog štaba](Q3444687) i [NKOJ-a](Q2273313) na Visu 1944. godine. Memorijalna postavka više nije izložena; u tvrđavi danas radi Zavičajni muzej grada Visa, koji čuva i obnavlja predmete bivše zbirke.
opis.en: The former museum in Batarija Fortress commemorated the stay of the [Supreme Headquarters](Q3444687) and [NKOJ](Q2273313) on Vis in 1944. The memorial exhibition is no longer on display; the fortress now houses the Vis local history museum, which preserves and restores objects from the former collection.

vis-spomen-obiljezje.slikaPotpis: Foto Lipa, Spomenici i spomen-obilježja NOR-a u opštini Danilovgrad (2017)

opis.sh: Posvećeno meštanima mučenim i ubijenim početkom jula 1944. tokom potere bugarske kaznene jedinice za borcima Pirotskog partizanskog odreda.
opis.en: Dedicated to residents tortured and killed in early July 1944 during a Bulgarian punitive unit's hunt for fighters of the Pirot Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Kosturnica Marijana Kockovića iz 1963. čuva posmrtne ostatke 37 boraca visočkog kraja, uz skulpturalnu kompoziciju sa ljudskim figurama u reljefu. Tri biste koje su nekada stajale iza nje kasnije su ukradene i uništene.
opis.en: Marijan Kocković’s 1963 ossuary holds the remains of 37 fighters from the Visoko area, with a sculptural composition incorporating human figures in relief. Three busts formerly behind it were later stolen and destroyed.

vitomirica-bista-milosa-gilica.adresa: Bista Miloša Gilića, narodnog heroja, ispred zgrade osnovne škole. Miloš Gilić, aktivista revolucionarnog omladinskog pokreta, partijski rukovodilac u peći, sek

vitovlje-spomenik-napadu-i-bataljona-pri.natpis:
V bližini so 1.9.1943 borci I. bataljona Primorskega odreda napadli in uničili sovražnikov kamion s posadko.

Po tej poti so zavedni ljudje oskrbovali enote IX. korpusa z materialom Vipavske doline, Krasa in Furlanije.

9.1988 OO ZZB Nova Gorica

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima NOR-a i žrtvama fašističkog terora; kod spomenika se svakog 8. septembra obeležava oslobođenje Vladičinog Hana.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen WWII fighters and victims of fascist terror; the liberation of Vladičin Han is commemorated here every 8 September.

opis.sh: Kosturnica iz 1946. preoblikovana je 1983–1987. prema projektu Valentina Šalajeva. Pri obnovi 2017. uklonjene su reference na ustanak i dodat krst; sadašnji natpis posvećen je žrtvama ustaškog zločina u Rašića Gaju iz jula 1941.
opis.en: The 1946 ossuary was remodelled in 1983–1987 to a design by Valentin Šalajev. During its 2017 renovation, references to the uprising were removed and a cross added; the current inscription commemorates victims of the July 1941 Ustaša crime at Rašića Gaj.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima narodnooslobodilačkog rata i žrtvama fašističkog terora.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters of the People’s Liberation War and victims of fascist terror.

opis.sh: Spomen-kompleks palima u NOR-u na obali Vlasinskog jezera, sa binom za manifestacije.
opis.en: Memorial complex to those killed in WWII on the shore of Lake Vlasina, with a stage for events.

opis.sh: Spomen-česma iz 1989. u centru sela, posvećena borcima palim u Prvom i Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Memorial fountain from 1989 in the village center, dedicated to fighters killed in WWI and WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno meštanima palim u balkanskim, Prvom i Drugom svetskom ratu. Spomenik Velizara Paunovića visok sedam metara otkriven je 1983.
opis.en: Dedicated to locals killed in the Balkan Wars, WWI and WWII. Velizar Paunović's seven-meter monument was unveiled in 1983.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašizma vlasotinačkog kraja. Kamena celina obuhvata kružni amfiteatar, aleju blokova sa reljefima i simbolični pilon.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascism from the Vlasotince area. The stone composition comprises a circular amphitheatre, an avenue of blocks with reliefs and a symbolic pylon.

opis.sh: Spomenik Vođeničkoj četi iz 1979. ima četiri betonska kraka i oštećene spomen-ploče. U istoj celini sačuvano je i zasebno starije obeležje iz 1953. godine.
opis.en: The 1979 memorial to the Vođenica Company has four concrete fins and damaged memorial plaques. A separate older memorial from 1953 also survives at the site.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim partizanima i žrtvama rata iz Vodoteča i okolnog kraja. Park obuhvata spomen-kosturnicu i skulpturalna obeležja; u septembru 2017. ukradene su ploče sa imenima i tri biste narodnih heroja.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisans and war victims from Vodoteč and the surrounding area. The park includes a memorial ossuary and sculptural memorials; name plaques and three busts of People’s Heroes were stolen in September 2017.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i ilegalcima vogošćanskog kraja. Grobnica iz 1954. zamenjena je 1969. memorijalom Petra Krstića i Zlatka Ugljena; obnovljena je 2008, a natpisi ponovo oslikani oko 2016.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and underground activists from the Vogošća area. The 1954 collective grave was replaced in 1969 by Petar Krstić and Zlatko Ugljen’s memorial; it was restored in 2008 and the inscriptions repainted around 2016.

vogosca-spomenik-igmanskom-marsu.natpis:
U NOĆI IZMEĐU 27. I 28. JANUARA 1942. GODINE OVIM PRAVCEM PROŠLA JE PRVA PROLETERSKA BRIGADA U SVOM SLAVNOM IGMANSKOM MARŠU
VOGOŠĆA 1984.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašizma iz bivše Vojakovačke opštine.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of fascism from the former Vojakovac municipality.

vojsko-partizanska-tiskarna-slovenija.slikaPotpis: Janez Novak, Ljubljana, Slovenija, CC BY-SA 3.0

opis.sh: Sačuvani kompleks tajne partizanske štamparije u kojem je od septembra 1944. do maja 1945. štampan list „Partizanski dnevnik“. Kao memorijalni muzej otvoren je 1947, sa drvenim barakama i sačuvanim štamparskim mašinama.
opis.en: This preserved clandestine Partisan printing complex produced the newspaper “Partizanski dnevnik” from September 1944 to May 1945. Opened as a memorial museum in 1947, it retains its wooden huts and printing machinery.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palima u NOB i članovima organizacije TIGR.
opis.en: Dedicated to those killed in WWII and to members of the TIGR organization.

vrabac-spomen-podrucje.adresa: Uz put Konjic–Kalinovik, na usponu kod Vrapca

opis.sh: Obeležava pobedu Konjičkog partizanskog bataljona nad nadmoćnijim neprijateljem 15. oktobra 1941. Memorijal obuhvata posvetnu ploču, top i kamenom popločan prilaz.
opis.en: Marks the Konjic Partisan Battalion’s victory over a stronger enemy on 15 October 1941. The memorial comprises a dedicatory plaque, an artillery piece and a stone-paved approach.

vranic-spomen-dom-spomenik-obelisk.slikaPotpis: Gorran at Serbian Wikipedia, Public domain

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima Vranjica. Mozaik Marinka Benzona iz 1956, prvi spomen-mozaik palim borcima u Hrvatskoj, prikazuje porodicu koja ispraća oca u partizane.
opis.en: Dedicated to the fallen fighters of Vranjic. Marinko Benzon's 1956 mosaic, the first memorial mosaic to fallen fighters in Croatia, shows a family seeing off a father who joins the Partisans.

opis.sh: Spomenik u sećanje na devetoricu zarobljenih partizana obešenih u decembru 1943. u Vranjskim Njivama. Delo Milorada Vukotića obeležava mesto njihovog pogubljenja u podnožju Veljeg brda.
opis.en: Dedicated to nine captured Partisans hanged at Vranjske Njive in December 1943. Milorad Vukotić’s monument marks the place of their execution at the foot of Velje Hill.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim partizanima planinarima.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisan mountaineers.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima NOR-a i žrtvama fašističkog terora. Obeležje podignuto pre 1973. premešteno je početkom 2000-ih i uključuje ploču izrađenu od srednjovekovnog stećka.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror. The memorial, erected before 1973, was relocated in the early 2000s and incorporates a plaque made from a medieval stećak tombstone.

vrbanja-spomenik-palim-borcima-nor-a-i-z.slikaPotpis: Andrija Ćavar, Registar kulturnih dobara RH

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima narodnooslobodilačkog rata i žrtvama fašističkog terora.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters of the People’s Liberation War and victims of fascist terror.

opis.sh: Posvećeno dvojici crvenoarmejaca poginulih pri oslobođenju Vrbasa. Uklonjen je posle 1948, a obnovljen 2010.
opis.en: Dedicated to two Red Army soldiers killed in the liberation of Vrbas. Removed after 1948, it was restored in 2010.

opis.sh: Na mestu grobnice iz 1957. nalazi se memorijal preuređen 1987. godine. U njemu su obeleženi i grobovi 13 poznatih i 17 nepoznatih boraca; posveta ratu 1992-1995. dodata je kasnije.
opis.en: The memorial was rebuilt in 1987 at the site of a 1957 grave. It also marks the graves of 13 identified and 17 unidentified fighters; a dedication to the 1992-1995 war was added later.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borbi Druge čete Trećeg bataljona [Četvrte crnogorske brigade](Q12761191). Ranije obeležje postojalo je pre 1975, a sadašnja skulptura Miodraga Živkovića potiče iz 1987.
opis.en: Dedicated to the battle fought by the 2nd Company of the 3rd Battalion of the [4th Montenegrin Brigade](Q12761191). An earlier memorial existed before 1975; the present sculpture by Miodrag Živković dates from 1987.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim u Prvom i Drugom svetskom ratu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed in WWI and WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno bici na Slemenu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Battle of Sleme.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima palim na Vrhama.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters killed at Vrhe.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Prvoj tenkovskoj brigadi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 1st Tank Brigade.

opis.sh: Spomenik iz 1983. na Popovića brdu posvećen je žrtvama fašističkog terora; katalog navodi 77 žrtava. Prikazana je samo približna tačka Vrhovske.
opis.en: The 1983 memorial at Popovića Brdo commemorates victims of fascist terror; the catalogue lists 77 victims. The point only approximately marks Vrhovska.

opis.sh: Posvećeno ustaničkom logoru Vrnjačkog partizanskog odreda.
opis.en: Dedicated to the insurgent camp of the Vrnjci Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Obeležava stratište oko 2.000 žrtava fašističkog terora na Poljicama. Spomenik je podignut 1955, a spomen-ploča razbijena u prvoj polovini 2025.
opis.en: Marks the execution site of around 2,000 victims of fascist terror at Poljice. The monument was erected in 1955 and its plaque smashed in the first half of 2025.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora, ukupno 195 ljudi.
opis.en: Dedicated to 195 fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror.

opis.sh: Spomenik iz 1971. nalazi se u memorijalnom prostoru sa imenima palih boraca i civilnih žrtava i izloženim topom. Celina je obnovljena 2011, posle vandalizma početkom dvehiljaditih.
opis.en: The 1971 memorial stands in a commemorative site with the names of fallen fighters and civilian victims and an artillery piece. The site was restored in 2011 after vandalism in the early 2000s.

opis.sh: Skulptura borca koji podignutim rukama poziva na ustanak, delo Dušana Nikolića, otkrivena 7. jula 1959.
opis.en: Sculpture of a fighter calling to the uprising with raised arms, by Dušan Nikolić, unveiled on 7 July 1959.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Slavku Todoroviću, jednoj od prvih žrtava Kukavičkog partizanskog odreda; spomenik Đorđa Vasića podignut je 1973. Posle razbijanja 2018, Zavod ga je 29. juna 2022. zatekao na mestu, sa oštećenjima.
opis.en: Dedicated to Slavko Todorović, one of the first casualties of the Kukavica Partisan Detachment; Đorđe Vasić’s memorial was erected in 1973. After vandalism in 2018, the heritage institute documented it still standing, with damage, on 29 June 2022.

opis.sh: U rodnoj kući Ivana Ribara bio je muzej o njegovom životu i radu i o sinovima Jurici i Ivi Loli, sa dokumentima i ličnim predmetima porodice. Muzejska građa je najvećim delom uništena ili opljačkana 1991-1995, a spomen-kuća nije aktivno muzejsko mesto.
opis.en: Ivan Ribar’s birthplace housed a museum about his life and work and those of his sons Jurica and Ivo Lola, with family documents and personal belongings. Most of the collection was destroyed or looted in 1991–1995, and the memorial house is no longer an active museum site.

opis.sh: Spomen-kuća nekadašnjeg štaba [Prvog majevičkog partizanskog odreda](Q16761149) obeležava napad četnika 20. februara 1942, u kojem su ubijeni članovi štaba i drugi borci. U kući je posle rata bila uređena memorijalna postavka, čija današnja dostupnost nije potvrđena.
opis.en: The former headquarters house of the [1st Majevica Partisan Detachment](Q16761149) commemorates the Chetnik attack of 20 February 1942, in which headquarters members and other fighters were killed. A memorial exhibition was established in the house after the war, but its present-day accessibility has not been confirmed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima Majevičkog partizanskog odreda i žrtvama fašističkog terora; prvobitni memorijal sa reljefom Ismeta Mujezinovića podignut je 1954, a kompleks proširen 1974. godine. U njegovom oblikovanju učestvovali su i Zlatko Ugljen i Branko Tadić, dok je centralni spomenik rad Draga Tršara iz 1980-ih.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters of the Majevica Partisan Detachment and victims of fascist terror; the original memorial with a relief by Ismet Mujezinović dates to 1954, and the complex was expanded in 1974. Zlatko Ugljen and Branko Tadić also contributed to its design; the central monument is a 1980s work by Drago Tršar.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama ustaškog terora: vlasti NDH su tokom rata na ovom mestu streljale 455 ljudi. Spomen-park je razoren 1990-ih, a obnova je počela 2015.
opis.en: Dedicated to the 455 people executed here by the authorities of the Independent State of Croatia during the war. The memorial park was devastated in the 1990s and restoration began in 2015.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Niku Marašu i šestorici saboraca poginulih u januaru 1942. na Morači i u okolini.
opis.en: Dedicated to Niko Maraš and six comrades killed in January 1942 on the Morača and nearby.

opis.sh: Obeležje za 180 žrtava fašističkog terora postojalo je pre 1983. Teško je oštećeno 1994, a obnovljeno i preuređeno sa velikim krstom 2020. godine.
opis.en: The memorial to 180 victims of fascist terror existed before 1983. It was badly damaged in 1994 and restored and altered with a large cross in 2020.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borbi naroda Šajkaške.
opis.en: Dedicated to the struggle of the people of Šajkaška.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašističkog terora i Narodnooslobodilačkoj borbi naroda Šajkaške. Kompleks na potesu Crna Ćuprija čuva sećanje na stradanje stanovnika žabaljskog kraja i Šajkaški partizanski odred.
opis.en: Dedicated to victims of fascist terror and the People’s Liberation Struggle of the Šajkaška region. The complex at Crna Ćuprija commemorates the suffering of residents of the Žabalj area and the Šajkaš Partisan Detachment.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora durmitorskog kraja. Piramidalni spomenik od belog kamena podignut je 1963. godine.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror from the Durmitor region. The pyramid-shaped monument of white stone was erected in 1963.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim vatrogascima.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen firefighters.

opis.sh: Posvećeno osnivanju Molniške čete.
opis.en: Dedicated to the founding of the Molnik Company.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama Drugog svetskog rata.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of WWII.

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto partizanske radionice kod Doma kulture u Zagonima. Ploča koja je postojala pre 1960. kasnije je zamenjena spomenikom, podignutim posle 1963. godine.
opis.en: Marks the site of a Partisan workshop by the cultural centre in Zagoni. A plaque existing before 1960 was later replaced by a monument erected after 1963.

opis.sh: Kosturnica čuva posmrtne ostatke četrnaest partizanskih boraca i čuva sećanje na još osam ljudi.
opis.en: The ossuary holds the remains of fourteen Partisan fighters and commemorates eight others.

opis.sh: Posvećeno dalmatinskoj brigadi.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Dalmatian Brigade.

opis.sh: Ovaj spomenik u Kanalu posvećen je približno 500 žrtava fašističkog terora ubijenih 1941. Podignut je 27. jula 1956. i obnovljen 1999; odvojen je od obeležja za 1.200 žrtava.
opis.en: This Kanal monument commemorates approximately 500 victims of fascist terror killed in 1941. Erected on 27 July 1956 and restored in 1999, it is separate from the memorial to 1,200 victims.

opis.sh: Obeležava mesto na kojem su fašisti 26. novembra 1943. ubili Pavla Lončarića.
opis.en: Marks the site where fascists killed Pavle Lončarić on 26 November 1943.

opis.en: Dedicated to the [December Victims](Q1564958), sixteen antifascists publicly hanged by the Ustaše in Zagreb’s Dubrava district on 20 December 1943.

opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascism from Dubrava.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama fašizma iz Zagreba, preko 7.000 ljudi koje su ustaše ubile u Dotrščini, Maksimiru i Rakovom Potoku. Skulptura Frane Kršinića iz 1954. prvi je takav spomenik u centru grada.
opis.en: Dedicated to the victims of fascism from Zagreb, over 7,000 people killed by the Ustaše at Dotrščina, Maksimir and Rakov Potok. Frano Kršinić's 1954 sculpture was the first such monument in the city center.

opis.en: Dedicated to Slavko Anastasijević and Stana Smiljković, tortured and executed on 9 March 1944 after refusing to betray their Partisan comrades. Stevan Sokolović’s monument was erected by the people of Priboj and Zalužnje in 1989.

opis.sh: Spomenik između Rosulja i Zanesovića posvećen je žrtvama fašističkog terora iz 1941. Prvobitno obeležje iz 1985. uništeno je tokom rata 1992-1995, a zamenjeno 2000.
opis.en: The memorial between Rosulje and Zanesovići commemorates victims of fascist terror killed in 1941. The original 1985 memorial was destroyed during the 1992-1995 war and replaced in 2000.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim zaostroškim partizanima i žrtvama narodnooslobodilačke borbe. Betonski spomenik Rudolfa Matutinovića na obali oblikovan je poput stilizovanog cveta, sa imenima stradalih i memorijalnim natpisima pri dnu.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen Partisans from Zaostrog and victims of the Partisan struggle. Rudolf Matutinović’s concrete waterfront monument resembles a stylised flower, with victims’ names and commemorative inscriptions around its base.

opis.en: Dedicated to those from Lepovče killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palima u NOB sa Trnja.
opis.en: Dedicated to those from Trnje killed in WWII.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palima u NOB iz Češnjice.
opis.en: Dedicated to those from Češnjica killed in WWII.

zeljova-spomen-kosturnica-palih-boraca.adresa: U podnožju brda u Željovi, na ograđenom platou

opis.sh: Kosturnica 19 partizanskih boraca, među kojima je Bogoljub Čukić, podignuta je 1958. godine. Katalog beleži obnovu 2007, uz znatnu promenu izgleda.
opis.en: The ossuary of 19 Partisan fighters, including Bogoljub Čukić, was erected in 1958. The catalogue records renovation in 2007 that substantially changed its appearance.

opis.sh: Posvećeno bombašima NOVJ poginulim u NOB. Stojeća figura borca u trenutku bacanja bombe, delo Vanje Radauša.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisan grenadiers killed in WWII. A standing figure of a fighter throwing a grenade, by Vanja Radauš.

opis.sh: Spomenik palima u narodnoj revoluciji 1941-1945, u središtu Avijatičarskog trga u Zemunu.
opis.en: Monument to those who fell in the people's revolution of 1941-1945, in the center of Aviators' Square in Zemun.

opis.sh: Posvećeno žrtvama logora Sajmište sahranjenim u masovnoj grobnici na Zemunskom groblju.
opis.en: Dedicated to victims of the Sajmište camp buried in a mass grave at the Zemun cemetery.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima [Zeničkog partizanskog odreda](Q19738589) i Trećeg istočnobosanskog udarnog bataljona, stradalim u maju 1942. Spomenik Arfana Hozića otkriven je 27. jula 1968. na Smetovima.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters of the [Zenica Partisan Detachment](Q19738589) and Third Eastern Bosnian Assault Battalion killed in May 1942. Arfan Hozić’s monument was unveiled on Smetovi on 27 July 1968.

zenica-spomen-park-papirnica.adresa: Park Papirna, Ulica dr. Abdulaziza Aska Borića

opis.sh: Memorijal sa kosturnicom oblikovan je 1955. prema projektu Juraja Neidhardta, obnovljen 1981. i 2019. i dopunjen 1999. U park su sa drugih mesta prenete biste različitih autora, među njima sestara Ditrih i Seada Škrge.
opis.en: The ossuary memorial was designed by Juraj Neidhardt in 1955, restored in 1981 and 2019, and supplemented in 1999. Busts by different artists were relocated here, including those of the Ditrih sisters and Sead Škrgo.

zenica-spomenik-streljanim-partizanima.adresa: Sarajevska ulica, kod ulaza u Kazneno-popravni dom

opis.sh: Spomenik Karla Kužatka na stratištu aktivista NOP-a podignut je 1954. i temeljno obnovljen 1973. Katalog navodi 14 žrtava, dok obnovljeni natpis imenuje 12 streljanih 26. januara 1943.
opis.en: Karlo Kužatko’s memorial at the execution site of underground activists was erected in 1954 and extensively restored in 1973. The catalogue lists 14 victims, while the renewed inscription names 12 people executed on 26 January 1943.

opis.sh: Posvećeno Radi Kondiću i palim borcima na Palašnici u masivu Mahnjače. Obeležje je postojalo pre 1960, a obnovljeno je 2009. i 2017.
opis.en: Dedicated to Rade Kondić and fallen fighters on Palašnica in the Mahnjača range. The memorial existed before 1960 and was restored in 2009 and 2017.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror.

opis.sh: Spomenik romskim žrtvama fašističkog terora iz 1970. obnovljen je posle 1995. Kasnije mu je dodata zasebna ploča žrtvama rata 1992-1995.
opis.en: The 1970 memorial to Roma victims of fascist terror was restored after 1995. A separate plaque to victims of the 1992-1995 war was subsequently added.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim kuririma.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen couriers.

opis.sh: Spomen-dom nosio je ime narodnog heroja [Petra Mećave](Q12757204), sa njegovom bistom i pločom poginulim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora iz Živaje. Prema popisu iz 2002, ploča je razbijena, a bista odstranjena; postojanje muzejske zbirke nije potvrđeno.
opis.en: The memorial hall was named after Partisan hero [Petar Mećava](Q12757204), with his bust and a plaque to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror from Živaja. The 2002 inventory records the plaque as broken and the bust as removed; no museum collection has been confirmed.

zivinice.adresa: Brdo iznad fudbalskog stadiona, preko mosta

opis.sh: Groblje je formirano 1957, spomenički elementi i ulazna ploča dodati su 1959, nadgrobne ploče 1968, a spomen-zid 1973–1974. Nalazi se na brdu iznad fudbalskog stadiona.
opis.en: The cemetery was established in 1957; memorial elements and the entrance plaque were added in 1959, grave markers in 1968, and the memorial wall in 1973–1974. It lies on the hill overlooking the football stadium.

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanu Dimitriju J. Trajčeskom iz Zlatara (1920-1943).
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisan Dimitri J. Trajčeski from Zlatari (1920-1943).

opis.sh: Posvećeno ranjenim i nenaoružanim partizanima koje su nemački vojnici 29. novembra 1941. streljali i gazili tenkovima. Iznad kosturnice je 1967. podignut obelisk Jovanke Jeftanović i Ane Bešlić.
opis.en: Dedicated to wounded and unarmed Partisans whom German soldiers shot and ran over with tanks on 29 November 1941. An obelisk by Jovanka Jeftanović and Ana Bešlić was raised above the ossuary in 1967.

opis.sh: Posvećeno bici na Palisadu.
opis.en: Dedicated to the Battle of Palisad.

opis.sh: Posvećeno poginulim borcima i žrtvama fašizma iz Zlota, uz obeležja ranijih oslobodilačkih ratova. Celina obuhvata spomen-ploče i biste učesnika NOB, među kojima su bili rudari i borci Boljevačkog odreda.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascism from Zlot, alongside memorials to earlier wars of liberation. The site includes plaques and busts of Partisan participants, among them miners and fighters of the Boljevac Detachment.

zmajevac-spomen-ploca-erneu-kisu.slikaPotpis: Ana Mutnjaković / Dokumentacija Konzervatorskog odjela u Osijeku, Spomenici NOB na području Baranje (2022)

opis.sh: Posvećeno Alojziju Novaku na Papežu.
opis.en: Dedicated to Alojzij Novak at Papež.

opis.sh: Posvećeno početku partizanskog ustanka u Vojvodini i osnivanju rukovodstva vojvođanskih partizanskih odreda 1941. Bronzana skulptura Mladena Marinkova oblikovana je kao raonik, povezujući otpor sa zemljom i radom vojvođanskih seljaka.
opis.en: Dedicated to the beginning of the Partisan uprising in Vojvodina and the establishment of the regional Partisan detachments’ leadership in 1941. Mladen Marinkov’s bronze sculpture takes the form of a ploughshare, linking resistance to the land and the work of Vojvodina’s peasants.

opis.sh: Posvećeno rodoljubima streljanim na Mihajlovačkom drumu.
opis.en: Dedicated to patriots executed on Mihajlovački Drum.

zrenjanin-spomen-cesma.slikaPotpis: Zavod za zaštitu spomenika kulture Zrenjanin

opis.sh: Posvećeno rodoljubima koje su nemačke snage streljale 1941. i crvenoarmejcima poginulim u oslobođenju srednjeg Banata 1944. Park obuhvata obelisk na stratištu i spomen-kosturnicu.
opis.en: Dedicated to patriots executed by German forces in 1941 and Red Army soldiers who fell in the liberation of central Banat in 1944. The park includes an obelisk at the execution site and a memorial ossuary.

opis.sh: Posvećeno crvenoarmejcima palim 1944.
opis.en: Dedicated to Red Army soldiers killed in 1944.

zrinska-spomenik-palim-borcima.posveta: 19 palih boraca iz sela i 99 žrtava fašističkog terora

zuberin-spomenik-palim-borcima-i-zrtvama.adresa: Kod osnovne škole prema katalogu; tačno mesto nije potvrđeno

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim borcima i žrtvama fašističkog terora iz Jasene i Žuberina. U 2015. godini zabeleženo je loše stanje spomenika sa uništenom pločom.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen fighters and victims of fascist terror from Jasena and Žuberin. In 2015, the memorial was recorded in poor condition with its plaque destroyed.

opis.sh: Posvećeno borcima [Pete proleterske crnogorske brigade](Q855731) poginulim u [Bici na Sutjesci](Q1419973) 1943. Betonski spomenik Ljuba Vojvodića podignut je u Carinama, nedaleko od manastira Svetog Luke.
opis.en: Dedicated to fighters of the [5th Montenegrin Proletarian Brigade](Q855731) killed in the [Battle of the Sutjeska](Q1419973) in 1943. Ljubo Vojvodić’s concrete monument stands in Carine, near St Luke’s Monastery.

opis.sh: Posvećeno palim radnicima krapinske tekstilne industrije.
opis.en: Dedicated to fallen workers of the Krapina textile factory.

opis.sh: Posvećeno partizanima i aktivistima Osvobodilne fronte poginulim u Suhoj krajini tokom Drugog svetskog rata. Ispod spomenika na Cviblju nalazi se kosturnica, a na kamenim pločama uz njega ispisana su imena 1.144 stradalih.
opis.en: Dedicated to Partisans and Liberation Front activists killed in Suha Krajina during the Second World War. An ossuary lies beneath the monument on Cvibelj Hill, while stone panels beside it list the names of 1,144 victims.

opis.sh: U zajedničkoj grobnici iz 1963. sahranjeno je 14 palih boraca. Grobno obeležje zamenjeno je 2010. stelom sa krstom; izvor ne potvrđuje da je grobnica ostala na prvobitnom mestu.
opis.en: The collective grave established in 1963 holds 14 fallen fighters. Its marker was replaced in 2010 by a stele bearing a cross; the source does not confirm that the grave remained at its original site.

opis.sh: Grob Filipa Kljajića iz 1961. deo je centralne spomen-kosturnice. Jusuf Begović oblikovao je dogradnje 1983; nije zaseban grob u Malom parku.
opis.en: Filip Kljajić’s 1961 tomb is part of the central memorial ossuary. Jusuf Begović designed additions in 1983; it is not a separate grave in Mali Park.

zvornik-spomen-kosturnica.adresa: Ulica Svetog Save, centralni memorijalni plato

opis.sh: Kosturnica boraca Prve proleterske brigade obuhvata i grob Filipa Kljajića iz 1961, dograđen 1983. Celina je obnovljena 2022–2023, a tada joj je pridružena Kljajićeva statua premeštena iz Malog parka; obeležje ratu 1992–1995. stoji uz nju.
opis.en: The First Proletarian Brigade ossuary includes Filip Kljajić’s 1961 tomb, supplemented in 1983. The complex was restored in 2022–2023, when his statue was moved here from Mali Park; a memorial to the 1992–1995 war stands alongside.

zvornik-spomen-kosturnica.autor: Dragiša Trifković & Jusuf Begović & Mehmed Hrasnica

opis.sh: Posvećeno Štabu Prve proleterske divizije 1943.
opis.en: Dedicated to the headquarters of the 1st Proletarian Division in 1943.
